reviews.comment: Professor Qing is one of the most knowledgeable professors I've had at MSU; Her profound understanding of the Sino-US partnership is rare. She possesses a plethora of experience reading, writing, and teaching about Chinese foreign policy and ways to pacify Sino-U.S. relations. She is both competent and caring!
Absolutely wonderful and brilliant professor, she knows a lot and always wants what's best for her students. I've taken 2 of her classes and I would take anything she teaches.

Prof Qing is a wonderful lady. She can be difficult to understand but she knows this. She recognizes the language barrier and will help you to understand. She laughs regarding her troubles with English at times. Not really a tough grader and pretty open with due dates. She is not a very good grader and does take some time to submit. 4/5.

I graduated in 2004.  Dr. Qing is the most compassionate, enthusiastic, fair, and honest professor I've had. I am now a teacher and her spirit in the classroom inspires and informs my work.  I tried to take as many of her classes as were offered and I studied abroad with her in Beijing.   Go to office hours. Be passionate and informed--you'll learn

Excellent Prof.  Encourages Debate and provides good guide lines for understanding the reading.  Accent is a small barrier.  Don't ever underestimate her, she is very smart, and always paying attention.

While Professor Qing's accent may make it hard for some students to learn, she really wants students to understand the material and engage in discussion.  She is more than willing to go over things during office hours and her enthusiasm for the subject shows.  If you study what's on her slides for the exams then you should do fine.

Generally nice-clearly intelligent;somewhat haphazard in teaching style; accent and English as a second language pose a barrier between her and the class. Grading either w/0 rhyme/reason or aiming to hit arbitrary 2.5 bell curve. Many assignments I received had 'excellent work' coupled w/ mediocre grades. Two words: Knuckle Sandwich.
good professor, hard to understand most of the time but very interesting and intelligent.
I agree...  not a good professor.  She basically just wants you to debate in class instead of going over the readings.  Then, by the time you get to the midterm or exam, you get screwed over.
Don't take this professor.  It will be the end of your GPA.
Very nice, and pretty easy, even though grading can be a bit inconsistant and hard to predict. Be careful, or she might give you a "knuckle sandwich!"
If you can take her for Russian, do! She's a great professor and is very generous. It's Russian, so you're going to have to work, but as long as you keep up you'll do fine.

reviews.comment: Lessons cover a lot of the class prep activities relating to the shows watched in class this semester. Very flexible with submitting late work and she if she doesn't allow corrections on summary activities (tests), they're usually given a bit of a curve anyway. Я люблю Жанну :)

Shannon is very kind and understanding, very flexible with late work as well, which is good considering the heavy workload for Russian. She's also pretty funny. Love hearing about the babushka lore. Lessons follow the Mezdhu Nami workbook until it's finished, then they go onto prep for the spring semester of 200 level RUS

The professor is nice, but this class is so boring. You have online prep videos, reading assignments, and a reading quiz all twice a week. We had two creative writing assignments and a final. Stories are originally in Russian and translated, so they don't make much sense and are very long and boring. Take another class if you can

reviews.comment: Class was easy, just a lot of homework involved. Teacher is nice and have had no grading issues either.

reviews.comment: Do not take this class if you can. There is lots of reading every week and the stories are boring. I took this class because of the easy schedule but wish I hadn't.

If you have any other options, do not take this class. There is pre class work for every class, a reading assignment with questions, a quiz, and an online prep. She assigns way too much homework! I would not take this class if you do not want the heavy and boring work load.  Class is mandatory and she is not understanding. Expects A LOT!! Just the worst.

reviews.comment: He has a class policy of requesting an extension by 10pm. Me and my friend both missed the deadline but just to try our luck, we both emailed him. My friend got an extension while I didn't. How do you explain that!
Worst lecturer. Too strong an accent, can't comprehend what he is saying. He comes to the class, talks to himself for 80mins and leaves.
Took the slides and homework from the the professor who taught the class in the previous semester, changed his name and that's it! He doesn't care if you understand. However, easy exams!

Take her online FI 311, everything is on D2L and her lectures are good. Material is difficult in some areas but many resources to help you through. She has an accent that she warns about at the start of the semester, I don't think its a deal breaker. Good prof.

reviews.comment: Very nice professor. Took the time to explain everything and in a way it made sense. A homework quiz attached with every chapter lecture, but she reviews all the questions in the videos and you get unlimited attempts. The exams were similar to the quizzes, overall easy class and great professor!
took her for M&A class, she is amazing.

One of the most enjoyable classes. I went to the lectures sometimes just to cheer up. Whatever happened in the news/reality, she made relevant jokes and is super positive. I never know someone can make so many jokes about finance. I learn a lot about everything else in addition to finance.

I took her class as I heard there was not a textbook but ended up likeing finance a lot more than I can ever imagine. She gave a lot of flexibilities and really cared for her students to succeed. I am good with computer stuff so the class is a lot easier for me than my friends. Remember it's a finance class.

This class has lots of practice material and homework. Even after doing that, I still didn't feel comfortable at all on the 2 exams in the class. If you take it hybrid, showing up to her class is optional and you can take it like a normal online class. If you're fine with teaching yourself and finance is easy for you, take her. If not, don't

Her lectures are very interactive and she talks a lot about career development. Attendance not mandatory and no textbook. two exams 50% of your grade. the other half basically participation by finishing them.
I like her online setup. She is quite lenient but there are rules like the rest said. I abide by the rules and ace the class!!
GOAT. But I might be biased. I am actuarial science major :) She made everything super organized and accessible!

Took her fi311 freshman year. Her session was really small then and now it looks like all her sessions are overbooked :)

She required attendance for participation points but heard that this is changing. She is very caring and even helped me during my job search. Watch out, she has a dark sense of humor :)

I took her this summer as she no longer does classes for non business students. Manageable and she barely emailed so I am not sure what others refer to. Clear announcements. Engineering background so this class is much easier compared to core engineering classes.

She creates all materials herself and no textbook fee is just a bonus. This class is not my major, just for a minor in business for non business folks. Too bad that all good professors return to teach business cores :(
She cares a lot about academic integrity and fairness, which is why I like her so much. Just do my work and no need to worry that someone may get ahead because they ask for special treatment.
One of my worst professors

reviews.comment: The homework was easy but never once did the quizzes we had show up in D2L on things due and maybe I missed it in the syllabus but I never saw anything about having to do quizzes each week so I missed half of them which resulted in my low grade. When I emailed her about it she told me that she is not allowing me to go back and complete them.
She is the rudest professor I have ever had. Her questions make no sense and she is honestly so conceited and full of herself. Do not take her.

2 homework assignments and a quiz due each week. She gives out the homework answers, but homework still takes time as its done on excel. Grades super easy; there was 2 assignments I did not fully complete and still got full credit. Her emails are weird and she can be hard to understand as english is not her first language.

I would personally be on the fence about taking a class with this professor again. The instructor is clear about what needs to be done, but if you need help or don't understand as well as you should, you have to figure it out.

Its an online async class, there are two assignments due each Sunday, both are very easy and are essentially participation grades. She explains concepts very thoroughly and goes through the homework with videos. There is a lot of material to rely on to complete assignments and the exam is open note.

reviews.comment: The concepts she teaches are complex and difficult to understand. However, in the online section, she literally gives the homework answers out in her lecture videos before the assignment is even due so it's a free 100%. Every exam question is on Chegg, and if the numbers are different, the formulas are still there. Overall, was an easy class.

Her class has a lot of difficult concepts, but she gives a lot of examples in her lecture videos, so you can kind of work through it. The exams are pretty difficult as well, but are open note. She likes to send really long emails and just overall has a lot of rules, which no one has time to read.
So much leniency with assignments, especially in the online asynchronous section. Hard to not 4.0 this class

She wants her students to succeed, gives ample assignments for easy grades, curves exams by awarding bonus points, and seems to be very available to help if you need it. The exams are a bit tough though. My one complaint is that she emails frequently and the emails are written as though they are an in conversation between her and you.
Grasp of English language not good enough to teach classes. Very difficult to understand. Says things that make little to no sense.
Ok literally so bad. Everything is all over the place all the time. Sends emails like its a conversation between them and the student it is SO confusing.
Full of himself and arrogant.

Qiu's class is clearly organized and not very difficult. The material is complex and challenging, but she sets you up to succeed. Only one homework assignment and one study quiz per week for the most part, which are free points because she gives you unlimited attempts for the quizzes. Exams are very similar to quizzes. Good professor.

Pretty easy class, just be ready to spend a decent amount of time on it. Qiu is a pretty tough professor, but her exams are not very difficult. I'd say most people who did poorly likely don't learn very well in an online environment, so if that describes you, I'd avoid this course.

As someone who isn't a finance major this class was cake. While it was all online that is what made it an easy 4.0 you just do the assignment and quiz every week, literally just do the work and you will get a 4.0 .

I'm a psych major with NO finance experience and I am doing just fine in this class. You only have to avg 80% on the exams to 4.0 with the way it is set up and I've done minimal homework/studying. reviews.comment: This professor seems very bitter. She is passive agressive and very petty in all announcements and emails. I have never been so unmotivated to do well in a class. Everyone in this class constantly complains about it. Extremely intense for a beginner finance coarse.

The professor seems like a nice person but she teaches like we already know the material. Most of us are not finance majors but she throws around a lot of technical terms which can be confusing. this class was unbearably hard for no reason. The professor just doesnt teach well, lectures arent structured well and hard to follow. 2 exams make up your entire grade basically and are very difficult.
2 Exams make up 60% of your grade.

Her teaching style is kind of like if Type to Learn was taught by a motivational speaker. If you're a masochist looking for an easy course that tests the boundaries of how much work someone can do without learning anything, then this "finance" course is the one for you.

Mingming was not a great professor but this class is easy af. 3 exams and attendance is only what you are graded on. Plus most questions in the exam are copied from her sample paper. If you are smart enough to understand basic finance, this class is the easiest 4.0 ever.

reviews.comment: Dr. Rodriguez is my favorite professor that I have ever had! In this course, he finds a way to make every lecture interesting and makes his students excited to come to class and participate. The class content is interesting. He does not assign homework besides reading. Quizzes are very easy if you simply listen to the lecture. Highly Recommend!!

My only problem with this class was the use of AI. He doesn't have lecture notes for the topics he assigns, instead you have to interact with an AI chatbot (Gemini or GPT). Other than that, hes great, the class is hardly difficult and it can be fun at times.
One of my favorite professors at msu, i took his avatar and vr class because of how easy his class is. The only way to fail is literally if you don't do your work

Robby seems like a good guy and the class isn't very difficult but that doesn't give him an automatic 5/5. 4.0 is 94-100. He is super disorganized. Everything in D2L is a link to a google doc. Not sure why he can't just post to D2L like every other professor. Grading expectations were confusing. Responded to emails quick but feedback wasn't helpful

Robby is a great professor who is very passionate about virtual reality and avatars. He encourages a positive, accepting, and inclusive environment. I can't forget to mention how absolutely fun the class is. Having group discussion/activities in VR is SERIOUSLY fun. A class where you learn while flying around on a magic cushion is unforgettable.

One of the best professors I've ever had. Prof Robby makes a clear effort to know his students' names and get to know them well. He is passionate and excited, making his lectures fun and enjoyable. He is always working with students to understand how he can make the class better and make tests go more smoothly. I would 100% recommend him.

Robby is definitely the best professor Ive had. Hes super cool and funny, hes understanding and just a great guy. Lectures are mandatory but theyre really fun and interesting. Hes chill and really cares about his students. Would recommend him and this class.
Great professor, great class. Everything was easy to follow and not hard work. Mostly consisted of papers but they were only 200-400 words. Easy 4.0 if you do the work.

Robby was hands-down the best professor I could ask for. He cracks jokes all the time and he really knows what he's doing. He's also very good at keeping the class engaged. I wish I could retake the class every semester.

Very funny and entertaining, heavily lecture oriented, 2 pretty easy and easily-graded projects, 3 exams and 1 final, get to drop one (so you dont have to take the final if you do good on the 3 exams)
Good guy, interesting topics, good explanations.

reviews.comment: She's a good Prof, however exams are worth %60. Final exam will replace your lowest grade but exams are tough.
Attendance mandatory. Pay attention in class or you wont pass. She moves pretty fast in class but lecture videos are posted. Put in the work and youll be alright.

Dr Pollock is an amazing Professor; her teaching style is good, and she tests what she taught with iClicker questions. She gives opportunities for extra credits as well, 4 total exams with 1 Final exam that will replace your lowest grade from the other 3. I had previous experience doing A' Level Chemistry, so the class was very easy to understand.

Mrs. Pollock was a good professor and explained topics thoroughly. 
-iClicker every lecture with questions for attendance 
-Homework twice a week graded by completion
-Recitation is mostly groupwork but is fairly easy and mostly completion

The exams were very lecture and recitation heavy. As long as you went to class and truly understood what she was talking about and could apply it to other concepts, you will do well in this class. I also recommend going to the help room for more clarification and exam prep. Overall, she was great and super nice.
Dr Pollock is a very knowledgeable person, and you are able to understand the lectures pretty well.  (I unfortunately don't do good in chem no matter what) But she is an amazing professor.

Amy Pollock is a great professor who truly wants her students to learn. PAY ATTENTION to her lectures and TAKE GOOD NOTES. These will be your best friend for the exam. DO NOT slack off on the BeSocratic HW or in the recitations. These are basically mini-reviews for the exams.

Absolutely amazing professor. The way she taught the class made everything in chemistry just click. All homework, recitation activities, and exams will be very easy if you show up to lectures. Made learning chemistry enjoyable.

Dr. pollock was seriously genuine about us succeeding in her class. she would give homework twice a week, but even those are done within 30 minutes. she would tell you everything to do in order to receive a good grade, provided tons of resources, and made it engaging. she is very educated on the topic at hand, and is very kind and considerate.

Professor Pollock took subject that I'm not very good at and simplified it enough for me to get a 3.0. Overall, a good, not great professor. But she can sometimes go a little fast so definitely be sure to stay up on the readings or at least use the help room.

Amy lowkey the goat at teaching, even for a difficult class. It was easy to take notes as she lectured and we would do iClicker for attendance points. Show up to lecture and recitation, take notes, try your best, and you will be fine. I literally got B's on all my tests and A's on everything else, giving me a 4.0 in the end. CEM 141 survivor.
She gave good explanations and clearly cares about students' learning. She has a lot of resources and tips for studying.

This class is taught in a big setting so not very personal. Everything you need to know will be taught in class which is mandatory. Lots of material to study for the test with. Class is not hard but she loves trick questions.

Great prof and made the course very easy to understand if you pay attention in lecture. Homework isn't bad and she goes over it in lecture. Attendance is mandatory with IClicker. Completion worksheet in recitation.
Great lecturer!
Made this class really easy to understand and she's good at explaining topics in a clear and concise way.

Amy is amazing. She is a super kind and a cute lady. However, if you do not come to the lectures, you will fail. Class material is basic chem and Amy teaches it super well. She is very passionate and explains every thing in great detail. There are about 2 easy homeworks a week.  Overall, if you come to class and pay attention, you should pass.
Super great professor!

reviews.comment: I loved Dr Pollock. She explains things very well and made confusing concepts easy to understand so make sure to pay attention in lecture. I got a 4.0 in this class. I never did amazing on the exams but the homework and extra credit help a ton. The final is super easy too. I would recommend taking CEM141 with Pollock.

Love Dr. Pollock! She explains things well in class better than my high school teachers. I never went to office hours since they conflicted with my classes but I've heard that she explains things very very well there. Just make sure you shown up and pay attention in class!
Very informative lectures, she teaches you exactly what is going to be on the tests and how to approach it. Definitely make use of the practice materials before each test.

You really just have to attend lecture and pay attention. This class is a general chemistry class, so the concepts are fairly simple. Go to class, study, get what you pay for. The only con I have is that the due dates for homework can be somewhat random, leading me to miss two of them because it slipped my mind.

Amazing at explaining the WHY for concepts, wants people to succeed and is good at telling us how to, makes lecture interesting, easy to understand. SUPER organized which was the reason for my success, posts lecture vids. Doesn't waste a second of lecture, definitely memorizes her speeches. Use learning objectives to study for exams! I'd recommend!

I studied for 9+ hours on every exam and never received anything better than an 82%. One exam I got a 69% even though I studied for 9 hours. She's a decent teacher, but this course just sets people up for failure. I do not understand how people 4.0 this class.
Very good lecturer, explains topics well. She does a very good job explaining why the concepts work the way they do instead of just giving us rules to memorize. And the homework load isn't too crazy.

Very good lecturer, explains topics well. She does a very good job explaining why the concepts work the way they do instead of just giving us rules to memorize.
And the homework load isn't too crazy.

Dr.Pollock is a very good professor. She is well experienced and makes you really understand concepts that can be challenging. She goes slow over materials (which I liked) to ensure that everything is clear. I wished she taught upper-level chemistry so I can retake them with her.

Professor Pollock was a great professor and explained the material slowly and thoroughly. She was very accessible outside of class and told you exactly what you needed to know to be successful. CEM 141 is a tough class but if you put the work in and go to all the lectures you will succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Prof is very aimed towards students success and education, but you can't really miss a lecture. Multiple extra credits and clear learning objectives. She is very clear with the material and easy to learn from, gives many suggestions on how to succeed in the class and if you follow you will. The exams were straightforward but at weird times.

Amazing professor, genuinely so nice and as long as you go to lectures and pay attention, you'll be fine. The homework is completion and the tests are hard so make sure you go study EVERYTHING on the slides and go to the help room!

Dr. Pollock was one of my favorite professors of the whole semester. I don't love chemistry, but she has a great teaching style. If most of the class got a lecture question wrong, she wouldn't show us how we answered and would reiterate from a different approach with more detail, then ask the question again and it worked every time. Great prof.
Professor Pollock is a great teacher. Highly recommend taking CEM 141 with her.

Lectures are SO important please go! Pay attention and ask questions, she is more than happy to help! She wants to make sure students succeed and even though it is a general course, still wants to make kids love chemistry. Overall, a wonderful professor!

I love her class. CEM 141 is typically hard but the way she explains things helped me understand. Homework definitely helps with understanding the material. I recommend utilizing the learning objectives. Exams to me were easy. Don't be afraid to use the help room too!

I absolutely loved having Dr. Pollock! She lectures in a manner that is easy to understand and she does look for participation a lot in lectures- but I personally didn't mind. If you follow the learning objectives, and are good (and quick) at taking notes in class you will be just fine. She makes expectations very clear and is very kind overall.

reviews.comment: She is a solid professor and conveys information in a digestible manner. If you pay attention and take notes in class, do the homework, and use the PAs for help as needed in recitation then you should be able to pass.

You will DEFINITELY want to take notes in addition to the lecture notebook. Make sure to do multiple practice exams and take the mock exams. The textbook itself wasn't terribly helpful.

Good teacher - One of the best I have had for chemistry courses. Teaching style is understandable and helpful, as well as taught sometimes from a student perspective. Missing a lecture could be bad, provided you don't read the section. Good office hours, too.

Great professor!  Explains things in a way that are clear and helpful.  Chemistry is just a hard subject in general but she makes it easier.  Whatever you do, buy the green book of notes and the blue exam booklet, they save lives.  Expect homework you do have to do OWLs but they help you lots. If you get another prof, come to Pollock's lectures.
Very clear when teaching, best cem prof to have
Hands down one of the best profs I have had at state so far.

She is very clear with her explanations and examples, and her homework is very fair and usually short (if you understand what's going on). She, understandably, has a dislike for students talking during the class, but she encourages questions to be ask directly to her if there is any confusion. It is a 'hard science class, so expect it to be so.
She does a great job of doing examples, and explaining chemistry clearly to the students

This class is extremely difficult, especially if you've never taken hard science classes since this is a mostly Freshmen class. If you're willing to work for it, you can get a good grade. A 4.0 is anywhere above an 80% which is not too difficult to obtain. This professor makes the class a lot easier.
Pollock is an amazing lecturer. She really knows how to explain things well. People skip their lectures with other CEM professors just to go to her's. Highly recommended to take her
Mrs. Pollock is a great teacher. But you still have to work for your grade. Her great lectures and office hours add to the success of the grade you earn. Do not slack off!

Amazing. I have the highest respect for her. She knows her field in great depth,  is crystal clear in everything she says, and brings her A game to every single lecture. She is the best professor I have ever had by leaps and bounds.  Do whatever you can to take her.
Pollock it by far the best professor i've ever had. The class is tough, but she's amazing

I was TERRIFIED to take CEM141 at MSU just because of all the hype over it. I had a different prof but ended up going to Pollock's lectures. Best decision I've ever made. She made the material super easy and broke it down to a point that you could easily understand. Go to her lecturse even if you don't have her. She's the only reason I did so well

The BEST professor I have ever had. Extremely clear and easy to understand. She explains chemistry so clearly and easily I received A's on the exams, when I never thought that'd be possible. DEFINITELY push to have her.

The best professor I have had so far. I didn't do so well in chemistry in high school, but she explained it so well and was very clear and easy to understand, and I received a 4.0. She is definitely one of the best professors on campus.

I found this class to be extremely hard but I also didn't go to class much. Just do all the practice exams, go to class, and make sure you know what you're doing after each lecture. If you do this, a 3.0 should always be possible
Explained the material very clearly.
Never opened the text book for the class because she explained the material so well.
She understands the material very well and presents it in a very clear way.
Pollock is a really good professor, very clear in her lectures and the best teacher for chemistry. If you don't get her, you'll regret it!

Awesome teacher! I switched from another prof and my grades increased dramatically, she is very helpful, her lectures are awesome and she has great office hours! Would recommend for any CEM class at MSU

She does a wonderful job of explaining things in a way that is easily understandable which is important with a class like chemistry. Don't waste any money on the textbook though, I 4.0ed it without opening it. Buy the lecture notes, the exam and solutions book and attend class regularly and you will be successful in this class.

She is a clear, helpful teacher, but the class itself is hard. The tests are hard no matter what professor you have. I would highly recommend buying the lecture notes and practice exams, but the chemistry text book isn't neccessary.
Great professor!
She was very helpful and clear.  The class requires a lot of work, but she does everything she can to help
I'm awful at Chemistry and she made it understandable for me.

Professor was great. She did a good job explaining the material thoroughly and in a way that was beneficial for everyone. I see she has quite a good rating here, and it's for a good reason. Highly recommended.

LOVE pollock!!! the class was difficult though but she is a great teacher very thorough and slow with the material and always willing to help out no matter when you need it... she is a great teacher but it doesn't mean slacking the class is a lot of effort!

This chemistry is hard, but Pollock makes it look so simple. She's very clear and her notes are so easy to follow. I loved the way she taught. My best advice is pay attention in class, then when you get home, do the Exam and Solutions qustions you can do. Good luck!
Great Professor, I hate the subject but she got me a 4.0
She explains everything very clearly, but in a monotone voice. I had the 4:10 lecture and needed an energy drink to actually focus on what she was saying.

Prof Pollock is an awesome teacher! People who got laduca or hunter were jealous of me because I had the best chem prof. She is super clear in teaching and does a great job explaining concepts. The course itself if pretty tough, i had to work REALLY hard to get a 3.0
Best professor ever
great! explained organic chemistry really clearly!!

Jeez... I have no idea how she got such a good score but I seriously disagree with most of what was said about her.  She goes out of her way to teach things differently than the way most people were taught in high school.  She over-complicates simple concepts, and the exams are absolute nightmares.

Decent prof. First time she taught the class. It can get boring especially in the afternoon. Notes are basically the same as the lecture notes. Use the study guide and do as many practice exams as possible way before the exams and you will ace the class or you can easily scrape by with a 3.0 by doing average on exams and all OWL questions

Dr. Pollock is a great prof. She is very clear and helpful. It is a pretty difficult class but it's chemistry. Go to class, take good lecture notes, start studying for the exams ahead of time, and do the practice exams!!! I would definately recommend this professor.

I simply LOVED this professor!  She is very clear, organized, helpful, enthusiastic, hard-working...etc,and I could go on for ever!  If you have any trouble understanding the material or doing homework GO to her office and she will help you.  Believe me when I say she is the sweetest professor you'll ever meet!  I am really going to miss her!

Dr Pollack was very helpful and available even though there were over 1000 students in the class. She is very good at chemistry and did a great job explaining the subject. Dr Pollack is the best professor in the chemistry department. I highly recommend her!

Excellent professor!  Very good at explaining and simplifying concepts, always willing to help, and her exams aren't too difficult.  I wish every professor was at least half as good as her!  God bless Dr. Amy Pollock!
Really enthusiastic about chemistry, and more than happy to help you out.  Great teaching style.
No Comments

Amy is an excellent professor!  I had her for 141 and understood everything she taught.  I don't like chemistry, but she teaches the information so that you can understand, and is always willing to explain again if someone has a question.  I definitely recommend her if you are taking 141 OR 143.
Very easy to understand. If you have a question she will be sure to clear it up for you.
The most wonderful teacher I have ever had! She makes everything so easy to learn, and she teaches in a way that makes it difficult not to understand.  I would highly recommend her to anyone!
Awsome teacher
She really knows her stuff, and she tries really hard to make sure that you understand it as well. Going to her helped me so much on the tests. I understood everything so much better.
The class is amaizng..even if its a big class..i lov the expirements she shows us!!..and she is a gr8 teacher!! Relaly like the way she teaches :)

She cares for her students and their wellbeing. Requires attendance, Group project heavy!! Should be a hybrid class because of the number of times you get out of class early. Doesn't really grade anything so you won't know your grade until the end of semester.

Truly the best Prof I have had all of college- sees potential, passionate about projects, and incredibly hands on work! If you just show up and participate you will pass easily- she truly cares about the success of her students which is so refreshing.
Best professor I had this semester. She truly cares about all her students.

This is my second class with Lolo, and she's great! My advice would be to participate actively in group discussions. She's great to have conversations with. You do most, if not all, work in groups but the work is easy

Just take her courses, even for fun. Sometimes it can seem like a good amount of work but it is all so worth it and important info that will lead you to finding out more on your own. Her DEI course was great and very informative. LOVE her!!
I loved Prof. Robison! She always let us out early, and the assignments were really interesting! The final is a group project, but it is very easy if you read the rubric.

she is actually the best professor you will ever have in your time at msu. she is quick to get to the point and teaches you well. she doesnt give busy work either. we had one assignment a week and it was pretty simple. easy 4.0 if you at least try.

class can seem intimidating at first but once you get a good understanding of what you are doing its not bad. you do have to get at least 2 textbooks. She is pretty quick at explaining what you are doing. writing assignments are not hard

This has been my favorite class, It is super easy grade, cares more about your learning, uses textbooks (you don't really need to read them, but it is good to have), and gave us a pizza party. Gives more feedback than any other professor. She will read all your work.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Super easy and really nice professor. If you show up, turn your work in on time, say hi to her when you walk through the door its simple A+. Not hard at all if you're a decent student.

Easiest class I've ever taken. Very nice but you truly will learn absolutely nothing. Every assignment was group work and you will get 100 on everything even if you do it wrong. Every class I went to I felt like she was confused as to what she should even be teaching. If you are looking for a class that is a complete joke and an easy A, take this.

Lolo was so much fun and super understanding of your needs. The mid-term was an easy A and so was the class. We were able to swap a final for a group project and that was also easy. All around fun and easy 4.0. Lolo is so sweet and I enjoyed class discussions.
Class is boring and you teach yourself a lot. There is lots of easy group work. The class is a little annoying, but it's easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Mr. Steinberg is an all-around great professor. He teaches tough topics with respect and passion. He truly cares about everyone and wants you to succeed, so take all the extra credit opportunities he gives you. Reading the textbook DEF helps, and being engaged in recitation is just locking it all in.

This is my second class with Dr. Steinberg and I would defend this man with my dying breaths. He's caring with his students, and makes his lectures interesting even if you aren't a history person. His rubrics are straight-forward, so as long as you do what's asked you'll do perfectly fine. Couple random quizzes but he warns you ahead of time.

the goat. Funny af, very knowledgable, interesting lectures, easy assignments, pretty absorbable content. Just make sure you go to recitations as that's where he holds the quizzes (which are super easy if you pay attention). Def going to take as many of his classes as I can.

he's a great guy and his lectures are always entertaining. make sure you attend the recitations, those are mandatory. only assignments were readings, the mid-term and final essays, and very short and easy  multiple choice quizzes on fridays. as long as you pay attention to the lectures and take notes then you're all set!
Great professor and even better person. He had engaging lectures and was extremely knowledgeable on the course content. Assignments were straightforward and related to lecture content.
Professor Steinberg was an amazing professor. He offered extra credit opportunities, made his lectures super interesting, and was not a harsh grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Great and passionate professor. As long as you go to the lectures and do your assignments you'll be golden. Generous with extra credit. Hilarious, I always referred to him as "if Michael Scott was a professor"! Entertaining, good at answering emails, and cares about his students. Wants us all to succeed!

Prof Steinberg is my lord and savior. Funny guy. Certified history hater but he made it my favorite class of the semester. We learned about genocide but he taught it in a way were we understood the gravity and importance of the events without being insensitive. There are a few easy quizzes and bigger essays but 100/10 class hes amazing

Dare I say it, the GOAT. He's super forgiving and willing to give out extra credit or make-up opportunities to students who need them. He's also legitimately hilarious and makes a super delicate and tragic topic somewhat light-hearted and approachable. I cannot recommend him enough, easily one of the best professors here at MSU.

He is so funny and so chill. His class was very interesting so I enjoyed going to lectures even thought you didn't really have to. We were graded on 3 at-home essays and 6 quizzes in recitation. Super easy class to take as an ISS. He is so sweet, I'm going to miss having a class with him!

Gosh he's great, just take the class. His TA's are amazing, he's hilarious. Lecture can get long bc he talks a lot but like, just take notes and chill. The topic is heavy but he is able to lighten the mood. I'd take any of his classes again. Genuinely going to miss this class.

There's a reason Dr. Steinberg has such high ratings. Not only is he able to take such a devastating subject and crack a few jokes, but he's so passionate and wants you to understand and take to heart what he's teaching. It's easy to pass if you show up to lecture and follow his rubrics, but I can not stress it enough to take one of his classes.

Professor Steinberg is one of the best history professors. His lectures were funny and easy to follow along with. He also posted his lectures after class to catch up on if needed. The grades were based on one midterm, one final, and attendance/participation; however, he gave a study guide and clear guidelines on what he wanted to see.

Easy class, course material is heavy but it's very digestible if you go to lectures. Steinberg is funny too, so I ended up looking forward to morning lectures. Recitation attendance is mandatory and workload isn't heavy aside from the readings. Extra credit was offered for the first few weeks to pad your grade or make up for quizzes. Silly guy.

Ronen is an amazing professor! Although the course material is not the most interesting, he made it very entertaining with his side comments and funny jokes! He is such a sweet guy and offers several extra credit opportunities. I wish I could take another class with this professor. The class only has 100 points, but its very easy if you listen.

The class is super easy, and the lectures aren't required but help a lot and aren't dreadful, he tries to make them entertaining. But recitation attendance is mandatory and worth like 15% of your grade. No homework really and only like 4 quizzes

Ronen was such an amazing professor. He had a way of making heavy course topics seem "light" with major emphasis on how each impacted history. He also a great sense of humor. Only gave 5 short quizzes, 2 exams, and 3 essays over the whole semester.

Dr. Steinberg is a fantastic professor, he's funny, kind, and very genuine overall. Our seminar was not in his field of expertise persay, and he was very transparent about it. You read papers, present one with a group, and then focus on writing a research paper. Overall easy, good vibes and plenty of sunshine.

Lectures were easy to follow, and prof answered all questions asked. Always cracking jokes and being unintentionally funny. Lecture wasn't required but recitation was, but my TA excused me when I was sick. Two papers, one midsemester and one for the final. Readings almost every week, but most were provided by prof on D2L.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Steinberg is an amazing professor and probably my favorite at MSU. Took him in the fall and I genuinely looked forward to each class meeting and was sad when the semester ended. Super kind, funny, and caring man. Take him if you can!!
Absolutely AMAZING prof. I had Ronen in the fall and he was super personable, funny, and caring! If you have the chance to take a class with him DO IT 100%!!
Professor Steinberg was amazing. I looked forward to his lectures every day and I never missed a class.

Had him for hybrid course, hilarious dude. Can't say I loved the class topic but he makes it bearable. Super easy, basically lectures/reading and the occasional paper/quiz. Attendance wasn't mandatory and he offers EC
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The reviews speak for themselves. I haven't seen many professors with 30 five-star ratings on here. Truly an amazing professor, he is enlightened in his understanding of higher education. He does not penalize you for not understanding. He understands that a degree is necessary for us to succeed, and he wants to make sure everybody does well.

This man is so unintentionally funny! I was laughing every lecture. Very understanding of students getting bored with the material so he made sure to give breaks during lecture. A ton of reading but the TA's did a good job of covering said readings. The class was only out of 100 points so only a few points could be missed to keep an A.

One of the best professors I've had at MSU. He really cares about what he teaches and makes it interesting by tying in personal experiences, etc. Bi-weekly 10 minute quizzes but you get the prep materials beforehand. If you can take a class with him, do it! One midterm essay, one final paper that's it. Very easy yet interesting class, easy grading.
Funniest prof ever and easy class!

Dr Steinberg made it wonderful our class was unexpectedly online via zoom which sucked, but he did his best to not only make this class interactive as well as always have a good story to tell. He was very relatable. It was very clear from him and the TAs that they want you to succeed. The class itself is very heavy with reading content.
be ware
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--So many papers--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is super easy going and he's a funny guy! There were a few books we needed to read but they were cheap and some he provided on d2l. He kept it interesting. Easy to pass if you pay attention and read for the most part.  Would love if he taught more courses.

Super interesting lectures and entertaining! Class is lecture heavy but not difficult though I do recommend taking notes. Really cares about the information and students. Would 100% take again and recommend taking, the best professor I've had at MSU!

Literally one of my favorite instructors I have ever had! He changes his content for the students and gives extended deadlines for students. Very accommodating. I would look forward to going to his lectures. I want to find other classes with him, even if they don't count towards my major.
reviews.rating_tags: Hilarious--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: he was really nice and would change stuff if the students had difficulty.  funny guy too!

He was a really good teacher! The lectures were very enjoyable and contained lots of information and covered EVERYTHING that were on tests and quizzes. The class work is definitely manageable as you only have to deal with quizzes and essays, would definitely take this class again!

He was an amazing professor. He honestly made class enjoyable and something to look forward to. You can tell he is very passionate about history. I went to every class in the start of the semester but I got lazier as it got colder and stopped and I still managed to 4.0 Your grade is based on a couple of small online quizzes and 4 essays. super easy

Ronen was a very great professor to have. His class was a very chill, yet intellectual environment. You could tell he knew the subject matter very well and is genuinely incredibly smart. All of the assignments in this class are essays and short quizzes which if you attend lectures and put a tiny bit of effort in you'll do well.

Ronen was an absolutely amazing professor. Lectures are interesting and he really tried to make the material interesting. The grading in the course is very easy-going. Show up to class and you're guaranteed an A!

For the people saying you have to do lots of reading and if you skip pass you wont pass are completely wrong. The professor creates a study guide and has his lecture notes at the ready for you when you take the 5-10 question quizzes. There are 4 essays in his class and they are all under 2 pages long. I would 100% take this professor again!!!
ronen is gr8, today was our last lecture which was #sad. but this class is very easy and ronen is very engaging as well as hilarious. I've never been bored in this class.

Prof Steinberg is a great lecturer, for our course we had about 8 quizzes and 4 essays that made up your grade, if you chose not to go to the lectures the quizzes were pretty tough but if you have good attendance then youll pass this class easily.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: one of the best teachers I have ever had
The professor is very easy going and you have to try to fail
Amazing prof., so genuine and made learning online feel actually normal. So accommodating and helpful with anything!!

I took ISS210 in Fall 2020, it was completely online and the class was asynchronous. As a freshmen he was definitely one of my favorite professors. With a few lectures to watch weekly, + short discussion posts & about 3 essays over the semester. If you watch the content you can do well in class. His lectures were fun to watch, he's funny & sweet

Great class. As a freshman I thoroughly enjoyed this class. Lectures are a bit long, but the material you learn about is very interesting. TAs were great, and prof was hilarious. Some reading, but not too overwhelming. Very fair.

There is a lot of content provided in this class but Steinberg makes it really easy to get through. You do have to read the textbook and this semester we had to read a 200+ page book and write an essay on it while citing it so you have to read it. Quizzes can be hard but not bad. If you want a 4.0 in the class, you have to really put in the effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: I had Professor Steinberg for ISS 210 and I really enjoyed his class. He is very funny and I think he makes learning the content fun. The work load is not too bad. There are quite a few lectures though. Overall I enjoyed his class!

Professor Steinberg is, so far, my favorite professor at MSU. His lectures are never dry and he manages to make them relatively upbeat given the subject matter. There are only 2 "papers" at the beginning of the semester but they're only about 3 pages total between them. I highly recommend Professor Steinberg.

He was an amazing professor and always made me excited to come to class. I would definitely recommend finding a course that he teaches because you will not leave uninformed. He makes the class very interesting and is hilarious, too!

Ronen was a real gem. He was always able to make large lecture halls feel smaller. He'd crack jokes but still always get the information across. Amazing class, that you won't leave bored or feeling as if you wasted your money.
Really good perspective on things in history. Very knowledgeable and has a good delivery.

I loved coming to Ronen's classes. He is so funny and his lectures are informative. Everything you need to know on quizzes are said in lectures. I was never tricked on any test or quiz. Make sure you show up to recitation, where you go over readings and quizzes. Very helpful!

Ronen is the sweetest professor I have had so far at MSU. His unique sense of humor makes for a wonderful learning environment that keeps the student engaged in the classwork. He makes me want to be a better person. I would highly recommend taking a class with Ronen if you have the opportunity!

Ronen is the coolest dude ever. He is so funny, and also quite attractive as well. His lectures are very interesting as well as his accent. He has an accent, but his English is flawless and he's not hard to understand. His accent just adds to his hotness factor. Totally loved the guy and would take his class again.

Really great class and a really great, and engaging professor. Course material is a combination of reading primary sources and lecture material. Does not post the lecture slides online, but they don't have much text anyway. He likes to hear students' opinions and interpretations of the history. Assigns really interesting books to read.

Great professor and hilarious. English isn't his first language so its pretty funny when he doesn't get American puns/jokes. He is unusually knowledgeable about pop culture and wants students to enjoy learning about history.  Participation is a big deal for him but he reads the flow and attitude of the class so he won't press students to talk.

Makes history interesting which is saying a lot from a girl who hates history. Super funny. Lectures are kind of long and it can get easy to stop paying attention, but if you do pay attention, he doesn't do half bad at lecturing. Liked him a lot & would take him again if necessary.  Also, looks a little bit like Ted from How I Met Your Mother.

Knowledgable. Funny. Makes the material interesting, for those with a desire to learn the material or not. Uses great sources for media. Great sense of humor. WIlling to work with the student. Flexible. Doesn't assign a lot of homework, but enough to understand the course's outlines. The best history teacher I've ever had. He is phenomenal!
stay away from this professor, he needs to retire.

He's a very nice guy but the quizzes are setting you up for failure. He doesn't give you practice questions so you're blindsided by the questions. The midterms are very difficult as well. He doesn't even try to help his students do well
The mid terms are rough, it's like 25-30 multiple choice questions and then 2 short answer questions with like 8 parts each. I would never even finish the exams.

His class was by far one of the most difficult to sit through. He is a really nice professor, but the class is difficult. I would recommend going to class and reading the book because it really helps. Otherwise you will be completely lost.
hardest class you will take as an econ major or even at MSU. But professor Woodbury does a great job making sure you understand the material. He gives chances for extra credit, so go to class.
I liked his class EC380, quiz's were very easy, midterms kinda hard, final was pretty tough but an easy 3.0 overall. Good class and good teacher.

Dry, uninteresting lectures. Book work was easy, yet didn't have much to do with what was done in lecture or on exams. Overall an easy course, just be careful not to fall asleep: it's really easy in this class.
Completely unable to connect with students. The work was easy, but the lectures are tedious and uninspired.

Dry class, dryer professor.  Be prepared to listen to mundane details like OSHA-specified toilet seat dimensions.  Be prepared to get no credit on homework because you didn't staple it.  Be prepared to get test questions wrong because he gave the wrong answers.
boring lectures, easy tests, mainly reads off the slides

Never in my life have I heard someone say "alright" so many times in one sentence. Her class is fine, just reads off straight slides for 50 minutes. Pretty easy if you go through her notes and do the practice problems.

Goes above and beyond with her lectures and practice problems to ensure that students have the ability to succeed in her course despite the challenging material. Be sure to utilize help-room and her office hours, but all around one of the best and most helpful profs I've had here.
Fantastic instructor. Very fair grader, with engaging lectures, and cares for her students. Best economic professor I've had at State so far.

5/5 for sure. Usually I think the grad students kinda suck but Sierra was great. Not only does she actually care about students, but she makes lectures super engaging and even kinda fun?? (which I didn't think was possible). Grading is fair, exams are reasonable, lowkey best person to take intermediate from.

Sierra is a really great instructor who actually cares about her students. She's super down-to-earth and makes a tough class way easier to understand. She explains things clearly, gives good examples, and is always happy to help if you're struggling. Even though the class is hard, she makes it less stressful and really wants everyone to do well.

Her leftist opinions dominate the class, and she shuts down students who disagree instead of allowing for real discussion. She was often late, rude, and swore regularly while begging for students to treat her with respect in her syllabus. class was easy, but I would recommend taking it with anyone else.

worst professor. she cancels class more then she hold it, which seems fine but its always 10 minutes before class starts, WHILE your sitting in class waiting for her to show up. she also shows up 20 minutes late and shows up with food, while the rest of us have been waiting for her to show up. she only cares about herself and it shows. DONT TAKE.

Overall, this class was not difficult whatsoever, but I would not recommend taking this professor again. She was constantly late to class multiple days wasting our time. On top of that she would cancel class 30 minutes before class multiple times as well while I was already on my way. She thinks she is funny and sometimes makes inappropriate jokes

LOVE Dr Smith! She is funny, interactive, creative, and caring! Lectures were engaging, especially bc she uses similes to connect new vocab to everyday life. We discussed theories of conflict and inequality, which is not a liberal agenda, just the backbone of the field. Assignments are straightforward and routine, and she is beyond understanding :)

I love Dr. Smith so much. She is teaching an inherently political class that align with left-wing ideology, however the point is to learn history. People hate her because they're not interested in learning the content and think she's too woke. She is disorganized which is frustrating for sure — I have however found it manageable if you try.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I don't get why everyone hates on Dr. Smith. I took ISS 215 & 335 with her. She is definitely left-wing, and her views are clear in her lectures, but regardless, the class is super simple with assignments. Simply just go to class and do the homework, and you will 4.0. Anything less than that is simply a lack of effort, not intelligence.
I do not enjoy this professor

Not gonna lie I really didn't like going to this class, lectures were SO boring and I don't feel like I learned anything. However, it was easy and exams weren't bad. Theres a 5 question quiz and packback discussion post due each week & only a few in class assignments. You get a lot of drops. Prof smith wasnt that bad but ive definitely had better.

The hate is so forced, Dr. Smith is strange, but she's so funny. Easy class, be prepared for weekly quizzes (takes like 5 mins to do), attendance is mandatory, exams are simple and easy, gives you many opportunities to make up your work, and cares about yall. Yes, she's woke, so what? That makes class so much funnier than other classes.

READI! Worst class I've ever
taken. Easy to pass but Dr. Smith
is the most woke leftist teacher
ever, brings her political views into
the classroom. Has said she's
been in a house with spirits? and
requiring IDs to vote oppresses
the poor, and said it "just isn't
true" that some immigrants
commit crimes. There's way
worse beyond these. Save urself.

This professor is very unorganized and all over the place while teaching. If that isn't your learning style, I highly recommend taking a different class. The workload is manageable, but it's full of a lot of busy work. Exams are very easy.
Very tedious class, quizzes every week along with packback discussions, and class was three times of week with iclickers for attendance.

Literally what even happens in this class. Lectures end up being an absolute waste of my time. We debated about if chickens are a good pet for like an hour, when I could have been studying for chemistry. Always confused and information just gets shot at me with no real way of comprehending it!
Dropped the class after 2 sessions. 100% mandatory attendance and if you don't align with her political agenda, she has a problem with you. Very strange woman.

Only gets a 2 bc she's so easy. Lectures were horrible and riddled with her political views. I couldn't stand it. Teach without a bias please. Luckily where her poor lectures lacked, the ease of the class carried. So simple and straightforward. Easy A, just TERRIBLE lectures

Go to the lectures and do the work and you will be fine! The reason I lost credit is because I stopped going to her lectures. But she is passionate and will give you a good education through her course material and other subjects she connects to her lectures. I would take her class again!
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: This class was insanely easy. The only negative is that she cancels class A LOT. Even worse, attendance is mandatory; and many of the times she canceled class, she did it last minuet. She gives tons of extra credit and weekly assignments are super simple. The midterm and final exams could both be retaken if you somehow did poorly on them.
Weird but easy A if you push through.
The class was alright.
Honestly Dr. Smith was very caring and her class material was very easy to learn. Her class is unorganized and her lectures are very boring but it is so easy to 4.0 this class.

Such an easy class but the prof does not come off as smart or organized. Had probably as many classes canceled as actually happened and sometimes 10 min before class. Also one of those people that lovessss the sound of their own voice.

I took this class as a university requirement. The lectures were very engaging. If you show up to class, do your work, communicate with the professor, and take a small interest in what you're doing you should be able to get a decent grade.

Stacy was an easy professor for a blow-off requirement. Her lectures were long but engaging, and she made discussions fun. Some days were movie days, which gave a nice break. I don't get the hate—she clearly cares about her students. We had one online quiz a week, and the 2 exams were online too.

Manageable, but class constantly changed. We went from iClicker (which wasn't set up well) to Google Forms and went weeks sometimes without seeing the prof (cancelled due to multiple reasons). If people left during the lecture, expect to sign your name on a paper to get credit for the in-class assignment. Tricked us to see if we used ai as well.

Stacy lectured right up until the last MINUTE of class and her lectures were beyond boring. We didn't have class for 3.5 weeks at some point in the semester because she kept coming up with random excuses on why she couldn't make it. Her class was very easy, but, the 2 hour lectures made this class miserable.

Attendance mandatory, but also cancelled class last minute for weeks straight. Unorganized with lectures, and didn't learn anything new or beneficial that I'll remember. Often tried to trick students to catch if they used AI without understanding that this is an MSU requirement. Graded by quizzes, attendance, in-class assignments, two exams.

This was the most unorganized and poorly run class I have taken in a long time. Professor Smith constantly cancels class putting us far behind and she rambles about nothing for 2 hours during class time, not getting to the material pertaining to the exams. I consistently left class more confused than when I went in. Find a different professor.

The worst class I have ever taken at MSU, so take at your own risk. She doesn't know what she's teaching because she's changed how she's formatted the course multiple times throughout the semester. She's cancelled more classes than not and always with only a 10 minute max heads up. The assignments are never explained and the ULAs dont answer emails

Bro, she keeps changing the class format she always tries to throw in stuff to catch ChatGPT but people use it cause she can't teach properly, she overdoes the work we need to do, she changes the attendance taking every single week, she always cancels class last minute, i think i had less classes than i went. Material just gets harder
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She has change the way the class format has been ran so so many times. she's canceled more classes than we've actually had. she gives assignments with no directions. when you email any of the teaching team they just don't respond or don't know what's going on either. She's changed attendance many times and the semester is over in two weeks.

It takes her days to respond to emails, a quiz every week, and Pack back every week, and if you miss one, that's ten points you lose. Grading is very strict, she always makes mistakes on her quizzes, and one of her ULAs took 29 days to respond to my email. Very dissapointed

This class has been extremely frustrating for the entire semester. Classes get canceled very often, many times have been less than an hour before the class start time. Lectures are very long and hard to focus on the amount of content. Way too many at-home movie days with worksheets that contain tons of questions that you do not benefit from.

Nonsense is a word would use to describe this class. She's nice enough where outside of teaching I would have no problem. Cancels class quite a bit, but makes up for it in never ending lectures. Things often don't make sense because the format is always changing. I find my self often confused with little to no answers even if I ask. Easy though.

Tbh yes she cancels class all the time and up until today we didn't have in-person class since 5ish weeks ago. But it's so easy. Same assignments every week. If you want an easy A take her. Still don't know what the class is even about honestly but it's a breeze. Nice enough but rambles about irrelevant topics

Super caring, lectures are really interesting. Exams are online and use questions from open-note quizzes given throughout the semester. Sometimes has in class assignments. You'll be fine as long as you go to class and do your homework.

The lectures are somewhat relevant, but most of the quizzes are just based on the book we have to read outside of class. All of the quizzes were open book and online. All exams were online on d2l. She doesn't take attendance, but there's lots of in-class assignments worth points. It's not a heavy load of work, and she does have a sense of humor.

As long as you do the work, and put in some effort you'll get a passing grade. It is super easy to get a 4.0 if you try on everything. She sometimes is late or cancels class last minute, but I really like the vibe she brings to class.
I really enjoyed her writing tier 2 class.

I enjoyed this professor. Even though she sometimes got off topic of the unit it was interesting and funny. Very easy class to pass and only two exams which are also easy. She is organized, all you do every week is one packback and one quiz (which is also easy). Often you have in class assignments so attending class is mandatory but they are easy.
She is ALWAYS late and doesn't end on time. If she cancels class she does it with very little notice. Easy class to pass but she annoys the class so much.

This is my second time taking a class with Professor Smith. The first time, she had an accident and the class was moved online. It was super disorganized, but I figured it was just because of the unexpected accident. In person, the course is just as disorganized. Lectures are unrelated to content. Spends way too much time on irrelevant intro.

Stacy would talk about the most random things during class. If you are looking for an easy class with a nice professor GO FOR THIS ONE! I felt like the work for this class was not hard at all the professor was just talking about random things most of the time. My class had online exams that you did not have to be in person for as well.

This class was very straightforward and easy to pass. However, the instructor was highly disorganized. She was late to nearly every class, her lectures were irrelevant, and she was nearly impossible to communicate with. If you can just tune her out and do all the work, it's a very easy class. I'd recommend finding another instructor if possible.

The class itself is an easy A. The weekly online quizzes are easy and open-book and exams were all online and not on lockdown so you could use your notes. Her lectures were super long, boring, normally off-topic and didn't relate to what we were supposed to be learning about. She was also late to class almost every day and very unorganized.

AVOID THIS PROFESSOR AT ALL COSTS! She's always late to class. Lectures have NOTHING to do with content about 70% of the time and its obvious she puts her slides together last minute. She kept a "class cancelled" sign up too long and punished the students that didn't show up for class even though her syllabus explicitly states she won't do that.

Honestly one of the pettiest professors I have ever had. Gave the whole class extra credit for showing up when there was a sign saying the class was cancelled. Made comments about the shooting during our first class period. If you are taking her be careful on what days you skip, there will be in class assignments randomly throughout the semester.

This course was so disorganized. The professor had many personal issues this semester, but this doesn't excuse how inadequate she was at running the course. Consistently showed up late or not at all and her excuse was that she just forgot. In class assignments every class period that were unrelated and often thought of on the spot.

I had her for this class and ISS 210 this semester and it was one of the worst teaching experiences I have ever had. She was consistently late or absent from both classes. On multiple occasions she simply forgot what times her classes started. On another occasion she cancelled class 20 minutes before it started. Ridiculously unorganized as well.

She was late to class almost ever single day by like 10 to 20 minutes and expect us to just sit there and wait for her. The lectures she teaches during the class has nothing to do with what are on the quizzes which comes from the book. Every class you have to do an in class assignment some take 5 minutes some are watch a 2 hour movies and write.

Most ridiculously unorganized class ever. Wont upload our quizzes due that night tell days later. Always late. Starts almost every class with "so I messed up".  Every time you email her with an issue she either wont respond or tell you to go to some other party about it.  Also took her months to grade our three question assignment.

This was the most unorganized class I have ever taken. Due dates changed all of the time, would randomly drop graded assignments after completion so you would get no credit, schedule was extremely hard to follow with constant changes. Was supposed to just be an elective and became my most challenging course. Stay away!

I was never able to reach the professor outside of class, even though I sent multiple emails. The PackBack assignments due every week were tedious and your entire grade is based on them and the exams.

Professor Smith was fantastic! She was very insightful and taught the class very well and from various viewpoints. The class was well organized but sometimes it got confusing when doing the PackBacks each week. You are only graded on PackBacks and the midterm and final which were both very easy. Do the reading, take notes, and you'll be good.
easy class better professor

Exam questions are pretty much directly from the textbook. As an online class, it was very very easy. Good if you want to do sociology, probably. Kind of disorganized -- just make sure you join a GroupMe and you'll be fine.

I felt that their lessons weren't organized. We'd have to write a discussion post about the book and lecture, but sometimes the lecture wouldn't be posted until late in the week. With this class being all asynchronous, I felt it was too jumbled and sometimes she and the TA were hard to reach when helped was needed.

This class was very easy. The only thing that I didn't like was that the discussion post topics were hidden within her lectures, meaning you had to watch them in order to do the assignment. The answers to the exams and quizzes came straight from the textbook, and the grading criteria on the discussion posts are very fair and lenient.

I am currently taking this in spring 2021, so it is all online. She is very unorganized with uploading. I never know when things are due. She also posts the required content that goes over the quiz late, so it is hard to know what to go over.
Very strict grader and doesnt answer emails about grading issues.

The professor is great and very accommodating. The class is very participation based and is much more philosophical than the impression I got from the class description. We talk a LOT about art made during covid and how it makes us feel, but not so much about what covid did to us. Just something to keep in mind! Easy A if you're not scared to talk.
