reviews.comment: One of if not my favorite classes and professor ever. This class (IAH 206, not english!) will stick with me for a long time and I'm so happy to have been able to take it. Dr Cho is so understanding and accommodating to her students. A truly wonderful person!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Amazing class! The professor cares so much about all the students. She is very inclusive and kind. Although the lectures are mandatory I always enjoyed going. Professor is very upfront about the amount of work. The workload is not at all heavy and there is rarely every homework. Overall the class is very easy and enjoyable.
A very simple course with very lenient requirements.

Was actually course IAH206 
Dr. Cho is extremely accommodating to all of her students and is very passionate about her topics. You can tell she really loves teaching about the topic and gets very excited. Most of the course is discussion based and only a few small projects towards the end.

Had her for IAH206 on disability culture in film, very engaging and never boring. She values everyone's opinions, creates a safe space, and encourages participation. Attendance is tracked with iClicker. There are two big group projects and a solo case study, all fun and manageable. She's super helpful and accommodating.

I had her for IAH 206 but it wasn't an option on here, I loved this prof! She's very kind and clearly cares about the wellbeing of her students and cares a lot about the material she teaches which keeps the class engaging. For projects she was very open to students interpretations of subject matters and understanding everyones opinions/backgrounds
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: this is for IAH207 and she is AMAZING!!! so kind and caring, and creates a friend like environment with the whole class. no homework, no exams, a few projects that are easy and fun. I cannot recommend this class and professor enough.

For Dr. Cho's first year teaching she NAILED IT. I got put into her IAH class due to an issue with scheduling, but it was well worth it. Her class delved into disability culture and it was all opinion based with in class participation making up 80% of the grade. She valued everyone's thoughts on the subject and was eager to share her passion.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Loved Soo and this class! Very engaging, I learned a lot and she's just a super nice person overall. Also has good amount of reading which I really enjoyed. Would definitely take again!

I highly recommend Professor Cho. Her class was engaging and interesting. She was accommodating and gave students the opportunity to grow and improve their skills and knowledge of digital humanities. Our class was tight-knit and I looked forward to it every week! Take Professor Cho!
Schrock is an absolute pleasure. His class is fun and engaging. It can be difficult at times though.

I would take MKT383 again with Dr. Schrock. He is very engaging with everyone and actually wants to get to know about you. He is one of the only professors I have had where I feel like there is mutual respect for each other. He is very upfront about what he expects from you and what you should expect from him. By far the best professor I have had.

Shrock is easily the best professor I've had at Michigan State. He does an excellent job connecting with students and making them feel respected. He has extensive knowledge and experience in the sales industry. If you have the opportunity to learn from him, I highly recommend taking it.

Dr Schrock was the best professor I have had at MSU. He extremely knowledgeable in the subjects of sales and sales management and teaches the material very well. Exams are fair and the class should be a 4.0 with moderate out of class effort. He cares about his students and is more than willing to help students in any way he can.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Writing this review about 4 years after graduating and have to say to this day Professor Schrock is still a Legend. He is kind, respectful, and truly cares about your mental and physical well-being. One thing about Professor Schrock that I admire about him is that he will go out of his way to help you reach your goals. Take his classes if you can!

Easily the best professor I've ever had. His teaching style is engaging which makes the content much more interesting. He memorizes the names of every student, and you can tell that he truly cares about each one of them. The most passionate, dedicated and caring teacher I've ever been around; it was a pleasure taking his class for a semester.
Wyatt is one of the best professors I have ever had. He makes coming to class fun and engaging. I have nothing but great things to say about him.

I wish I didn't take Schrock while classes were online. He makes lectures interesting and fun, he is young and inspiring. I learned so much about sales management and used skills I learned in class during interviews. He gives great life lessons, too. I took that after someone recommended him to me, and highly recommend to anyone else.

dr. mac is AWESOME! ibio328 is SO HARD (especially the lab, lots of memorizing and difficult dissections) but i learned so much incredible knowledge that i WILL utilize in my future as a zoo major. love her teaching style in lecture, lots of great notes and slides!

She's really nice, and very helpful. If you are interested in Zoology or FW however, I wouldn't recommend IBIO200/Animal Biodiversity unless you are looking for a class that will tell you more about your future education. 60% of what we did in class had nothing to do with learning about Animal Biodiversity.

The professor was nice, but the class itself was terrible. I don't understand why the lab is a requirement on top of the lecture. The lab is stupid and so much memorizing of terms for the exams. Avoid taking this class, but sadly for me it was a requirement which was also a joke because never in my career will I utilize anything I learned.
Dr Mac is fantastic. She is understanding and caring. As long as you participate and turn in your assignments, the class is a breeze.

I just want to make it clear that IBIO365 is not intended to be an easy class. You will have to do a lot of studying and majority of it is memorization. But there are a lot of resources to study from. Teresa is an excellent professor and cares for her students. I had a great time in this class and I got a lot from it.

Genetics was a horrible experience. She never responded to my emails and she didn't even teach her own material, in fact, she didn't teach at all. I also want to say the reason I'm submitting this review now is because the one I submitted prior was deleted. Looks like all her bad reviews were, go figure. Take with another professor if possible.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She's by far one of the best professors I've had. Makes helpful commentary as opposed to reading off the slides.  Lab is difficult, but there are plenty of ways to do well, you just have to take the time to study and memorize. Do not procrastinate if you want to succeed. Prof McElhinny creates a welcoming environment for students & is approachable!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: This is the worst class I have ever taken. It is only grades on quizzes and exams. It is such a difficult course because there is a lot to it, such as memorization. They expect way too much from you, and expect you to be very knowledgable regarding anatomy. You have to dissect a lamprey, shark, bullfrog, and a CAT. It is horrible and miserable

Professor McElhinny gives great study guides with exactly what you need to know for the exam on them. The lab is a lot of memorization, but you can get a lot of extra credit here which is really important in the end. She records lectures and posts them on D2L and attendance is not required for lecture. It does take a bit for them to grade stuff tho
Really sweet lady but the class itself is very difficult. The lab is really cool but also very difficult.

Dr. Mac was wonderful! She was clear about what we had to do and was always there for assistance. Her class wan't overbearing or over-explained. It was very interesting material and I am sad the class is over. It was a lot of group work, but it wasn't bad at all. My group was great.

Dr. Mac is an excellent instructor. Her class is fairly easy, but also pretty interesting. She genuinely cares about student success and is actually passionate about what she teaches, which makes it more engaging to learn.
Dr. Mac is awesome!! This class is very easy and does not have very many assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Mac is a very knowledgeable, respectable professor. I absolutely loved taking IBIO 200 with her and hope to have her as a professor again in the future.

Dr. Mcelhinny is one of the most caring professors at MSU. Not only are her lectures super helpful, but she genuinely cares about her students and makes sure they are successful. I recommend her for genetics!

I would 100% recommend anyone to take Dr. McElhinny for genetics. She is very understanding and TRULY cares about how her students do in the class. She is accessible outside of class and always stays after class to answer peoples questions. Genetics as a subject was difficult for me, but she made me want to come to lectures due to her positivity.
I loved this class and her teaching style. You do have to be prepared before lecture though, as her lectures are more discussion based. Not much homework and pretty much everything is group based.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Her lectures are thorough and she makes she people are engaged by having them chime in through the chat to answer questions or ask questions. Shes spends a solid amount of time on each slide and makes sure everyone understands the content before moving on

You don't have to read the book before class but it does help. Her lectures are very thorough and though she may seem direct, she's very knowledgeable and helpful. She specializes in teaching and it shows. Recitations are helpful, do the homework, go to class, and do lots of practice.

Took this class online after the pandemic. Instructors were uncommunicative, unhelpful, and even used YouTube videos as supplemental lectures. Exams were much harder than any homework given and there were no curves, unproductive office hours, and the instructors would often miss individuals appointments made with students. AVOID!!!

Really great teacher. Know basic bio concepts and she will help you learn the rest. Go to recitation (and lecture for clicker points). She can be direct but is always very willing to help. Do all the assignments and go to class and it should be ok.

The biggest turn-off about this class is the workload. Sapling homework, class prep assignments, and recitation pre-class problems. Yes, that's 3 different homework assignments (per week, sometimes). And, clicker questions throughout every lecture. Also, the exams are hard. Dr. Mac's teaching was fine, but the workload was just too dang high.
Mr. Mac made my life so much better after BS 161. I thought everything was going to be awful after I had Dr. Koslowsky for 161, but Dr. Mac and Dr. Roberts were fantastic

Homework due online 3 times a week (some have 50+ questions). She expects you to have the entire chapter read before lecture, you have a clicker quiz on it at the start of class, and then questions throughout the lecture so it's not like you can just leave after the quiz. Her lectures are so hard to pay attention to. Would not recommend at all.

Lots of clicker questions each class. BS 161/171 are the best classes to prepare you for this class. Printing key figures for lecture is helpful but not necessary. Always go to recitation. Give yourself PLENTY of study time before exams (i.e. days in advance). Exams are LONG and you MUST give yourself time to do the short answer ones.

It's pretty sad that her GTA at the time was a better professor than her. You have a quiz at the beginning of every lecture and probably at least 15 clicker questions for participation points during the lecture so she ends up rushing through the lecture. None of the lectures are online and the tests are way harder than what you actually learn.

Extremely sweet professor and cares about all students who step into her classroom. She provides structured, thought-out feedback and provides interactive lectures that teaches you lessons about everyday life. As an "unmotivated" student, I'd always look forwards to class. If I could retake any class at MSU, it 100% would be this one.

Her lectures are really fun and easy to relate with in real life scenarios and she also addresses present day issues. Grading isn't too strict but will give useful comments to improve on, a lot of group work. If she sees potential, she helps give resources and references how to succeed and do more outside of class. Took the class for fun, worth it!
Really nice to talk to, helps students a lot and if you have issues with grades she loves helping students with where they can earn more points. Also very funny and lectures are fun and interactive

Dr Taylor is very passionate about her class, and she's very caring of all her students. Some of the assignments are a little annoying but she tries to make them fun. She's one of the sweetest people ever, and I would recommend going to her office hours. The only 2 big gradings in the class is the midterm (notecard allowed) and group project.
Sweetest professor ever.

She is very kind and caring and actually cares about her students. Attendance is strict and lectures can be boring but she jumps around a lot which makes it engaging. I wasn't a fan of the topic but she quickly made it my favorite course. Do the in class activities and as long as your group for the final is decent it's easy.

Dr. Taylor is a kind and caring professor. She would always say in class "this is not a building block course and we are going to be jumping around" which is 100% true. There usually always an in-class assignment so make sure to pay attention to the lectures.

Professor Taylor was an average professor. She had some boring lectures/ annoying homework assignments, but was fair in her grading. Group project/ midterm exam make up the bulk of the grade. Final group project was annoying to complete.

She is so nice. I have a 98% in this class its very easy. Just do the work and you're good. She offers extra credit and grades work super fast. I emailed her about an issue and she responded within minutes and fixed the issue. I love her, she's so sweet I'd do anything for her. Please take this class and show her love.

Literally one of the kindest professors I've ever had. Always receiving and listening to feedback, knows all her students and you can tell she loves her job. Weekly homework but it's never difficult and no exam, just a group presentation.

Dr. Taylor is just an alright professor. She explains things very clearly but she can sometimes talk to you like a baby, and other times talk too fast. The homework is pretty easy as long as you pay attention, and the midterm exam wasn't the worst. A lot of guest speakers and their content will be on the exam. No readings though which is good.

She is such a sweet teacher; you can tell she loves her job and teaching this subject. I really like her classes and hearing her talk. She takes your answers from the homework and incorporates them into the next lecture. She's very open to feedback and will adjust her class and teaching format to keep her students happy. I enjoy her class.

Dr. Taylor is my pride and joy. Had her for 202 and 208L, amazing experience in both would take a million times over. So kind, helpful, understanding, funny, smart, everything you want in a professor. learn to use excel beforehand and the class is much easier. If you have the chance to take her, do it! Praise Dr. Taylor, she deserves the world.

Although she overcomplicates the class a bit and is very nit-picky eith grading, she is incredibly nice and understanding. I didn't mind the group work, but having to show up every day or getting a 0 for the in class activities kinda suck. One midterm with cheat sheets, weekly homework and a final presentation/paper. Interesting class

Dr. Taylor is the best professor I've ever had. She truly cares about her students and will help you with anything you need. There's a regular amount of work but it's not too difficult just can be time consuming. Just show up to class and participate.
It is unbelievable how hard she tries to make this class way harder than it needs to be.

The class was setup in groups and almost everything is done with your group. The final is a semester long project which you present and work on in groups it's a good chunk of the grade. There is a textbook but she provides it. There's only one test and it's the midterm which if you don't do well can drop your grade a decent amount.

I so grateful for how this course is set up. you never feel like your wastin your time bc the lectures, readings, hw, quizzes, exam are all related and you feel prepared. she also offers a cheatsheet and it counts towards your hw grade which is a free grade !
Dr. Taylor is an incredibly supportive professor. She provides valuable insights during group projects, ensuring that we meet all the requirements and achieve the grades we desire.

Dr. Taylor makes every class activity feel engaging and exciting. Whether it's a workshop or lecture, she always incorporates interactive elements that keep us engaged while making the learning experience enjoyable and productive.

I really appreciate how Dr. Taylor encourages us during group projects. She's always available for questions, offers constructive feedback, and ensures we stay on track to meet the expectations for the project.

Working on group projects with Dr. Taylor is such a positive experience. She encourages collaboration and offers helpful suggestions to ensure we all contribute and meet the project's goals. Her support makes a huge difference in the outcome.

Dr. Taylor is incredibly supportive during group projects. She goes above and beyond to ensure that we meet the expectations and achieve the grades we want through her constructive feedback. Her guidance helps us stay on track, and she's always available to help when needed.

I really appreciate how Professor Taylor creates a positive learning environment. She always encourages her students to ask questions and gives thoughtful feedback that helps us grow and do well in her course
I love how organized and well-prepared Professor Taylor is for each class. She makes every topic easy to follow and provides helpful examples from real life that deepen my understanding.
I'm so grateful to have had Professor Taylor as an instructor. She is insightful, approachable, and truly cares about her students' growth and success. I always feel supported in her class.

She is a knowledgeable and approachable professor who creates a welcoming environment for all students. Professor taylor provides clear explanations and is always happy to offer assistance when needed during her office hours or after class

Professor taylor is one of the best professors I've had. She genuinely cares about her students' success and goes out of her way to make sure we understand the material by offering workshops and in class activities. Her feedback is always helpful and encouraging.

I have learned so much in Professor Taylor's class. She is patient, approachable, and has an amazing ability to break down difficult material. Her passion for teaching really shines through because of how well organized and constructed the course is. You can tell so much work is put into it to ensure her student's success

Professor taylor is a fantastic instructor who makes every class engaging and enjoyable. She explains complex topics in a way that is easy to understand, and she's always there to help when you need it.

Professor taylor consistently goes above and beyond to create an engaging and informative learning experience. Their enthusiasm for the subject is contagious, and their clear explanations help students feel successful and confident in their work.

professor taylor is both knowledgeable and approachable, making it easy to engage with the content. They offer constructive feedback and make sure every student has the support they need. I feel more confident in my academic abilities after taking this class.

I feel incredibly fortunate to have had Professor taylor as an instructor. They create a classroom atmosphere that encourages collaboration and critical thinking. They always make time for students and offer valuable insights into the material as well as clear up any confusion on any topic.

Professor taylor is an excellent communicator who truly knows how to make learning enjoyable. Their passion for the subject and dedication to students shines through in every lesson. I've gained confidence and a deeper appreciation for the topic.

I am so grateful for Professor taylor's teaching. They are approachable, patient, and always willing to help. I have gained a deeper understanding of the subject thanks to their clear and effective teaching methods.

Professor taylor brings enthusiasm and energy to every lecture. They explain complicated topics in a way that is both clear and engaging. I look forward to their class each week as well as the interesting in class activities that we do

What stands out about Professor Taylor is their genuine care for their students' success. They go above and beyond to ensure we grasp the material and are always willing to answer questions. I feel encouraged and supported throughout the course which i rarely find that with other professors.

Dr. Taylor is one of the best professors I've had!!! She has an incredible ability to make the subject interesting and accessible. I've learned so much from their clear explanations and thoughtful feedback. She puts so much work and effort into her course and honestly, you can see that being reflected in the course!

Dr. Taylor presents material in an organized and approachable way, and they are always available to offer guidance. I feel motivated and confident in my learning because of their teaching style and support

since we have a final project as our final, she is very understanding and supportive if we had group members who are not contributing or delaying the group's progress, and instead, grades your individual work and is very fair.

Dr. Taylor an outstanding instructor who always creates an engaging and supportive learning environment. Their passion for the subject is infectious, making complex concepts easier to understand. I truly appreciate their dedication to helping students succeed.

The irritating thing about this class was how you had to attend 5 events from the program that she was involved in which had no relation to the class.

So condescending. So passive-aggressive. Lectures are insufferable, she drags out every concept unnecessarily. Course work is fairly easy but there is just so much for this type of class. Requires a lot of out of class participation for films. Asked her a question about how she prefers I turn in an assignment and she was so difficult to talk to.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: She is one of the best professors I have had at MSU. She is really kind and understanding of everything. There are some events you have to attend on the weekend but other than that and the reading she assigns her class is really easy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Dr. Weiss is a very kind professor, she isn't strict about grading or attendance. I would recommend showing up to class often though as it can be easy to get lost in some of the content she teaches. She does post everything on D2L though so if you miss a class you have access to everything you missed. Sometimes she doesn't explain things well.
Dr. Weiss was really kind and accommodating when it came to getting assignments in. She really cared about our comprehension of the topics presented. Great professor and an enjoyable class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She made it clear in the beginning that the she wanted her relationships with students to be more peer based rather than professor/student, which made it easy to reach out. She was the sweetest, but also knew when she was being taken advantage of. Most I had to write in this class was 150 words, and a simple group presentation at the the end.

I had Dr. Weiss for IAH 210, I highly recommend taking the class with her because she is such an amazing teacher and is very passionate about the class. The class content is not super heavy and the work load is very manageable. I loved taking her class so much, I am taking a second level IAH with her next sem.
She is the best professor i have seen. She lets you have your our opinions  and  nurtures them. Her classes are very interactive and she is very good in grading as long as you show good effort.
kind, fast talker, encourages questions and gives good answers.

She is a very kind a helpful person. She gives a ton of extra credit and is very willing to help in office hours or through email. The midterm and final were hard, but you do get a cheat sheet, so it's not that bad. Overall, I really liked her and would take the class again.

Although CEM 252 is rough and can be hard taking this class with Dr.Vasileiou is a must she is so nice and understanding. I had ran out of tries on my aktiv homework she would reset them for me and my friends and she really cares that her students are learning. She gave us a 1pg cheat sheet for the midterm and 2pgs front and back for the Final.

It is clear that this professor cares deeply about this content, while also understanding that for most people, this class is a necessary stepping stone toward other classes. I really appreciated her enthusiasm, and it helped me get through the class. Also, for exams, you get a cheat sheet.

I took this course in-person. Seems to be much tougher when taken in person vs online. Does offer a ton of extra credit though. Attendance is not mandatory. Very little homework.

Would recommend her as a professor, but take online if at all possible.

She was an solid professor. She taught fairly well, but her Greek accent sometimes was hard to understand, but it wasn't too thick. Naturally, since this is orgo 2, it wasn't really easy, but that'd apply to any professor. Only major complaint was that the midterm (and probably final) were very difficult and had poor averages.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: As a professor, she is good, not bad, but not great either. Lots of extra credit makes it easy, but you can learn the topics much more quickly by just attending recitation. Many times, I found that teaching myself while doing the homework was much more efficient, and the lectures were useless besides earning extra credit points.

I took the online version of Orgo 2 (I think they are getting rid of it though). Had sooo much extra credit. Responded to emails within minutes. Was always willing to stop lecture to answer questions. Great professor.
She was a great professor, this is a very hard class though. Don't let yourself fall behind at all, or you are cooked. You need to remeber stuff from cem 251

Dr. Vasileiou is a AMAZING professor for orgo II. Lectures were twice a week, and attendance was rewarded with extra credit, which she also gave ALOT of through quizzes, homework, exams, etc. Her lectures were super easy to understand, and she was always willing to answer questions throughout the lecture or through email. Best professor for orgo!!!
So so sweet and understanding. TAKE HER FOR ORGO.

Online organic chemistry 2 with Vasileiou was significantly easier than organic chemistry 1. She is a great teacher who is always willing to answer questions during lecture, with quizzes and exams that match up well with what was taught in class. She offers a lot of extra credit, through TopHat questions during lecture and other opportunities.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Vasileiou was a great professor, I was worried about the class since I took it online, but despite the content being hard, it was taught well. There is tons of extra credit in the class so it made a high grade easy to achieve. Professor Vasileiou was super easy to reach and very accommodating if I needed to switch a quiz to another day
Made it so easy but recitations are necessary if you don't understand, lots of time that content specifically came up on quizzes
Lots of extra credit provided, so make sure to get as much as you can. Everything is online and she provides help for any homework in her office hours

TAKE THIS CLASS ONLINE WITH HER!!!!! Seriously one of the easier classes I've ever taken, extra credit for just going to the lectures online and answering the tophat questions. Weekly quizzes and 2 exams with no lockdown browser. Basically gives out extra credit for breathing. Super sweet lady and explains and teaches orgo extremely well.

Love this woman, she makes this class incredibly easy to do well. 10% extra credit, lecture is optional, recitation is optional. Only downside is it is a late zoom lecture from 6-7:20pm but she records the lecture. Exams and quizzes are very fair and based off the homework, and all exams + quizzes are online no lockdown browser.

I was nervous to take organic chemistry over the summer but Dr. Vasileiou was an amazing professor. She understood we had lives outside of lecture and often recorded it and gave extra credit to those who watch the live lectures. She was very clear in teaching and broke everything well. If I have a chemistry class I would take it if she taught it.

Organic chemistry is a difficult subject to understand, but Dr. Vasileiou makes the topic easy to understand. She offers so much extra credit so make sure to use those opportunities. Although this is a virtual course, she is EASILY accessible: easy to meet for office hours or test/quiz accommodations. Online homework is a bit tricky so ask for help

Words cant explain how grateful I am to be able to have had Dr.Vasileiou as my orgo professor. If you want to 4.0 this class, YOU CAN! She makes it easy as long as you put in the work and are willing to learn. You don't have to break your back or be a try hard. she gives lots of extra credit and should I say makes enjoying chemistry possible?

I did most of my learning from the textbook, but it goes way more in depth than what is required. Lectures are optional but have tons of extra credit as clickers. There's a good amount of other extra credit too. She is very nice and will give extensions on the quizzes if you need. Accessibility is limited but expected for a class this large.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: Great teacher for ORGO . Gives many opportunities to do well in the class.  10/10

She is an amazing woman and is always available to help you out. She is quite knowledgeable and makes 252 so easy to understand. She also offers lots of extra credit, and is flexible when you have to miss a quiz. I would advise to do the cengage homework early so you aren't cramming at the last minute. Super chill.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I truly love this woman and I only wish her the best. The class is hard, but she makes it easy for her students and she truly cares about everyone. Homework is hard and most of it is not like what we do in class. She offers lots of extra credit and she cares a lot for her students. Quizzes are MCQ, exams are MCQ and short answer

Dr. V is amazing and clearly cares about the success of her students. The amount of extra credit she offers is insane, and assures students' success in the course. Homework is hard but extra credit accounts for that. Quizzes and exams are easy and also have extra credit in them. If you see her as an option for orgs II definitely choose her.

Class overall seems fine but the homework is infuriating and goes against her reasoning for it helping you learn. You get five attempts per question but the question changes with each attempt and it doesn't actually explain what you did wrong or show the correct answer making is useless and irritating. At least tests are multi choice.

Her teaching style makes topics clear and easy to understand which helps you succeed on exams/quizzes. She's very kind and gives tons of extra credit opportunities. The homework can be annoying but it is really helpful. Easy to get a good grade and to actually understand orgo.

She is fine if you want to take this class and then never think about it again, the only way you will really learn in her class is by teaching it to yourself. she doesn't really teach anything apart from reading the slides. the only way to do decent in this class is by doing the extra credit which you have to pay for. DONT take if you wish to learn

Please take her class for orgo!! She is such an amazing professor. She really wants her students to succeed and offers so much extra credit it is literally impossible to fail the class. People saying its her fault that the averages were so low but organic chemistry is an extremely hard course that I thought she taught very well. Would recommend.
best orgo professor

Dr. Vasileiou was quite literally the best teacher I have ever had for any chemistry class i've ever taken. Not only does she give lots of extra credit but explains the material perfectly. Her tests are exactly what the lecture is on and aren't too difficult. I think it would be impossible to fail this class.

Lots of extra credit offered in this class. Quizzes/ exams are very clear with what will be on them. Personally, I thought the bookwork problems were sometimes more challenging than the tests. Attendance to lecture helps grade with in class EC everyday! She walks through the practice questions which I found really helpful.

If you need an easy orgo class Dr. Vasileiou is your best bet. I do think, quality wise, she is good, but with how stale the lectures are and how easy she makes earning extra credit, actual learning is difficult. I do not recommend if you will actually need orgo in the future unless you can concentrate super well.

This professor was the fairest professor I have ever had for a chemistry class. She gave so much extra credit that if you do it all it is IMPOSSIBLE to get anything less than a B. She gave amazing practice problems for each lecture that were nearly identical to the quizzes. The midterm was a bit tough but very doable. I recommend taking orgo w/ her

She seems like a nice lady, and you will get a good grade in this class if you apply yourself. My problem is that the class is too easy and I didnt learn anything. As a premed student thats a problem. I had her class online synchronized, her zoom lectures are awful. Camera off, cant ask questions just chat, made it difficult to engage.

Great Orgo prof. Class is not overly hard. Dr. V's office hours are very good, you learn a lot when you ask her questions. By far one of my favorite profs I've had so far. I also retained a lot of what was taught in her class.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: She was great and made it super easy to do well in the class. Everything was organized and there were no surprises when it came to quizzes and exams. Tons of extra credit to boost your grade if you need it. The homework can be a pain at times (but the TA's at office hours are extremely helpful). Super nice and accommodating if you have to email.

Loved this class. She goes slow with the content so you actually understand. Makes orgo easy and fun to learn! Her tests are not crazy hard and are simple. Definitely attend lectures and take notes tho because due to her strong accent its hard to rewatch and properly make sense of what is being said. However, she is amazing and accommodating !
She is really nice. Since it's Orgo, make sure you attend her lecture and ask if you have any confusion. The extra credits will save your life but try to score well on quizzes and exams
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Without her generous amount of extra credit I probably would have had a 3.0, but ended with a 4.0. She has moves very quick but gives direct lectures that are easy to take notes off of.

Such an amazing professor. She makes a weed out class like orgo into an easy a. So much extra credit is offered on all quizzes and exams. Focus during her lectures and it will be easy to pass. Activities even replace the lowest quiz grades. Do the practice sets she offers before each quiz, and you will be fine. Also answers emails very quickly.

She wants her students to pass, and she offers a lot of extra credit opportunities. She is understanding of health issues and let me take a quiz at a later date when I was too sick to take it on time. Textbook is required to purchase, but I never used it. As long as you attend all lectures and do the homework you will easily pass.

She is a very nice professor, she explains things thoroughly although can be a bit confusing at times. Orgo is going to be a hard class in general but I found keeping up with her pace and organization a bit difficult.

This professor makes the class so easy to understand. Some of the hardest topics of organic chem are made easy because of her teaching style. She is very fair with grading and her quizzes and exams are super easy and straightforward. She gives so much extra credit is almost impossible to fail or even end with a C for that matter. Her class is great
I absolutely adored Professor Vasileiou! She explains organic chemistry in an open way that makes it easier to understand. Definitely one of my favorite professors so far!!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Professor Vasileiou made organic chemistry manageable and enjoyable. I took her for the summer class which is accelerated, so be ware that it is fast paced. She is superb in her abilities to explain concepts and gives out practice problems that replicate her exams. Attending class is extra credit and it is super manageable to 4.0

It's orgo, it's going to be hard. Being online made it slightly easier to access notes, but there is lots of studying! All lectures were posted, so most attendance weren't mandatory except for quiz periods, but extra credit was offered DURING class. She's slightly hard to understand but she knows her stuff. Plenty of points in the class!

Good class. I was challenged but I learned a lot. She offered a lot of alternative assignments to continue our understanding yet have the chance to earn extra credit. Going into this class I thought I was going to hate it but now I actually enjoy organic chemistry

Dr. Vasileiou made Orgo 1 more than possible to 4.0, let alone pass. Her lectures are very clear and to the point -- take notes on what she taught, stay on top of homework, and do practice problems -- you will be just fine. She offers lots of extra credit which is helpful considering the difficult content. I highly recommend her as a professor!

Dr V was amazing for orgo 1. Her extra credit made the class very forgiving if you did bad on the quizzes. If you take notes based on the lectures the quizzes will be super easy for you. Def take this prof

Overall a cool prof, hard class material but nothing much you can do about it. Allows honors option, answers emails fairly quickly. Quizzes and tests are kinda hard but she doesn't try to trick you, answers every question during lecture, lots of opportunities for extra points.

She is an amazing professor. She has very clear grading criteria, and offers a lot of extra credit points. Many people complain about organic chemistry being a difficult subject, however she breaks it down so nicely. Her exams and quizzes are like her notes, and she is very flexible with grading and due dates! She wants to see students succeed!

I loved her. She cared so much if people understood what was going on in lecture and answered about every question people asked which was almost a little too much because at some points I wished we would have already moved on. Each quiz and exam has extra credit on it. Responds to emails very timely. Wish she was teaching orgo 2 in the spring!
Great professor. Lectures are very easy to follow and understand and she gives a TON of extra credit so it's very hard not to get an A.

She gives the best lectures and makes sure that you understand the concepts. All her lectures are on chalkboard so she does not post her lectures online. She provides ample practice problems which are really helpful. DO NOT FALL BEHIND, otherwise it will be very difficult to catch up. make sure to do the practice problems and mechanism practice.
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: if you don't get an A in this class you should probably reconsider your major.

AMAZING teacher and the class is not too difficult given the topic is orgo which in itself is hard. Gives lots of extra credit, and explains topics very well. Definitely the best in the organic chemistry department at MSU. Do whatever you can to get in to her class vs others!!

Dr. Vasileiou is an AMAZING orgo prof. She is very clear on what she expects on all of her exams and 'pop quizzes.' They say the quizzes are random, but she will give you a heads up about them and tell you exactly what will be on there. As long as you attend the lecture and take thorough notes, there is no reason to not 4.0.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Everything on here is absolutely correct. Dr. Vasileiou is an amazing teacher and a LIFESAVER when it comes to orgo. Don't take anyone else. Extremely nice, everyone in the class LOVES her. Takes really difficult material and breaks it down methodically. Whatever they're paying her, it isn't enough!
Amazing professor who knows what she's talking about. She makes orgo understandable. Prepares you really well for every quiz and exam. Also gives you many opportunities for success and extra credit.

Organic chemistry sucks, but taking it with this professor made it better. Her accent makes it a little difficult to understand her at times, but you can expect exactly what the exam is going to be like and she is very clear with her notes

She writes all notes on the chalk board which i liked. Exams are all written with maybe 4 multiple choice questions. 3 exams and a final and 5 quizzes. one quiz and one exam gets dropped. Would recommend doing the honors option, a 10-15pg paper on a drug or a concept, really pretty simple. She's super nice and really chill.

Dr. Vasileiou is the best for orgo at MSU. She genuinely cares about her students and wants to see you succeed in her class. There is a lot of material and it's a tough class but she is very straightforward about what will be on exams and quizzes. Highly recommend going to recitation, it's really helpful! Extra points on every exam and quiz too.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: Nothing from lecture gets posted online so if you dont go you wont pass. Class is fairly easy considering the challenging topics
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She writes lectures on the chalkboard so you need to go to class. Recitations were helpful too. An 85% is a 4.0 so it is do-able. She puts extra points on quizzes and exams. Graded by 4 quizzes, 2 exams, and a final. If you study and go to recitation it's not impossible. The workload is low since there's no homework, just studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: She makes the exams fair and gives students every opportunity to do well in the course, she knows the material extremely well and is very good at relaying this knowledge to her students.

This lady completely sold me on organic chemistry. The exams are reasonable, and the lectures are interesting (especially when she gives you backgrounds on some of the chemicals she's talking about). She's very helpful if you have a question, and won't hesitate to give refer you to someone for research.

Only grades are exams, quizzes, and possible extra credit. No homework to cushion your grade, but less work to do overall. Exams are very hard. However, lots of partial credit is given if it shows that you tried. Hard subject but best professor to teach it.
reviews.rating_tags: TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough

reviews.comment: This class is all lecture and memorization. She is Greek and has a very heavy accent. I would recommend taking this class at a time other than 8 am. Do the practice problems or it will be nearly impossible to pass.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: She's such an amazing professor and really knows what she's talking about. She's open to class discussion. She gives difficult tests, but they don't stray from the class material. She never tests on anything that she doesn't explicitly lay out in lecture. I highly recommend her for anyone taking organic chem.

Very organized professor, sets students up for success (gives EC and drops 1 exam and 1 quiz). Gives lots of practice problems. What you need to know for the exams is made very clear. She is very Greek and has an accent but I have never had a hard time understanding her. She writes very clearly on the board. I 4.0'd 251 and I'm in 252 with her now.
Great teacher. Gives lots of extra credit on each test and quiz. Also gives two chances to do extra credit assignments.

This class was easy, and I learned a lot. I took it online in the fall semester, but you could tell he cares about students and the material. He gives great feedback, and I recommend him if you need to take the 1 credit classes.

One of the nicest professors I've ever met. His actual teaching is also great.I cannot fathom how there's even one bad review here. He cares deeply about his students, and his course is VERY clear/easy on how to get a good grade. There was not too much reading, the videos were the perfect length. Take any of his courses with no fear.

CAS 204, fully async class. Workload is light and assignment criteria is clear. It's set up as a "choose your own adventure" system where you do 3 of 8 assignments that best fit you/your major. From his videos he seems like a caring and understanding professor. No exams or quizzes or anything, just take your time on assignments and you'll get a 4.0

Unless you want to learn absolutely nothing and listen to him ramble about nothing for the entire class period, don't take this class. There are 4 projects the entire semester and the only other grade is in person attendance. Take Jeff or Maral's section of this class if you actually want to get an education worth paying for.

I took Cal online, as long as you do what you need to I PROMISE youll at least get a 2.0. He does Effort grades that is based on your homework, quiz and recitation attendance grades. Even if you get 0 on all exams your effort grade (if you do it all right) will get you the grade you need. Highly recommend if you arnt good at math
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Not a bad teacher

Many people say MTH 124 is difficult but I think that if you follow along in the lectures and make sense of the concepts, it is easy to do well in this class. Your grade is made up of the final, WeBWorK (which is basically how you study anyway), recitation attendance and bi-weekly quizzes, and easy online effort assignments. The class is very fair.

Prof. Velivasakis is honestly a good math teacher. First few weeks of class are hard but he can always help if you have questions. There are quizzes likely every week but most of them are based off the homework. Really funny professor. Only downfall is the amount of homework he gives so give yourself time to do it because there's no late work.

Tbh his accent is what made me go to class. He is so funny. There is alot of homework and weekly quizzes but if you keep up with it you will be ok. I ended with a 3.0. Half the class skips lecture but i would definitely recommend going.

The material was taught well but the 6 quizzes throughout the semester (worth 55% of our final grade) would often only be 8 questions, so if you only got 2 wrong that would be a 75%. The final was also only 20 questions so it gave room for little to no error.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Test heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This class is hard if you do not attend the lectures. Recitations are mandatory with 2 skips. Luckily there was a built in "effort grade score" so as long as you went to the recitation and actually tried you were automatically passing the class which was really nice. The TA was eh they were not good at explain the material.
This class was genuinely awful. I failed it. The professor is a nice dude but I genuinely cried when walking to class. All I have to say is good luck. My ta was also so awful and did not care

He was the best professor i could get and honestly he was very good and understanding, i was sick one and forgot the due date of my hw and then let me do it for 100% credit not 75% late credit. overall i would tell you never take this course because if your not good at math then forget it but i think as someone who loves math this wasn't horrible
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Marios is a nice person and his teaching is understandable. As far as his quizzes, you get one every week in your recitation and there is 7-8 questions on every quiz so if you get one or two incorrect, your grade is heavily impacted.

Professor Velivasakis is by far the best prof you could get for MTH103. His lectures are really easy to follow and he's really good at explaining everything. If you're paying attention, actually take notes along with the lectures, doing the assigned webwork and studying you will be fine. He wants you to succeed.

This class is the worst class I have taken here at MSU. It is VERY fast paced, and the professor goes super quick so it is easy to fall behind even in class. VERY homework and test heavy, majority of your grade is based on the exams and quizzes. Overall, I think I'd rather take ANY class than this one and I pray for anyone who has to take it.

Velivasakis is pretty good at explaining each topic and example problems. But the course, MTH 124, was rough. You have quizzes every other week during your recitation, but you only have 20 minutes to do 8 questions. I usually bombed due to not having enough time to fully read/redo the problems. This isn't the profs fault but just be aware.

humbly think this might be one of the worst math teachers i've had. he moves way too fast. "it is not rocket science" will forever be engraved in my brain. webwork assigned every week but not too bad. you learn new material before recitation that will be on the test next week and not the test on that same week so it gets confusing
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The prof was good, but the class isn't. If you come to believe that MTH 124 is easier than Calc 1, you're wrong. Survey of Calculus is basically statistics for calc and is a pretty business-heavy. It's mostly word problems which was a huge issue for me, whereas Calc 1 is mostly number based question answering.

I TOOK MTH 124! i took it online async. NEVER AGAIN. i am failing this class. it's self-taught, meaning you are assigned videos and have to take your own notes. it is also extremely hard to reach this prof. the tests are impossible, they only have like 13 questions on them :(

I love this guy. He is a great professor and person, very caring, always answers emails, funny, and helpful. This class is test and quiz heavy with either occuring every week, as long as you don't skip lecture, do all homework and notes, and review, you will be fine. One of my favorite professors at MSU and made a difficult clas fun and engaging.
Test and quizzes are every week, but if you actually do the notes and homework you should have no issue

I loved Marios! He was so funny and a great Math Prof! Prof Marios is great at explaining things and may be the best math teacher I've ever had. Beware there are quizzes and exams every week, but if you look over the notes and lock in you will be fine. Overall, this math class requires some work, but you will learn a lot.

I mean I suck at math and am failing the course because its just so fast paced and the tests and exams are every week. I tried to get help but the resources were lacking when I went for extra help! He is a good professor though- def not a class for the week. Kudos to all of you
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I've had some horrible math teachers in the past and was scared to have a math class in college because of this, but Prof Marios was very good at explaining algebra and took questions unlike some other professors. Though you have quizzes or exams every week, this course is fast paced but not difficult. Homework is NOT too much.
Great professor.  Explains things well.  Recommend this course!

I love Marios. Lots of material to cover in class, but he really cares to help you understand if you ask. Go to his office hours before quizzes, he will make sure you understand. Do the practice he posts for quizzes rather than relying on webwork to study. Super funny guy, really cares to know his kids during office hours too. 100% would recommend.

The Professor tried his best with what he had, this course is very difficult to teach. Use textbooks & work problems form D2L for Webworks. Use his recorded vids and practice exams for exam studying. WebWorks should be done as early as possible so you can get corrections in office hours. Good quiz scores lessen the burden for exams.

Marios is very great person, and a good teacher. Seems like he was trying to rush through the semester though. While we were on D4 it seemed that the other classes were still behind learning other material. 
College algebra is a difficult class to teach, so I understand.
lots of material to self teach, prof tries his best

I think Spranger is full of himself and holds a large ego over his head, but theres no doubt that the dude knows his stuff. His class has pushed me to my limits academically and mentally, but I've learned a lot. I also think that being a pre-health student, his class serves as great preparation for grad school.

Biggest ego of any prof, with boring lectures, too much material, and impossible exam questions unless all you do is study. Don't take any other tough classes while doing PSL is my advice. Don't fall behind, memorizes the AQs for the exam, and only attend office hours if you want him to make you cry. He brags about 60% average exams too.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Mixed feelings

I was a 4.0 student. I don't understand how some people "enjoy" this class. Worst I've ever done in college. Made mistake of taking it even tho not needed for my major- don't make this mistake (vet students - not worth GPA drop). Horribly boring lectures, too fast, too much material, impossible test questions unless it's your only class. don't take

I get its meant to be a difficult class but he goes out his way to make the exams harder than they need to be. The low class average on exams says enough about him and he still somehow remains confident that what he does is right.

prayed I would get hit by the cata bus on the way to class. As if his material isnt hard enough to understand he goes out of his way to make sure the questions on the tests are meant to trick you. cried during every exam.

But the way Spranger designs the course not only prepares you to do well in the exams, but in the rest of your pre-health classes. His study skills are very clear and effective, and if you follow them, you will do well in the course.

Dr. Spranger is an amazing professor.  He appreciates hard work, what you put in is what you will get out. Use his study skills...
