reviews.comment: Work with the same group throughout the semester. Every lecture has a game to help teach the topics, which I thought were fun. Easy exams, open note.

An absolutely amazing professor, passionate about what he does and talks to you like peers, rather than students. Such a manageable workload, all exams are open notes. Extremely understanding and easy to reach. Could not recommend more.
This professor was amazing, I absolutely loved his lectures. From this class you learn a lot about communication and how to be a good leader.

Professor McKim is one of the best CSUS professors I have had.  He truly cares about the students and his lectures are incredibly engaging and fun.  I looked forward to going to class and I wish I could take his class again.  There is not a lot of homework and the course is very manageable.

Professor McKim has been one of the best professors I have had at this school. He is so caring and kind to his students. His lectures are fun and engaging and he wants everyone to succeed. I would have him as a professor a million times again.

Literally the best prof I've ever had at MSU, and I'm not even a community sustainability major. He cares for his students, their success, and has the most engaging lectures I've ever had in school. I wish I could take again for him

For a class that has 75% of the final grade dedicated to your exam performance, you'd think there would be more material to actually practice for it.
The professor himself is nice, but asks WAY too much of his students.
(Depending on your major or minor, you could substitute something like STT 200 [much easier] for this class - ask your advisor.)

reviews.comment: Ron is a great guy but probably the worst teacher I have ever had. You could know the material and study a lot and still not know the answers to the exams. Ron is a great guy. He's funny, he's engaging in his lectures, and is clearly passionate about his teaching career. However, his exam's are near impossible. The answers are so incredibly similar that it will make your head spin, yes physically spin. The exams are worth 75% of your grade so each one feels like stepping onto a battlefield. Good luck.

reviews.comment: Dr. Tamborini is passionate about the subject, but the class was tough. Exams are 75% of your grade and mostly (points-wise) short-answer, making them difficult. Tamborini is one of the sweetest and most caring professors I've ever had. He is knowledgable and passionate about mass communication and his lectures are packed but entertaining. He does talk a lot but the content is interesting and makes it better. LOVES his wife, HATES UMich, and always cracks dad jokes with us.

My fav professor by FAR. sweetest man you will ever meet and an amazing, clear, professor. I have 0 clue why he has any bad reviews. the class has 0 hw, and the exams are not that hard as long as you study a quizlet and look at the study guide. entertaining lectures and does not take attendance, yet somehow everyone shows up. LOVES his wife,10/10.

If you need to take this class and its your only option, do it, but if you have other options, do that.

Worst professor I have ever had. So lecture heavy he doenst post the slides which are from the 1900s btw talks like an ice age character and goes through them so quick without enough time to write everything down. No homework basically your entire grade is based off of exams with the exception of the random in class participation papers. stay away.

Also BEWARE of pop quiz writing exerts at the end of classes to count towards your attendance grade.

He is very nice but he does give out random in class papers throughout the semester and he will have you do his research projects as apart of your grade but there options to get out of it. Also attendance isn't mandatory but the lectures aren't posted at a later time

Hands down one of the most caring professors at MSU. Attendance is taken through random small writing assignments. His slides are not on D2L so attending lecture is important. Tamborini is cool. Simple lectures that are helpful (he tells you what will be on the exam). Just take notes and you'll be set. reviews.comment: Professor Tamborini is really pleasant, and his lectures were very clear and didn't have any useless information. The assignments were really reasonable, and the exams were really doable if you attended lectures and took good notes. I would absolutely take more classes from him.

Tamborini is quite the professor. The class itself is complex and the way he teaches it doesn't really help. He tries his best though. Tony Mandarich

Professor Tamborini is a great teacher. You can tell he truly cares about his students and wants them to succeed. He was very accommodating during COVID. He gives great examples in his lectures, though the topics are a bit boring at times. If you take good notes you will get an A no problem.

Possibly one of my favorite professors! Lectures are always interesting. He makes the test very easy to study for. Funny, kind, and all around great professor!!! Ron tries really hard to be funny. He's a super nice guy and you have to appreciate the effort he puts into his lectures. You can tell he really wants you to understand, but the class is hard and the material isn't easy. Must attend lectures and study if you want to pass. READ THE BOOK

Ron tries really hard to be funny, and you've got to appreciate his efforts. As a prof I think he's good, it's just the course that's hard. Be prepared to take tons of notes, and a highlighter doesn't go amiss either.
Great professor. Very sarcastically funny and helpful when asking questions. I absolutely loved COM 275 with him!

Very challenging class. Tamborini seems like a pretty cool dude, but a terrible professor. Lots of pointless case studies and reading. Aweful! All you do is write notes off the PowerPoint screen.  Completely pointless when he could easily posts these notes online like most normal instructors.  Nearly impossible to get an A and no fun class activities, media examples (videos, etc.); we don't even get to watch a single movie in this class. Tries to trick you on his test!
Ron is a very good professor, but if you do not bother to do any work and don't study then you will have a hard time in his classes.

Great prof.  Clearly got all information across with good examples of things that relate to your lives as college kids.

Woah, is dr. t ever hot.  He's simply a spectacular specimen of a MAN.  Hard to focus on the course material when you've got dr. hotbottom up there shakin' his thang.

It's online and you are teaching yourself
He's not involved in course at all besides monitoring exams, when you go talk to him about your grade he isn't helpful at all besides just giving you common sense such as "study" or "go to MLC"

He never emails back, when you try to talk to him in person he is rude and disrespectful. I had an online class with him so emailing him was my best option and I emailed him 7 times over the course o the semester and never once got an email back.

MTH 1825 was the worst class I have ever taken in my life, the fact that I come to a university and was told I had to take an online course is ridiculous in itself. ALEKS is absolutely the worst program, and the professor made the exams so much harder than anything we had to do on ALEKS. I loathed this class and despise Ron Powers

This was the worst course I ever took.  The software, ALEKS, was worse than myspace!  Ron Powers was never available and put all the work onto his TAs.  He made the last few tests really hard to purposely lower our grades.

He has got to be the worst professor ever. He goes extremely fast and doesn't even know what he is talking about himself most of the time. Don't bother asking for help because he will make you feel so small. Most definitely the most rude person.
Rude! I have never met a professor in my four years as rude as this man.  He is unavailable during office hours, and belittles you when you ask for assistance.
It is much easier to just go with the book than try to follow his lectures. And, a great deal of the time, he seems to say "told you so" rather than help you before there is a problem.

I dont know how this man ever got a job as a trig professor because he does not know anything about it. I had to substitute class with a tutoring sessiona and things went better but if you have to rely on his teaching good luck because you will need it

I'm the worst person ever at math, so the class was pretty difficult for me. But, I think that Powers is a pretty good Prof- he is very helpful and he sorta looks like Elton John. Not the worst, not the best.

He needs to actually retire already. He could be my grandpa and it seems like he enjoys teaching but his class was miserable. Hated all my papers no matter how much work I put into them. Forced unnecessary class participation. Not fun to chat with at all. Way too much reading, and the homework had almost no connection to writing sometimes. not good
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Professor is the best teacher here at James Madison. As one of the founders, he is extremely passionate about teaching, especially freshman, which is hard to come by. Take his course if you want to become a better writer. My papers only improved. I appreciate all the time and effort he put into the course to help the students get the most out it.

Professor Dorr is an eccentric old man that is very passionate about writing which makes the class enjoyable. However, it is very hard to do well in the class due to his extreme pickiness when grading papers. He will humiliate you participating in class but it is worth it. Unless you have PERFECT grammar, don't expect more than a 3.5 in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Get ready to read--SO MANY PAPERS

reviews.comment: Great professor, very insightful and wise however he is a VERY tough grader on papers. Make sure you go to office hours and participate in class discussions, although you dont get marked for absences, it will seriously hurt you if you don't show up.

Although once a great professor, in recent years Dorr has been overcome with sentimentality. Inappropriate morality lessons and Bible quotes in class, scattered dry discussion and overall not a lot of progress. Grades based on level brown-nosing done in class, not quality of writing. Overall a major disappointment.

One of the better English professors at James Madison if you are looking to better your writing. He grades tough, and takes no B.S. He expects you to attend most classes and if you do not he will call you out on it. Also make sure you have the readings done because he does active discussions.

Probably one of the hardest profs I've ever had, but he's taught me so much about writing. He's amazingly smart and his classes often run over because we have such good discussions. He grades really tough, but it's worth taking the class.

i knew i would like him. and then i did. it was great. serious, smart, passionate about his work. everything you could hope for. hard grader, which angered those used to grade inflation. earning a b? who has ever heard of such a thing!
No Comments
JMC lost one of the best profs ever with Dorr's retirement. Perhaps, though, he will yet live out his dream of being reincarnated as a Hutterite woman...
No Comments
No Comments
Although Dorr certainly is one smart cookie, his class is only benefical to those who go to office hours regualarly, which I didn't.
very hard, but an amazing prof

I've never hated my life more than when I took this class. I stopped going to lectures half way through semester because it was a waste of time since my math skills were actually regressing when he taught; Instead, I taught myself the topics through Youtube videos. I paid for this class yet I'm the one teaching. Don't take if you want to live.

I've never cried or called my mom for anything this much before this. I stopped going to lectures because I learned more from someone else teaching me than the professor. I was starting to think that I was the issue but I shouldn't have to pray that I get hit by a CATA bus on the way to my exams. If you're not religious, find one & start praying.
Took confusing notes and gave us practice quizzes that had many things not on the exams. Takes attendance each class. Taught very slow though which made it easier to understand.

His handwriting is extremely sloppy, students have ask what he wrote on the slide. Lectures are confusing, on top of his extremely thick accent. Very unorganized, answers questions incorrectly, and doesn't understand the questions students ask him. He often gives no help for the question that was asked by the student due to misunderstanding them.

Could not be more confusing. Horrible hand writing, extremely thick accent, constantly gives the wrong answer and then has to be corrected by students, super unclear communication. No real explanation ever, simply fills in the notes and then tests you on said notes the NEXT class. Don't take this class unless it is literally your only option.

So confusing and disorienting. Professor has messy writing and a very thick accent. Does not keep a cohesive schedule whatsoever. You walk in class, take notes, and take a test on the notes you took the class BEFORE. No time to study whatsoever.Even told me and my entire class we had a big exam the NIGHT BEFORE. 0 out of 1,000. Could not be worse.

Prof. Madrigal is a good professor, it's just he pushes you to be a better writer. He's very relaxed with due dates and often gives us more time to turn writing assignments in. He usually holds office hours after class if you want him to peer review/edit your paper. He often gives really good feedback which has helped me become a better writer.

Took over a class originally taught by another teacher- so not much to say about his class layout. He's extremely socially awkward and expect to cringe at least 5 times every class. Gives horrible feedback (copy & paste on multiple docs) and talks about nothing all the time. Not a hard class just horribly unenjoyable

Hands down one of the best professors I have had so far. The lectures teach you a lot about writing at the college level if you pay attention and participate. Will help you to succeed indefinitely whether it's in class or outside of class in his office hours. Professor Madrigal is, in my opinion, a gifted writer and teacher.

Pros: Cool guy, very relaxed, and works with you whenever you need help and tell him. This man straight up does not teach, he just talks about random things during lectures. So easy. And I got no less than an 88 on all of my papers. Cons: He doesnt give feedback when grading, just good grades. Relies heavily on peer review. Such boring lectures.

This prof is an easy 4.0. Even though he talks in circles sometimes and the lecture seems pointless sometimes, you have to go. You can just sit on your laptop all lecture, (got a lot of outside hw done). Initially every assignment is confusing, but he is good at explaining what he's looking for, so they're all super doable. Easy 4.0 & honors credit
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS

reviews.comment: Boring lecture but learned a lot and not too difficult. Fair grader and only textbook needed was like 10$. Papers weren't difficult and not many to do.
reviews.rating_tags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Enjoys writing, but does not share very many tips on account of how to improve your own work. Fairly easy to do well in here, but the content of the class is not interesting. The professor himself is very genuine and friendly. I would recommend him to others.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Madrigal is very intelligent and knows how to write very well. He gives you a very long time to do each project and is not too strict about due dates but do not take advantage of that. Sometimes he will say things that do not exactly make sense and use big words but as long as you write how he speaks and writes, you will be great.
He is a grade C intellectual, and too unintelligent to follow basic argument. A very nice man, and not a brutal grader, but really should not be a doctor.

The class is two hours long and they are so boring. He rambles about nothing the whole class and then assigns a paper. He's a pretty easy grader and he's easy to talk to. He's really lenient, if you ask for an extended deadline, he'll give it to you. He checks attendance.

The class is easy, but he talks in circles. The lectures are pointless, so you can just do homework for other classes. He is a huge pushover and will push back assignments if you ask. Overall, a very easy class, and a pretty respectable prof.

Don't go near him if you're gonna take this course. Daily 30-50 pg readings that will be on the final. Pop quizzes with a 10 min time limit. Doesnt let you see your grade until you have taken the final, meaning you have to email him to see your grade. Lectures are only pictures, so notes are based on what he's saying or notes on the readings.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a genius and very passionate about what he teaches. Not a tough grader, but you're going to have to do some research and reading. The material is pretty interesting so it's not too bad. One of my favorite professors.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Prof is very passionate, but grade is entirely based on weekly essays, participation, and a 8-10 page final that is 40% of your grade. If you miss lecture you miss all of the material, but all the essays are based on the 30+ page articles you have to read 2x a week. Class is very interesting, but very stressful and difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--So many papers

reviews.comment: Dr Cornelius is fun, but his class is very hard. If you see him teaching this class and Jack the Ripper & Victorian England, this class is not about that. This class is on African Traditional Religion and Warfare & the final is 40% of your grade. The concepts are very abstract and hard to grasp. Fun teacher, but try your luck elsewhere
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Mr. Cornelius was the absolute BEST TA I have ever had. He is very inspirational, energetic, and cares about all of his students. I can not recommend any class/section with him enough. You will not regret it at all.

Such a nice and amazing person. He really cares bout his students and fosters and kind and nurturing environment. As long as you show up, participate, and do the work, you will have a wonderful time and grow so much as a writer.

He's really sweet! His grading for his Creative Fiction Writing class is just making sure you complete assignments on time, and making sure you participate in class. The class's workload is probably 3/5, so not too much or too little. He's also an enthusiastic professor, and willing to work with you to meet your needs.

Shastri is so sweet. Big fan of him. Intro to Creative Writing was very much that, an introduction where you explore different forms of creative writing. His grading scale is pretty clear and as long as you actively participate and give feedback during class, you should be fine. Feedback has a focus on positive aspects as it is an intro class.

Course uses R-studio which is the coding portion. For exams, his coding portion will be taken at the same time frame. Other STT 231 professors allow you to take home the coding portion. He is super nice and gentle, but overall a boring professor. His lectures can be confusing due to the accent but he does offer some extra credit points.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE HIM! Actually so boring, horrible, hard to understand. In person R studio exam unlike every other STT 231 professor. I've heard take Horr, from everything I hear the class is nothing like Zeleke's was. He was really sweet just shouldn't be teaching.

Dr. Zeleke is a super caring professor who will do what he can to help you succeed. Although attendance isn't mandatory, it's vital to attend lectures as he works on a chalkboard & doesn't post his notes/lectures online. He offers lots of practice problems & extra credit, & his exams are fairly similar to the practice offered. I highly recommend!

Dr. Zeleke is an incredibly kind and enthusiastic professor. However, in my opinion he is not the best teacher and studying for exams can be increasingly difficult and stressful. There is lots of homework too. There are many opportunities for extra credit too. My advice: Go to every class you can, do the homework, and go to office hours.

I enjoyed this class especially trying to refine my statistics skills. I took a stats class in the summer at OCC and I found that some stuff was the same, but the formulas were slightly different. In this class, I would personally say that I struggled with the R-studio part because I would always get error message when I was typing in command.

He seems like a nice guy, but I could not grasp this class well. I am a good student and I enjoy math but he made a lot of the concepts quite confusing. There is extra credit, but doesn't help your grade a ton. His lectures are boring, I was warned of this prof and was told not to take him. I thought I would be fine but I was wrong.

I like Professor Zeleke as a person, but lectures can be kind of boring. There are peer writing assignments which aren't fun if you have a bad group, but they aren't hard. 3 lecture attendances, 1 recitation, 1 PW, and 1 HW are dropped at the end of the semester. 3 tests which aren't too hard-- the final isn't cumulative, and there's lots of EC.

Zeleke is a nice guy, but he just can't really grasp teaching very well. He is quite confusing in lectures. Catch him quite a bit seeming like even he doesn't know what he's talking about. You have so much hw in this class, individual and group hw. The individual hw usually lengths within the 30's for questions. Gives out a lot of extra credit.
Professor Zeleke followed a course-pack and shared many resources to help students succeed in his class.

Professor Zeleke is such a kind man but he cannot teach well during lectures. Asking him questions about homework may lead to more confusion. The homework is difficult and there are so many questions. Moreover, no feedback is provided for homework. Coding section is not hard. Extra credit is provided, so make sure to do all of them when possible.

Very nice professor but his class was awful. Struggled to reach a 3.0 while other students in other professors recieve over 100% on their tests. This class ruined my 4.0 gpa. Do not listen to the reviews saying he is a good professor. I don't know a single person in this class who wasn't struggling.

This Professor is very articulate on most concepts in Calc III. He is very accessible for office hours and study groups outside of class. Exams are very similar to material learned so if you give effort you will do very well. Very interesting class and very simple for those who are interested in the course.

I loved Dr. Zeleke. I am historically terrible at stats, but he got me through this course with a 4.0. He can be difficult to understand, but he wants you to do well and will always try his best to help. Great teacher, do the homework/practice problems/mock exams and you will do well. Attendance is mandatory but he is understanding. Very kind prof.

Professor Zeleke was a ver kind professor. He truly wants his students to do well. I, however, am not very math brained and some of the harder concepts were not explained well leaving me to have to re-teach myself. I ended up pulling a 3.5, but if you understand stats it would be an easy 4.0. homework every week and group essays every other week.

Zeleke is a dawg. By far the best class of my semester. Attendance is mandatory, but class gets done early, and participation isn't normally necessary. There is a "mandatory" textbook, but he provides the same information during class time or alternatively on D2L.

Okay (normal) lectures, but very nice guy & knowledgeable. Always happy to help outside of class, has a good attitude, flexible, offers extra credit. Do the homework, look at the mock exams (just like the real exams). Easiest 4.0 of my life. Excellent mentor for UURAF/Honors Opt if you're a more motivated student. Wants you to do well!

Dr. Zeleke is one the best professor at MSU. I had him last fall for my calculus I and he is always helpful with my questions. His office hours was one of the best thing. Moreover, he is a linear grader with lots of extra credit. Just practice the homework and sample exam paper to get a straight A in the Final.
He is an awesome professor! This isnt high school anymore. You gotta keep up and be responsible for yourself!

Nice guy, talks slow, really goes through material thoroughly & office hours were helpful. But tests were nearly impossible and he teaches calc like you took AP calc already & even those kids had a hard time. for example he taught us 2nd derivative test, but asked us to do 4th derivative on exam? had lots of extra credit but take a different prof
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: tests are kind of challenging he puts true and false questions that are conceptual not a fan, but he gives extra credit on each test and the homework isn't much and it is easy

Class is very very challenging because everything is multiple choice even though stats is very up to interpretation. As a professor, he does a really great job and is very caring. He makes him self available to help and wants all of his students to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Test are incredibly hard.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough Grader--Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: He's amazingly clear and willing to go out of his way to help you as long as you show that you are willing to put in the effort.
I LOVEEEEEE HIM AS A PROFESSOR!
Harsh accent, horrible lecture

The class is taught as if the student took AP Calculus in high school, so it was pretty challenging. He was really helpful if you took advantage of his office hours. Meeting one-on-one made things make a lot more sense.
Good professor, for stats. does a decent job of explaining the material that is pretty easy to begin with.
He teaches his calculus class like you took AP Calc in high school. Doesn't explain anything. Had to retake the class with a different professor the next semester.
Very nice and helpful. He really explains everything well and you never feel rushed.
I am a math major and thought his class was definitely good. My friends who were not math majors like him as a prof but have trouble understanding the material.
Tests are tricky, loved calculus before I had him for calc III.
I felt that he thought we all knew everything already so he expected us all to do fine when we gave him blank looks. Not a very good class.

Literally an awful professor. Never knew the answers to any question I asked. The assignments were so confusing because he never explained them. He also didn't know how to work the online D2L system. 0/10 DO NOT TAKE HIS CLASSES.
He was very bad and didn't know how to use D2L to put assignments in. Never responds to emails and doesn't have office hours. Good luck if you get stuck with him.
Doesn't know how to work D2L. Won't email you back at all. Sucks at communicating about literally anything.

ASIANLAN426 (Advanced Spoken Japanese), Imamura is the only teacher of the class and it is organized very poorly. The homework has an insane amount of typos and when it comes to preparing speeches, there are no examples and explanations are not clear. Her "feedback" is extremely blunt and rude, and sometimes just downright hurtful.

Imamura sensei is a wonderful teacher! She really cares about how you're doing in class and helps you as much as she can. Even though the class is a lot of work, if you're able to attend everyday and keep up with the content, it will be pretty easy.

Imamura Sensei was a great professor, definitely recommend taking her class! She rly cares abt her students. You have hw and class every day, so make sure that your other classes aren't too time-consuming- languages requires consistency and time. However, it was such a rewarding & fun class, I also loved getting to know my classmates.

She does give a lot of homework, but that's expected of a class with a language as difficult as Japanese. If you do have mistakes, she will ask you to resubmit a new corrected version of the assignment, but it's all for your own benefit. She's a great teacher and everyone in the class really seemed to enjoy having her as a teacher.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Overall great teacher that does everything you can ask for from a uni level language professor. Very clear with her expectation and grading, takes her time and fully explains everything very well. Clear deadlines, goals, and instructions the entire course. 100% would recommend

GEO221 online. He was great! Very responsive outside of class (online course) via email, and the labs were very easy to follow. Some may say there's a lot of labs/assignments (I personally didn't think so), but there's no exams, and as long as you set a decent amount of time between beginning the assignment and the deadline, you'll be alright.
His class is a lot of work, but he makes the instructions very clear and you will receive a good grade as long as you follow them. Not a difficult grader.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Inaccessible in terms of help and assigns loads of assignments.

He is super sweet and checks in with us to make sure we are all okay and to remind us of due dates in our GroupMe. There are about four papers that we had to do (not very long), and there is about 20 pages of reading per week with a weekly quiz. Overall, a great professor who cares about his students and the information at hand.
Honor section is more difficult compared to other sections.
You have to study lectures before class. Useful material.
dont take.
Would give a 0 if possible. Avoid this TA if you can help it.

literally the worst teacher I've ever had. the dude has existential crises in class and doesn't teach anything helpful, and didn't even know when our midterm was. there's maybe two people in the class that actually know what's going on. DO NOT TAKE A CLASS WITH HIM.
My favorite Professor ever. She will work with you and accommodate you as you need. Highly recommend taking her for as many courses as possible.
For One of the best Packaging Professors. She gives you credit back on test if you go to her office hours. Very straight forward what is on the tests.

Super tough grader, you're basically screwed unless you put in a TON of hours and go to her office hours. Assigns complex assignments without teaching you how to actually do the assignments in the application she asks you to use

Not for pkg 221 but 315 rather. For our final lab assignment made us memorize a poem comprised of nonsense word and recite the poem in costume and character during the lab. Is that an assignment or a humiliation ritual?
Extremely rude and unhelpful. Does not accommodate if you lose family members or go through a tragedy. She is quite literally just mean about everything.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Took the course over the summer. The content was easy, but she is an extremely picky grader for the quizzes and assignments even though it is a 101 course. She took a point off one of my assignments because it was not written in "technical writing" even though the assignment asked for our own opinion.

Prepare for exams by reviewing lecture & test review slides thoroughly. Keep communication open with your team, assign tasks, and stick to deadlines. Highly recommend scheduling recurring meeting. Attend office hours to gain valuable insights. Stay curious, especially about machinery in pkg line. Professor's awesome!
As a person, she is nice. However, her tests are full of trick questions meant to lower your grade instead of actually assessing your knowledge on the subject.
Go to her office hours or wait till after class and ask her questions. Very understanding. She wants you to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Had her for PKG 221 and it was one of few classes I have failed in the past several years, a lot of her material would contradict each other and cause confusion on exams. Unnecessarily difficult grader, must have every minute piece of information possible on projects and diagrams. Re-took the class with another professor and it was lso much easier

She does not want you to succeed, grades tough on the group project that is worth the majority of your grade, and has test questions meant to trick you. She taught little of meaningful value. My grade does not reflect the effort I put into the class
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easily accessible outside of class (email and office hours). Tough grader on assignments/tests, but will let you go to office hours to discuss the grade (and get it raised if you make your case well enough). Not many complaints here.
Super nice and knowledgeable! I enjoyed her class a lot

Best professor I've ever taken and highly recommend everyone to take your classes with her, you would for sure love them. She is easily accessible outside of the class and offers extra credit opportunities whenever possible. I learned so much about packaging and really miss her lectures. Highly recommend!!!

I don't have words to describe how nice and caring this professor is. She really wants you to learn, grow and succeed. I consider myself a pretty committed student, however, if you show your interest, attend her office hours, and try your best to learn, you will easily be able to get A in this course!

There is a lot of content covered in the course, but she helps breakdown the most important concepts that we should know for the exams. Go to office hours to get anything cleared up because she cares that her students do well. Group project is fun depending on how dedicated your group is, because it requires a lot of time and effort.
Followed instructions for group project, and group received a 60%. She said that our group clearly did not understand the fundamentals of her class. Rarely shows interest and enthusiasm.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Great Prof that is very dedicated to helping students succeed. The lectures can be quick at times, but she always goes over exactly what you need to know before exams (and posts lecture slides). She also is almost always available to talk in her office and go over past exams or or any questions you might have.
Extremely caring and compassionate. Easy grader and makes an otherwise boring subject pretty interesting. Best professor I've had at MSU.

Dr. Porter is one of the kindest and most caring professors I've ever had. Though her classes are lecture-heavy and can sometimes drag on, she tries her best to keep them fun and interesting! Your grade relies on attendance, so make sure to show up. But overall she is a great professor, and I would 100% recommend her!
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Porter is so sweet! Her classes can be often times long, but other than that she does her best to make you like them! Attendance s heavily based, and can make your final harder so make sure youre always there!

Although classes are mandatory, she makes them fun. She is also a very kind professor that absolutely knows what she's talking about. You will have to do some reading but after all this is a writing class. Very understanding and honestly will probably be one of the most down to earth professors here at MSU. This class was actually WRA195H.

Dr. Porter is a fantastic professor. She's very kind and wants what is best for her students. She wants her students to put effort into their work and wants to help them write better. 5 projects with different weights, but might get condensed to 4. Follow the rubric, don't use AI, and put a little effort in, and it's an easy A. Wonderful person!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I can never quite describe her personality but she is a bubbly person and the most understanding person I have ever met. All she wants is for you to write your own work and thoughts and is very understanding. She is that one teacher(professor) you will never forget.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is hands down one of the best professors I have come across. I took this class just to get the credit over with, but it very easily became one of my favorite classes to show up to. She made the class enjoyable and fun and really cares about your progress overall she's a great teacher, and I would definitely suggest taking her class if you can.
She is a very sweet and caring professor in and outside of the classroom.
Very kind professor, willing to extend deadlines and always open to helping whoever needs it. Gives great feedback. Take WRA 101 with her!
Super punctual with grade and incredible feedback. Never makes you feel stupid and is always open to questions. Would without a doubt take this course again!

Dr. Porter has changed my outlook on the subject of writing. I show up to class wanting to learn how to improve my writing skills every class. For context, I am a stem major that hates all writing. She grades well, extends deadlines, is energetic, is accessible and has planned her section to run better than the original 101. She is a must take prof
BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO

She is really nice & upbeat during class, but this year she went back and forth between two websites. It was hard to keep up sometimes because she constantly changed it and there would be some problems (link not working, quiz not letting you see your results) but she explains things very well and the material is generally easy to understand.

This professor was not helpful at all. Her office hours were inconvenient, and she never replied to emails, which was really frustrating. She was really cheerful during classes, and seemed like a nice person, but was not the best professor. Her scheduling was confusing because she constantly changed it. the homework was easy, but exams were not.

This professor was not very prepared. She never returned any of my emails, and her exams tended to cover material that we went over in minescule amounts compared to what she actually talked about. She changes the schedule constantly. She was nice as a person, but not the best professor in my book.

Professor Cagnato was very unprofessional and was not willing to help outside of class she was always late to class and  never returned any of my emails. you have to check angel everyday because she is always posting new assignments without notice.

I felt my soul leave my body every Monday and Wednesday. Probably the worst class I have ever taken. The exams are weirdly hard, and he expects you to remember details he doesn't even go over in lecture. He is very hard to understand during lecture; felt like a huge waste of time and attendance is basically mandatory if you want to get a good grade
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Oh my gosh. I would rather drop out of uni than to attend this class again. First day I showed up I wanted to cry the entire time. He slouches in his chair staring at his computer and mumbles to it throughout the entirety of the lecture. You will never leave class early maybe even late. 2 hours of agony. How in the world was he hired!!!?

Worst class I have ever taken. A university required class should not be this hard. He mumbles and you will not understand him, his lectures are very unstructured and impossible to follow. Do not take this class.

All I really have to say is please take another IAH. 

This class was way too much lecturing. He mumbles, it is horrible. He is one of the worst professors I have ever had. He declined my accommodation and did nothing to ever help me. He is extremely hard to follow. I have never been this stressed about a class ever. Please DON'T TAKE THIS COURSE.
Difficult exams, he does not give extra credit, attendance is mandatory. He is unfortunately very hard to understand and mumbles a lot. I would not take him as a professor again.

He was a great lecturer. Really passionate about the subject and VERY happy to answer any question. Professor Johnson was amazing you could tell he loved what he was lecturing on and was very knowledgeable on the topics. Loved his class.

only 3 exams. class was hard to connect but lots of real life examples that were relevant. be sure to do the outside reading as they are on the exams. you can tell he loves to teach but class can at times drag on
