Arbogast was my favorite professor this semester! His lectures were really interesting, and he gave out study guides before each exam which were very helpful. He's very easy to talk to and understanding. If you attend lecture + pay attention and do the readings, an A is very possible.
Love this class! His lectures are engaging and really interesting to listen to

ISS 205 is mainly a prerequisite that students take, he makes it way to difficult and it is definitely not Big Ideas in Social Science. It should just be called current events and geography. He brings up current events and then gives his very liberal opinion on it attempting to brainwash other students.
Alan Arbogast is the man.

Really like the guy and his lectures, but I feel like he should make the lecture material actually available to the students instead of penalizing them for not retaining every word of what he says. His slides are basically just pictures, and are hard to make sense of after the class. His exams were fairly tough, but easy enough to get atleast an 80
He has good energy when giving lectures but the class just seems off. Should have just called it geology. He also loves brining up current events and giving his very liberal opinion on the situation.

I enjoyed this class a lot, especially gaining more knowledge about Michigan history as well as what is going on in other countries. I know that I would sometimes come late, but that didn't affect my learning, but I found that the exams were tough even though I would study in advance. Overall, great class and had a great semester with you!

Professor Arbogast is THE best professor I will ever have. His exams are hard and very outside-of-class video-heavy, but his lectures are entertaining if you interact. His wife is a mental health therapist, and it shows. A girl dad who loves what he's doing and is passionate about what he is teaching: if you can take a class with him, YOU MUST.

Professor Arbogast was really good at making class interesting and keeping the energy up.  He was a really fair grader, and would correct test answers if they were confusing and a lot of us got them wrong, blaming himself instead of students.

There's a decent amount of reading involved, but honestly you could probably get yourself to a 3.0 just by showing up and paying attention in class. Dr. A knows his stuff and is more than willing to answer questions for as long as necessary for the class's understanding. Great dude who really cares about his students!

Dr. A is one of the best professors i have had. He really cares about his students and his lectures are very engaging. Its easy to get an A in his class if you just listen in class and watch the videos or articles he posts for before class. He used top hat in my class and had 5 pop quizzes and took attendance but it wasn't daily.

Amazing professor, and definitely cares about his students. Grades very clear - 5 of 6 quizzes, 10 of 12 attendance dates. Very much girl-dad energy. Makes class fun, and enjoys what he's teaching. Would absolutely take again.

I took 206 online. There were no video lectures like in my other online classes. The lectures were made up of pages of reading. There was also a textbook to read from. Very reading heavy. Grade is made up of 14 quizzes (16 quizzes but 2 are dropped), 3 papers (pretty easy), and a final exam. The quizzes were tricky but open note and timed.

Online class taught entirely by the TA. Never communicated with Arbogast at all. Class was fairly easy. A few HW assignments and the exams were easy IF you read his notes. I briefly skimmed the notes, then copied and pasted all of his notes into a word document and used the search tool to look for relevant words. I 3.5 the class.
LOVE HIM! Very interesting, very enthusiastic, a bit difficult but totally worth it.
Great Teaching Style and Clarity. Course is relevant to current events and a must for anyone interested in understanding the interconnectedness of our planet.

I had him in sp. '96 and still remember how great he was. The class was very interesting.   I almost switched majors because of him and his class.  Also, very helpful during office hours.  Would highly, highly recommend.  (I only knew the course # because I kept the book (5th ed.) and the info is on the SBS sticker - that's how much I liked it!)
great teacher!
Very interesting! His tests are tricky but class is great.

Alex was an amazing instructor who clearly cared about her students and the material she taught. She kept the class engaged and knew how to pull us back in when attention drifted. The freedom she gave us in assignments was deeply appreciated by my peers and me. If you have the opportunity to take a class with her, take it.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Alex was a great professor, and I really enjoyed her class. She was so caring and respectful of everyone in class and what they thought. She was very understanding about late work and gave great feedback. All the content assigned felt necessary and meaningful to the course. Participation and group work were highly encouraged in every class session.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Alex cares very much what her students think. She works hard to make sure everyone understands the homework, but she also expects you to bring your perspective into the discussion.

I took Alex's TE 353 class, and she was awesome! Super interesting lectures and in-depth discussions. She clearly is very knowledgable and passionate about our material and is so caring for us and our needs. Classes were dynamic and so fun to attend every time, plus she brought food every week. I loved this class and would love to have Alex again!!

The contents we learned about are very interesting, and even though I don't like reading, the articles and books assigned are some of the best. Alex was very considerate of us and was always making sure to give us extra credit options and grade in a timely matter. Along with that, she's just funny and loving; definitely my favorite prof so far!
Alex was an amazing professor! She was very understanding and I enjoyed her teaching style!

Alex is one of the kindest people I've met. She is great and takes the needs of students into great consideration. She deeply cares about people, and this class makes you actually reflect on some tough topics. I could not recommend Alex enough.

Professor Allweiss is an amazing professor. I loved going to her class because everything she taught made me think. She was super understanding and I cannot stress how kind and caring she is. I actually learned in her class and enjoyed all our discussions in class. If I could have her as a professor for all my classes, I would.

Alex is amazing. Easily one of the best professors at MSU. She takes class feedback and directly implements it into our work for the week. She cares about us and caters the work we do to the overall mood of the class. She teaches tough topics, but always makes sure we have a great understanding of them. Highly recommend this class!

Alex is amazing! . Her class is easy to follow along with. All the work is apart of the class besides some outside activities. She is very supportive of her students needs especially when they are going through a hard time. She wants all of her students to succeed and is willing to help students out when they need it. HIGHLY RECOMMEND HER.

Alex is a perfect example as to how every professor should teach during a pandemic. She is kind, understanding, considerate, etc. Everything that she assigns is essential to your learning and is very easy on grading. She is super passionate about what she teaches and is the most organized professor I've ever met. Highly recommend taking her classes
Very difficult 1 credit class heavy work load

Please for the love of God and your sanity do not take this class. It's only week 4 and it makes me want to die. Its unorganized, poorly structured, too much going on, and classes are overwhelming and vague. Please just don't take this class.
Good professor, cares about his field and wants to make sure you understand content

He is a very nice guy and is willing to help, but the class feels like a waste of time, its reaching the end of the semester and he still hasn't graded past the first notebook. His lectures and instructions are also pretty confusing at times overall would avoid this class if it is not required.

His criteria contradict themselves all the time, so it's hard to get a good grade because it's hard to understand what needs to be done. The class feels like a mess, and it's tough to understand the work that needs to be done. He will help you out a great deal and is very nice to talk to. Just not the best instructor.

The lectures were pre-recorded videos to be watched outside of class where Jameel read off of a powerpoint. The lectures took a few hours even on 2X speed when I took notes. There were pre-class quizzes and weekly post-class quizzes as well. Jameel is a nice person but is not great at explaining lecture content for a 2-hour long class.

This man takes absolutely forever to grade anything-- even if it is just releasing scores from a multiple choice D2L quiz. He is also very nit-picky when grading. Most of the material must be learned before the lectures, because he is going to go on ten tangents and cover maybe 25% of the material in class. If you have to take him, best of luck.

Ugh, please avoid this professor if possible. He seems like a great person and is caring about students but cannot grade things in a timely manner. Also, you have to earn a 93% or above in the class to earn a 4.0 but must earn 80% or above for a 3.0. So kinda like a curve that is helpful to nobody. Very tough grader too.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: A really funny professor who is really knowledgeable and passionate about the course material +beyond. Always willing to support students with assignments and make the course fun/engaging.

Dr. Al-Haddad is one of the toughest graders I have experienced at my time at MSU. Not only is he a tough grader, but he has only graded a handful of our assignments this year and class is already over. Despite this he is actually very helpful when you ask questions in class and is good at helping students with their work.

I found professor Al-Haddad to be a great and engaging person who cares a lot for what he teaches but is very slow to grade coursework which makes it extremely hard to know what you need to do better/ different for he next assignment. We have completed 5 notebooks this semester and only one has been graded and it's the final week of classes.

It is finals week and he just started grading notebooks we did at the beginning of the semester. Even if you follow the rubric for the notebook, you'll still do poorly and you'll have no time to make improvements. I have no clue what my grade is and grades are literally due in two days. He is an incredibly boring lecturer for an almost 3-hour lab.

We only have a few days left of finals week and half of our assignments haven't been graded yet. We don't know if we are completing assignments correctly, which also makes it especially difficult to submit any final drafts for lab proposals and presentations because there is no criticism telling us what we need to fix.

Overall a hard class, Dr. Al-Haddad is a really nice guy who is open to help. But for it being a 1 credit lab, there is a lot of work. On top of that it takes him the whole semester to grade the lab notebooks, leaving you lost as to what your grade is at the moment.

Hes very nice and knows what hes talking about but is VERY unorganized. Its the last week of the semester and 1 grade has been put in. The class is a lot for a 1-credit lab and not much feedback is given at all

He's nice, but unorganized. Homework is 15% of your grade and we only had one official homework that took him the entire semester to grade. The class is group oriented, so hopefully you get a good group. The class was hybrid but the quizzes and exams were online, and they weren't to difficult. He's not a bad professor just a little unorganized.

By far my least favorite professor and class here at MSU. Himself and his lectures are a mind-numbingly boring. There is an unholy amount of work. Often takes days to respond to emails. Always unorganized, instructions rarely clear. If your group mates drop, you won't be placed into a new group. Terrible experience from getgo. Would not recommend!!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: I still don't know what a notebook is. I have asked in class multiple times along with others and he just says "watch the videos." The videos do not help in the slightest. Everything seems very unorganized and I don't know what's going on half the time.
This class is an ungodly amount of work for one credit. My 5 credit math class had less work.

This professor is one of the most unorganized people I have ever met. He cannot make D2L quizzes properly, he fails to grade work, and announces significant class changes last minute. Overall, he makes the class an awful experience, despite his otherwise nice personality. I would advise not taking this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Genuinely thought I was gonna fail this class even though I took AP psych in highschool and have gotten 4.0's in all classes since coming to MSU.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: JUST RUN BRUHHH..EXAMS ARE SO DIFFICULT..DONT TAKE THIS CLASS FOR UR HONORS CREDIT
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Nice guy, but VERY BORING. Lecture should not be 2 hours long for a 15 slide powerpoint. Maybe its because I am an upperclassman in a lower level 100 course, but damn I was not paying attention at all because he's just that boring. Very open to questions and clearly passionate but probably not built to be a professor.

Erik is a kind professor, but I would not recommend him overall. Each class is a lecture with a PowerPoint. Exams are pretty much the entirety of the grade. Exams are difficult, and often 2 answers are correct (and he admits this too). You will only have lectures to study for exams. He is a funny dude, though.
There were only 3 exams that used to be online, but now they are in person, and they are not fun.

Incredibly test heavy which makes it difficult to ace. No practice exams, homework assignments, or study guides to gauge your knowledge so you are going into every exam blind. There are also no extra credit or corrections which is understandable, but if you want to have any kind of confidence going into these exams this course isn't it.

This class is wickedly uninteresting. The professors tone, slides, and presentation style will have you asleep. This class relies solely on exams for grading which does not account for different learning styles. This class is a complete waste of time and I am losing precious hours of my life by attending. Avoid this prof if possible.

One of the best professors I've had. Very caring & accessible outside class. Most of the material is in lecture, so it really pays to attend. He's a good lecturer and slips in a joke here and there too. Gives a lot of examples that relate to lecture than enhance learning. I'd highly recommend this class & this professor. I enjoyed the class a lot!

The lectures are....a lot.....but they have all the answers for the exams. Prof is super willing to talk outside of class and will treat you really well if you're interested in the course content. If you're not interested.....you're gonna have to pay attention

The only thing you need to do well in this class is attend lecture twice a week. He is an amazing lecturer and gives no outside homework. Tests are online and very clearly match the material given. Easy A and easy honors class. Also very interesting and fun to learn about.

He is a little boring, but the class is relatively easy to pass if you show up. A lot of the stuff he asks about in exams are activities directly done in class, so even though he posts the lecture slides afterward, it pays to attend.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: there is no homework in this class. It was very easy and mr altmann is very easy to listen to. the tests were easy only 2 tests and the final.

Dr. Altmann's class was one I usually dreaded. Nothing against him as a person, but as a teacher the class was very boring and hard to learn from. Presentations were made with content directly from the book, then basically just read from the slides. He does provide good examples of what he teaches on.
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Literally such a great professor! He's a great guy and always manages to slip a few jokes into lecture if you're paying attention. If you don't enjoy lecture-heavy courses this may not be for you, but I felt he kept things interesting and covered a wide range of topics. He also tells you exactly what to study for exams, which is so helpful.

Lectures are SO boring and dry. It's still important to go to class because he gives a lot of extra info and examples. I wouldn't recommend skipping often but you may want to make a friend to share notes with. He tells you exactly what is on the exam and you should go to office hours before the exam and he will give more hints and clarify things.

Take PSY 101 with this professor and you will have nap time twice a week. He is monotone and just shows videos. When it comes to the tests, the questions are formatted poorly and just leave you confused. The material is dry, and seems outdated. Many things could be improved on.
reviews.rating_tags: GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Tests are tough--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: This prof was a di$k to me. Asked him after class about a question and told me "that is something you just just "get" in this chapter" - to which I responded, that's you job. Surprised to see all of the great commented after my experience, but who knows. Easy enough for a good grade, just a di@k to me I suppose.

His lectures are not straight from the book, which is nice. He also explains things in detail to help people understand. He enjoys questions and never treats people like they are stupid. He even gets stumped by questions but returns the next class with some kind of answer.
Plenty of opportunity for questions, and he'll never make you feel stupid for opening your mouth-he's always open to new points of view.
Need to read the book and go to class/take notes - but a 4.0 isn't too hard if you do these things.
loved him. you should go to class and take notes since a lot isn't included in the lectures.
Way too political for a Psychology class, his political tangents drove me nuts and were not helpful to my understanding of psychology.  Boring class.
posted his lectures online, but said a lot in class that wasn't in lecture.  he definitely requires you to attend lecture and take notes, but tells you what is on the exam right before it.

As far as I've found, his is the psychology lecture at state. He is easily relatable and funny (brings pictures of his cat). I would definitely take a class with him again. Super helpful, and a professor who is in it because he truly loves it.
Very friendly and helpful person. I really learnt a lot from his class.
lectures are interesting and helpful. with his teaching you barely even need the book. if you enjoy psychology then you will enjoy this class.

awsome prof.  can't say enough great things about the guy.  he's nice, his lectures are funny and cute and he really, really will take the time to talk to you.  i studied hard for his class, but he made studying easy because lectures are so clear.
Complete Waste of Time!! Babbles.
fun and witty prof.  lots of little demos to keep you awake.  always interesting
very advanced Power point presentations make lecture more interesting, learnalot

literal GOAT -  class is a lot of work but if you pay attention in class it is so easy. genuinley take advantage of her teaching style and really try to learn bc the professors for acc202 genuinley dont teach and just excpect you to have learned the topics previously or through the reading. She also offers extra credit throughout the semester.

I am not a big fan of ACC but she made it manageable. She gives a lot of practice test and good homework that aligns. The exams do make or break your grade so make sure not to study last minute. But the TAS are super nice and will help you out a lot. You also get 3 recitation drops which is really nice.

Best professor i've ever had. She genuinely cares about the students and wants kids to succeed. Exams are tough but not impossible if preparation is put in. Lots of due assignments so neither one thing is gonna make or break your grade in the class. Plenty of resources available to get help in the class if needed.

The grade i got reflects the effort i put in pretty much. She teaches well and is available for students outside of class, i just don't care much for accounting. 3-4 homework assignments a week, which make up a decent chunk of your grade. Exams were tough but not impossible as long as you study and prepare.
Just do what you are supposed to do and the class really isn't that bad. Like seriously

Allison was great! I missed a 4.0 by .09% cause I bombed the final, but I wouldn't say that was her fault. HW is easy if you keep up with it and her lectures actually help you understand the material. Super nice too! Go and talk to her after class sometimes

Allison is an amazing professor. As someone who was dreading taking accounting, she made the material easy to understand and organized the course in a way that helped me so much. There is a decent amount of work but if you stay on top of it and go to lectures you'll do fine!

I don't understand why some people are giving her bad reviews and genuinely think they just want to blame her for their shortcomings. Professor Dellapelle does a great job at explaining hard-to-understand concepts and overall is a fair grader. She provides lots of material to help with exams, and she models them after the unit practice questions.

Everyone here is blaming everyone but themselves for getting a bad grade, bc she is a great professor. Great teacher, accommodating, no issues with textbooks. If you take notes in lectures and participate in recitation, the class is a breeze. The lessons and homework are directly related. She lets you use a cheat sheet on every exam.

This class is tough but fair. Some didn't take it seriously and expected it to be easy, so go cry about it. Prof. Dellapelle is a perfectionist who cares about her students. She fixed the homework structure even though only a few had issues. Yeah, we paid $90, but mistakes happen and she handled it well.

There are only 2 quizzes and 2 exams throughout the entire course. SO it is VERY important to give assessments your all. She is not very homework heavy in the course but make sure to go to every lecture since they are very material heavy and she uses Iclicker.

Allison made us buy a $90 online book just to have us not use it for more than 2 weeks. I did extremely well on all assignments, and despite studying HARD I did absolutely terrible on the exams. The exams have trick questions and the study questions she gives are nothing like the exam questions. iClicker is worth a lot of your grade also!
She is a great lecturer with a lot of energy. The quizzes and exams barley correlate with the unit practices and homework. Seemed like the quizzes/tests were designed specifically to trick you.

Lectures were very fast paced and sometimes hard to keep up with. What got me through the semester was watching her lecture videos to take notes and doing the practice questions. There were about 16 points offered for extra credit which isn't a lot but it gave me the small boost that I needed in order to get a 4.0 in the course.

Dellapelle made us buy McGraw-Hill for nearly no use, only about 9 EC points, wasting our money. The class was disorganized, vague, and sloppy, leaving students feeling set up to fail despite putting in work. Expectations were unclear, grading lacked consistency, and the materials provided failed to align with what was on the exams.
Awful experience with her. amazed by how bad she is, do yourself a favor and find another acc 201 professor

I really liked her lectures, i think they were very engaging and informative. I think the material I learned from the class will help me a lot out into the future, but the quizzes and exams are just really different from practice quizzes, homework, and other assignments. It doesn't seem necessary to make the course like this.

Professor Dellapelle is a great teacher, and you should do well in the class if you are willing to put in the work to study. She gives a refined topic list before each quiz and exam which literally give you exactly which subjects you will be tested on, so just study those concepts before the exams and you'll be fine. Very engaging lectures.

I can genuinely say that I learned close to nothing in this class. The lectures, practice quizzes, & homework WILL NOT prepare you for assessments. Allison does examples in class without writing them down, says them and expects us to follow. Ironically, she takes ZERO accountability for our terrible class average. Save yourself and take it at LCC.

Honestly I think half of these reviews are bots or Allison herself. She tells us to prepare by going through each and every units practice quiz, but half of the questions on all these practice quizzes don't pertain to the final exam and only 2-3 out of the 20-25 practice questions on each of the unit quizzes is actually on the exam.

Allison is one of the best professors I have had at MSU. She offers a bit of extra credit, but generally the material in this class is complicated, but she engages with her students and truly cares. If you prepare for the exams, you should learn how these exams work over the semester. Allison truly cares about her students and their outcomes.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Accounting sucks, but Dellapelle is amazing. She's a very engaging lecturer and sets clear expectations of what you should be doing to succeed. If you follow her advice and pay attention in class, you'll do really well. Resources like help room, office hours, and HiTA were accessible and incredibly helpful. She wants everyone to do well.

Professor is a solid teacher who explains things very well, while also being extremely organized. However, tests are pretty hard, and material is not directly covered in class. Along with that, purchased a half-cooked McGraw hill class that did not work, and then abandoned it 3 weeks into the semester.

The class is hard but Mrs.Dellapelle is amazing. She is so organized and concise. If you pay attention during lecture and follow her very clear instructions on how to succeed you will do really good in the class.

This class is very challenging. She teaches it as if we aren't beginners in accounting. It is very frustrating because the homework does not match up with the quizzes and exams at all which is very deceiving. She doesn't seem to care at all if you pass or fail the class.

I did not vibe with her, the class itself is hard without her horrible teaching. She is bad at explaining and just tells you to copy her notes and explain it at the end instead of going through the problem with you. She makes rude, sly comments throughout the lectures. The class is structured very poorly and there needs to be change.

The homework consists of overwhelming Excel worksheets and quizzes with only 3 attempts. I can fill out the worksheet but still get questions wrong on the quiz, learning nothing. Additionally, after-class quizzes only allow one attempt, and you can't see your score until the next day, preventing immediate feedback and clarity.

People writing reviews and given their opinions early in the semester of spring 25 are invalid. Professor Dellapine is an awesome professor with CPA licensing to back up her credentials. People saying the exams or quizzes don't match up to the material are wrong and are incompetent of understanding accounting is hard. Too challenging? Switch majors

all the other ratings seem like they're from the professor herself or bots trying to make her look good. She has a long way to go from being a great professor. 50% class avg on first quiz, poor preparation and guidance, rushed lectures, sits there and tries to justify a 50% avg, apologized more times to the class than any teacher ive seen. a mess.

The tests are difficult and dont match up anything on the recitations or homeworks. She purposfully underprepares students and sets them up for failure for the tests, then after the quizzes she goes over what we COULD'VE done after its already way too late.

Good professor. Explained things well in class. Recitation leads were solid, but Allison did a good job of ensuring they were not responsible for teaching course material, but were responsible with teaching the application of content. Well ran course. I'd highly recommend her as a professor.

This class is not easy by any means, however, if I wanted anyone to teach me these concepts it would be from Instructor Dellapelle. She is so knowledgeable and while the concepts can be challenging, she explains them in the best way possible. Her course pack is so organized and helpful. The exams are hard, but if you study you will do great !
Great prof gave every opportunity to succeed. Weekly HW but not too much

Her class is very well put together. The content of this class is naturally difficult but she does a great job at trying to explain things and breaking them down into smaller concepts. Lecture is mandatory with 5 drops. Homework is not bad and exams are ok, be sure to study off of the refined topic list she basically tells you all the questions.

Allison is an amazing professor. Always brings positive energy to class and is an all around great person. Accounting is not easy but she makes it bearable and is very passionate about what she teaches. As long as you come to class and do your homework, you will do fine in this class.

This class is a cakewalk if you show up. Brings in lots of industry speakers, and is very knowledgeable on the subject. Easy class for those who want to learn more about careers in accounting, and weekly quizzes are easy to do.

The class accounting 250-001 was extremely difficult, Mrs. Dellapelle made it very tough for me to pass the course. She did not seem to care about my well being in the class or helping me succeed in the class. I would not recommend this or any class with this professor, by far the worst experience I'v had. She should be excluded from her position.
She is a wonderful professor and as long as you attend lectures and complete the homework on your own, you will do fine in this course.

This class sucks. She goes wayyyy too fast when lecturing. The exam are 20 questions 50 mins so barely any time. They grade homework kinda hard as well. Also the homework is nothing like the exam so I don't understand why they give us it. Definitely a harder class as she does not dropped any exams as well.
She was amazing!!

I respect this professor, however I found her class very challenging.  The lectures were rushed and the exams were time demanding and different than the reviews.  I get it accounting is hard, but I was not able to learn the material well the way she taught the class. Hardest Broad class I have taken thus far.

Dellapelle was easily one of the best professors I have had at MSU, very knowledgeable and passionate about the content. Sometimes speeds through the lectures, but started recording them at the end. Exams are hard, definitely doable. One thing...even if you attend every recitation, to get 100% on recitation engagement you have to ask questions.
Such a good professor. The class is hard but the way she organizes it and goes through the course pack is great.

Allison was my favorite professor so far at MSU. She is super genuine and is clearly passionate about teaching. We took 3 midterm exams and 1 final which are curved. There is a mandatory course pack that she wrote herself that covers all the material for the course. Overall, the course was very organized and managed by a great professor.
Dellapelle was the best instructor I have had. She taught accounting extremely well, and the recitation leaders were amazing. If you focus during lectures and study well it is not bad.
Dellapelle teaches accounting very well, and she is a great professor. She also picked the best ULA's for recitation.
Professor Dellapelle clearly understands the material inside and out and is able to explain it in an engaging and effective manner.

Great professor, and makes an incredibly difficult class somewhat digestible. She truly wants her students to succeed and is incredibly nice. Lectures are fast but she does her best to break it down in an understanding way.

She is knowledgeable and passionate about accounting but speeds through lectures making them impossible to learn from. Exams are pretty challenging, had to learn the material all on my own. Homework assignments are nothing like what we learn in class or what is on the exams. Go to help rooms.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I could say the class is easy, or I could say that the material was explained so well and so well understood that the class seemed easy. Isn't that the goal as a good teacher to ensure students are learning all the material? Mission accomplished.

Clearly passionate about her lectures and it shows, they were all super easy to follow and interesting. The 2 Homework assignments are fun and don't take much time. In class participation assignments create interesting discussions, and students go to the MSU bug house at the end of the semester!

I adored Professor Lorenz! She was incredibly gracious with RCPD extensions, and provided stress-free assignments. Every quiz and test was open resource, with plenty of time to complete the task. Lectures were engaging and interesting. She felicitated a calming learning environment while also sharing her passions. I cannot recommend enough!

LOVEDDD Dr. Lorenz! She is very sweet and funny. This is an online class held over zoom so you'll have daily in class participation and pre-class readings, 3 home work, and 4 exams (all of which are open note). Genuinely enjoyed this class as her lectures are interesting and you can tell she is passionate about her work. Could not recommend enough!

The class is good, it is pretty easy and she is clear on student expectations. Dr. Lorenz is kind and very passionate about what she teaches. The only thing I struggled with is the way she talked about politics and was pretty divisive

Prof Lorenz is super friendly and clearly loves teaching her class. All you have is 3 exams which are open note, 2 homework assignments, 3 question preclass quizzes, and in class participation. She teaches well so all the information is easy to understand and you visit the bug house at the end of the semester. 10/10 prof

Super fun and interesting class. Next to no homework, and what we had was super easy. Exams were open note. Lectures were collaborative and not just her speaking to us. Very good professor, really fun class. Would definitely recommend taking this class.

Dr. Lorenz has a clear system of operation for her class, but it is easy, fun, and engaging! She has a lot of love for the material she teaches and it shows. Her lectures are very clear and informative and the in-class participation that she requires is good review of topics discussed. Pay attention in lecture and you will do well :)
This class made me enjoy exploring the outdoors once again and I had so much fun admiring all the bugs she brought to class to shows us. 10/10 Professor
Amazing professor. Very obviously passionate about her work and the subject being taught and will always answer questions if asked.
Dr. Lorenz is a great professor. This class was an easy A, just attend the zoom meetings and do the participation. Slightly boring but you can tell Dr. Lorenz is very passionate about what she does.

Awesome prof and person. Super kind and receptive to questions. You can tell she's very passionate about entomology and that directly translates into her teachings. I wish grades were updated more frequently, but besides that, she's amazing.
Dr. Lorenz is a very kind professor and cares for her students. She let us take our exams at any time of the day and only had two homework assignments. She gives many points for attendance.

I have struggled in every high school science class I have ever taken and this teacher truly turned that around for me! She breaksdown concepts Into digestible material. if you really care about how you do, so will she. If you put in the work, you will do great. Definitely an easier science for those of you who are not chemists. Sweetest professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Seriously one of the best teachers I had. For being an online class, this teacher truly cares so much about her students. She is responsive on email an always accessible out of class. Science is not a strong subject of mine and I was nervous to take this class. I can seriously say I have learned so much and enjoyed it all because of this teacher!
I learned a lot of things about bugs in Dr. Lorenz's class both interesting and things that will be useful to know for my future career! The bug house visit was especially enjoyable!

Dr. Lorenz was great!! Her lectures are easy to follow, assignments are few and far between, and exams are short, usually multiple choice, and open note. You can tell she is very passionate about what she teaches, and is genuinely excited each day to teach her students. Would 100% take a class of hers again.

Before every class there is a reading quiz that is 3 questions based on a short article you have to read. In class there are in-class participation questions you have to answer in zoom chat. Every class is worth 5 points, and you get 3 drops, exams are online and open note, you have the entire day to complete it. Take this class for ISB requirement

Dr. Lorenz was by far one of the best professors I've had a Michigan State. She is very personable and her lectures are entertaining and engaging. Her passion about the material really shows and makes lectures really fun.

great professor. i took this biology course as an easy A, and i got that easy A. she's very laid back and relaxed and her teaching style reflects that as well. the material and the course is easy, and she's very caring and understanding. ellie was also a wonderful guest to see from time to time.

Great professor and cares about students doing well. You can trust that she has the best interest for everyone and the class is pretty easy. Weekly reading assignments that take less than 5 minutes, and a few exams that are online.

Amanda was so sweet and I loved listening to other lectures. Super short quiz with articles before each class, 2 homework assignments, and open note tests throughout the semester. My favorite part of the lectures was getting to see her dog Ellie. If you have the chance to take a class with Amanda, do it!

She is a great professor and I loved her lectures. The course is very easy and simple, but I still learned a lot. My only complaint is I do think she's a bit hard to reach which can be quite annoying as it was an async class. Though, nothing that was make or break with my grade.

Sooo nice and caring, clearly loves her students/teaching/this class, super fun lectures. Much of the class is completion/participation based, and the tests are very easy. The 2 major homework assignments are fun or at least not difficult. At the end of the semester you get to visit the MSU bug house during class hours which is so much fun.

Very lenient and caring, she asked what topics were difficult before the final exam and adjusted the exam accordingly. There's like 2 homework assignments, open-note tests, and participation grades. Took it online and she showed lots of enthusiasm for the material!
This class was interesting and would be hard to fail. Prof. Lorenz is awesome, funny, and a compelling lecturer. Visit the bug house!

She never answers emails. Like hellooo what's ur job. she takes forever to grade. not mean or difficult but she annoying for never answering my emails or anyone elses. like your not the president of the united states. andwer emails
Very good lectures, not much homework but the homework that you do have is honestly pretty interesting.

Prof Lorenz is the sweetest! She teaches clearly and answers any and all questions. She loves to discuss with students, and keeps lecture interesting. Attendance is needed because a lot of your grade is in class participation. There are extra credit opportunities, but you might not even need them! This class is fun and easy to pass.
Absolute gem, and her dog is adorable. Class is an easy A.

I loved her!! This class was somewhat interesting because she is so much fun and wants everyone to learn. She makes every class fun and she is also so funny so that makes it more fun. There are 3 exams which include the final. There are 2 homework assignments and before every class, you have to do an easy reading quiz. Super easy and she is so nice
Exams were easy and open note, Lorenz is a good lecturer and I never had a problem hearing back from her.
Class is extremely easy and she's lenient with her grading on the homework's. Class should be an easy 4.0

Took this class online for Fall 2021, one of the easiest class I had so far, there are 3 unit exams and 1 cumulative final exam in which are all open book test with multiple choice questions; theres one or two assignments, the assignments are easy to complete, took me about 20 minutes. Dont really require much memorization, just general concept.

She is a very good professor and easy grader. I had technical difficulties and emailed her and let me turn in the assignment late without grade deductions. Highly recommend taking her for ENT205 for the bioscience credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Prof. Lorenz is truly the most caring professor I have ever had! She truly cares about her students and their success. Very easy class- easy 4.0. Exams were open note/open resource. She is very willing to help students outside of class. Would take her class again!
I don't even really rate professors but she was so good I wanted to go on here and give a good rating :) Really easy class as long as you participate
Assignments are easy (at least online they are). Professor is so nice and understanding.

Lorenz is an amazing professor. Had her for ent205 and the class was very easy and I learned a lot. Never thought I would be interested in bugs but she makes it interesting and fun to learn. Most of the grade is determined on in class participation, so if you show up you're in good shape. She's very well educated and kind.

She is very caring and demonstrates her enthusiasm during her lectures. Combines videos along with her powerpoints to make the lecture more fun. Exams are easy as long as you study. She does not try to trick you on the exams they are quite simple. Easy 4.0 as long as you do the work.

Easiest ISB 201 class if you are willing to show up to class. She does in class papers for attendance (so easy you barely have to pay attention) basically your entire grade is attendance, a few 1 page papers & exams. The exams are very very easy. Super kind prof! Highly recommend her but dont get stuck in the 8:30am you wont make it.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment:
if this class isn't something that genuinely interests you or you don't have to take it for your major, DON'T. 

The professor talks way too fast for you to keep up with notes and has "study guides" that equate to you answering 20 questions plus 30 definitions for each slideshow (when you have like six slideshows per exam). 

would not recommend.

Although the class was easy, the lectures were extremely long and boring. She is very caring and wants everyone to succeed but also claimed half the class used AI on an assignment during finals week. Mind you, there is nothing in the class that is so hard you need AI. Do the learning objectives and the first test is the hardest. You will be fine.

She is extremely sweet and caring, however I was not a fan of having my grade plummet a day before they were due because of "AI". She changed it back to a 4.0, however I was extremely stressed and stayed on a Zoom forever. If you read the textbook and use it to study, you will 4.0 the class. The lectures are long and extremely boring.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is very against any technology, if she assumes you use AI you will be in trouble. Poor communicator as well. In class she just lectures which can be hard to follow, on tests she expects you know everything.

She's very traditional so she hates technology and AI, BE CAREFUL and do NOT use AI you WILL be in trouble. Tests are somewhat hard because she expects you to know everything taught in lecture. Lectures are boring but mandatory. SO much extra credit, take advantage and you will 4.0. I can see why people didn't 4.0 this class, but it's achievable.

accused like 100 students of using ai because our writing was “generic” and threatened to give everyone an academic dishonesty report. then had us join zoom office hours to talk about it with her and I had to wait 4 hours to even get to my turn. not even joking. put everyone in a stressful situation for something she had no proof of.

accused a bunch of other students for using ai with no proof. Don't take this class unless it is required for your major because it is a huge waste of time. She was nice-ish but can come off kinda rude. She sped through lectures so I had to teach myself most of the material.
Accused many students of using AI with ZERO evidence. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS UNLESS YOU NEED TO!!!!!!

She accused so many people of AI without reason, then her excuse was "your writing is generic". Is it AI or generic? She emailed saying that she had a list of people that used Ai, but that she wasn't going to tell anyone. We are not mind readers. Her teaching is bad and she should feel bad.
Accused a bunch of students of "using AI" in a diet assignment. The night before grades, she messed up a bunch of students' grades. Run for your life and do NOT take her class
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: She is not good at teaching. Lectures are all over the place and fast paced. She gives way too much info that doesn't even show up on the exams. I did well only because I taught myself with the learning objectives and studied them for the exams. Don't take this class if you haven't taken many classes about the human body, I found it somewhat hard.

I did very well on all of the exams (over 80%) and did every single thing that was required of me and still couldn't 4.0 it. So much was required just for a 3 credit class. She seems super sweet but class structure is bad. You have to get a 92% just to 4.0 this class. Even a 90% for physiology is considered an A. Ridiculous for a nutrition class.

Attendance is mandatory, these lectures are pointless. She talks about nonsense,wastes time on things that have no significance to exams, and is an overall waste of time. Sweet lady, but to succeed, use her class as a study hall for your other classes and put in the extra work for these exams on your own time because the lectures will not help you.

Awful. Class is not hard but the prof is awful, disorganized, annoying, cannot stay on topic, cannot teach, etc... Very passive aggressive, slides have a million words on them. Material is easy but the prof makes it painful.
there is a lot of material in this class that you need to memorize, but if you are interested in nutrition and biology, you will enjoy this class

The class itself wasn't very hard; however Alaimo made it painful every class. Talks way too much about things that do not matter to the class and never finishes the material. She should not be a teacher here at MSU. Based on her ratings, I'm sure many students would agree.

as somebody who never read a page in the textbook, i did ok in the class. her exams are easy if you study for them. but her teaching is very disorganized and i feel like i was never able to retain anything she was saying during lecture because she would yap about things that were insignificant and not related to the topic we were learning about
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Alaimo is clearly passionate about the subject and is friendly with students. However, her lectures are extremely tedious, she goes off on tangents and tries to cram too much information into too short of a time. There's a lot of busywork, and the D2L is disorganized. Nice person, rough professor.

Despite what other people have said, I actually loved professor Alaimo. She is a very quarky person and loves what she teaches. I though that this class was super easy to understand if you actually went to the lectures and listened. I would take this class again in a heartbeat.

Lectures were 2 hours and torture. Grading was hard, and projects had us evaluate our own diets and it seemed extreme. She got on tangents and would add/remove things from exams without telling. The book was more helpful than the lectures 100% will never take any of her courses ever again. Content was fun and exciting to learn, but she ruined it.

reviews.comment: took this class last semester, and I really enjoyed her as a professor she cares a lot about the content and her students her TAs would host reviews/study sessions before exams, and they were super helpful. Tbh if you're having a hard time in the class you probably thought it was going to be a blow off class and are just pissed you had to do work.

she's extremely unorganized and never finished lecture on time. has a crazy amount of material during each lecture and expects you to remember all of it for the exams, which are so hard to study for. goes off topic often and overall, a bad lecturer. also, a 4.0 is a 92%. don't take this class unless you absolutely have to, it's not worth it !!!!!!

Every single thing I learned in this class I taught myself. Just don't take it unless you absolutely have to for your major. She is a terrible lecturer and the TA's act like you harmed them in a past life when grading. Absolutely a waste of my time, would have rather done any other class as an elective.

reviews.comment: Exam heavy assignments are weighted light. Over 80 on each exam and ending with 3.5 not bad but still. Super nice lady but she's all over the place and better off teaching material yourself. Never read the textbook... Unless this is something you're interested in take a different elective

I have never put so much work into a class, done well, and still not received a 4.0. This class is very lecture heavy but the learning objectives are the key for the exams. I would receive 80's on all the exams and then got all the extra credit and it still wasn't enough for a 4.0. There are not enough small assignments to have a 4.0 be a 92%.

reviews.comment: too much lecture, too much studying, too much finals, too much that I all I remember is this class was jokes. Dont take it with this prof, she wasnt mean or bad. It was just too ritardando.

reviews.comment: She is very passionate about this subject, but class is not taught well and she rushes lectures. She speaks at you and expects retention based on that. I found this class more difficult to study for than my 300/400 courses. She doesn't post lectures, slides don't match learning objectives, test questions are very specific & difficult to study for.

very nice lady but the class is genuinely impossible. i have not gotten above a 50% on the exams and i have studied for hours every single time. i use every study guide or review resource that she offers and it never ever works. genuinely, if its not required for you to take DONT'T TAKE HNF 150 with this prof

She has long, very information heavy lectures and can be scattered at times, but she has really good information. I think the way she lectures takes time to get used to becuase she goes really fast but once you get it you like it. There is extra credit oppertunities almost every week so definitely do them because they add up.

her lectures are pointless and she talks about the most random things. be ready to teach yourself. alot of memorization. learning objectives are hard to answer because nothing on the slides line up with it. she doesnt posts the slides until after class which is so annoying. also keeps you in class until the very very end. annoying.

This class is so easy just search up a quizlet for exams. Lectures are a waste of time but I just did other work in class to get the IClicker. If you have 2 braincells you will be fine. Professor Alaimo cares a lot about the class but is easy to tune out.

reviews.comment: She goes off topic. Just study the learning objectives that she posts. Dietary Assessment Assignment can kiss my a**.

Respectfully, Dr. Alaimo is incredibly annoying. She loves going off-topic, gives off a "morally superior" attitude, and she keeps you to the end of class even when there is no more content. More than half of this class felt like a waste of time every day. Very information heavy, and half of it shouldn't even be included in an intro course.

If you care about your grade, trust me do not take her class.

- Lots of writing and writing for homework
- Crazy amount of memorization
- A lot to revise for test and 80% of what you study won't be on the test
EXTREMELY STRICT GRADER, takes away 50% of your assignment grade even if your just 30 minutes late. WARNING, do not take.
Awful. Do not take.

This class was all over the place. It felt rushed and disorganized. Grades took forever to get back. However, there were lots of extra credit opportunities. There was a lot of information covered in lectures, but only a small amount of that was on the Learning Objectives used for exams. She cares a lot about her students but isnt the best professor

This class is very test-heavy and requires lots of memorization. Exams focus on tiny details and everyone study not to learn but pass the test. The professor is fine but ineffective, and the TAs are unhelpful, slow to respond, and grade harshly. If you're still deciding, trust me—don't take it.

fun class if you're in medicine. She's very sweet but not good at teaching; she stutters too much, and there's too much information to memorize. For a 3-credit class, it's a lot, but it is manageable if you study and keep up each week. Exams are hard, but people over exaggerate difficulty of the class. You just have to teach EVERYTHING to yourself
This class is genuinely awful and I feel bad for those who are taking it because they know what I'm talking about.

reviews.comment: She just rambles the entire lecture and does not do anything to actually help you learn. You're much better off taking the attendance points lost and going over the material yourself outside of class.

Do not take this class unless it's required!! The professor goes through the slides way too fast, making it hard to keep up, and she constantly gets off topic about things that won't even be on the exam. This class drove me up the wall every week because of how much homework she assigned.

This class was so boring I had to force myself to go each time. The professor always got off track, so I never knew what I should or should not be taking notes on and the tests really depended on notes from class. She gave a lot of homework assignments that were basically unnecessary and weren't very helpful.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Alaimo does go on rants during her lectures and the class itself is mandatory to attend along with she reads off slides, but the class itself is easy. She does not give a lot of homework, and if she does you have a lot of time and can get extra credit. If you study the learning objectives you're guaranteed to do well. I believe she is overhated

Rude to students. Extremely insensitive to student circumstances. Attendance is mandatory. Annoying class, can't believe it is only for one-credit. Don't take this class unless you need to. Very specific questions for the exams.

This class is super easy if you simply pay attention, actually go to class and listen, read the D2L announcements, and study. There were minimal assignments/homework, which left lots of study time. I LOVED Dr. Alaimo; she is so passionate and truly cares about the subject, and it really showed. 10/10 class, I looked forward to it every week!
gets off topic all the time and her lectures are hard to pay attention to. u need to go to class because u will miss all of the notes since they are posted on d2l last minute

Super kind but incredibly disorganized with her lectures, constantly went off topic and discussed things that had nothing to do with the actual tests or assignments in class.  Going to lectures is pointless but required for attendance points.  Creates her tests based off of learning objectives alone, so study those over her lecture notes.

Her lectures are all over the place; Ta doesn't help. Her exams are so challenging for no apparent reason; there's just so much information to memorize. I spent hours studying for this class, yet I still performed the worst in all my classes. She slurs and makes no sense. There's 20 learning objectives per week, so good luck. I had to teach myself

reviews.comment: This may be the worst class I've taken at MSU. This isn't hard; the teacher is just awful. Can not stay on topic for the life of her. You can tell she cares about the class; however, she is a horrible professor. Lots of random and unnessry assignments. I took this class as a random elective, as I am a major in Kinesiology. Painful class
Don't take this class! She gives a lot of unnecessary homework, the homework isn't in one spot it's in different links in D2L, her instructions are all over the place and unclear.

There is so much content in this class that it's almost impossible to study all of it. The exams were decently hard. I got 80s on the exams and got a 3.5 which I'm not mad at but I studied really hard and that was the best grade I could get. Beware.

Would not recommend to freshmen or sophomores. Only taken if it's your major. She talks incredibly fast and fails to stay on topic. Genuinely one of the worst teachers I have ever had. Her lecture notes are all over the place and her “study guides” aren't anything but helpful. Just plan on studying every topic from her class, which is A LOT.

Expect 30-40 slides per lecture. You will be given learning objectives, practice quizzes, and assignments that don't help with her tests at all. The questions are easy, but you go over so much information you won't know what to study. Her emails are curt, and she refused to round my grade 6 pts for a 1000 pt class. Not helpful in the slightest.

Annoying. Whether it be her voice, teaching style, or pushing her own ideas, it was not enjoyable to be in class. Would often get off topic and ramble about random things which made paying attention is class very difficult.

She is one of my favorite professors I've had. She truly cares about nutrition and her students. She provides a few extra credit options, mostly if you turn things in before a certain date. She can get off topic/ ramble a bit, but for an hour and 20 minute class, it keeps things interesting sometimes.

Dr. Alamio is a very nice lady who has a passion for what she teaches.The class isn't super hard as long as you do your work, the exams just suck. There is a ton of content on each exam but if you study you should be fine. Alamio doesn't really make it easier cause her lecture slides can be all over the place and include unnecessary things.

Nice lady, but no idea how to teach. Hour and 20 min lecture of her rambling about random things. Most of what she talks about isn't on the exam. She gives extra credit opportunities and all the material you need to do well on the exams. The problem is the lecture is useless with her teaching so you have to do majority of the learning on your own

The class would have been much easier to learn and understand with a different professor. The professor is very scatter-brained and has trouble speaking in sentences that are understandable. She does not record the lectures which makes is very hard to learn because you cannot go back and listen to her explain topics that are hard.

She is an amazing professor who is passionate about nutrition and improving people's lives through teaching. She's kind and approachable, but her class is very hard. I don't know why people have said that it's easy, because I definitely spent the most time on her class outside class. As long as you study and keep up each week it's fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: While she is very nice and does care, she spends class talking about things that don't matter. She puts a lot of material into the tests and the lectures are all over the place so you might study for something that isn't even on the test. Free food though

Gave out too many assignments by accident & deducted points earned from them last minute. Goes on tangents and wastes lecture time with information that isn't on exams. Lots of content between exams, does not often tell what is important and what isn't for exams. Assignments aren't hard. Use lecture notes, not the textbook. Would not recommend her.

reviews.comment: Dr. Alaimo is a great professor! She's very kind and always available to answer questions and clearly loves teaching about nutrition. Exams are difficult and the lectures are jam packed with information, but if you pay attention and study enough, you should be fine. Overall, a difficult class but worth it in my opinion.

Talks way too much about stuff that doesn't matter to anyone but her. Drones on and gets off topic very often. Gives too much buys work and loads of content to memorize. Very difficult to pay attention and do well in this class. I would not recommend taking this class unless you absolutely need to.

This teacher is the absolute worst professor I have taken here within all 4 years of my schooling here. She gives wayyy too much material for the tests that she gives- weeks of lecture notes (half of which aren't even on the test), the book readings, the learning objectives, the readings and the vocabulary terms. Office hours are useless too! GL :)
Lectures are not helpful and the slides do not match what she says. Nice though

Very boring lectures with a lot of information thrown at you. Her voice is annoying and she talks for way too long about things that won't be on the exam and are frankly uninteresting. There's a ton of memorization required so it's a lot of work for what should be a pretty easy class. Don't take unless you have to.

Dr. Alaimo is great. Her lectures tend to be long and she rambles a bit she gives outlined notes that are fill in the blank so you're not copying info down off the slides. For a 100 level course there is quite a bit of studying but I wouldn't let that shy you away from taking the class. As along as you study and keep up with the HW you'll do fine.

she is sweet but talks a lot. exams are hard and the "study guide" is every learning objective/term which is A LOT. just don't take this class if you are not prepared to spend a long time studying. she does offer a lot of extra credit to improve your grade! the exams are my only complaint

I loved professor Alaimo. She offers so much extra credit and it is so easy too. The tests are heavily based on lectures and the book. She is super easy to approach too, and she really gets to the point. She also made us food in class to try and expand our taste! I took this for a requirement, but it could have been worse!

She's nice but talks a LOT. Do every extra credit assignment and you should have a good cushion as exams can be a bit difficult. Pay attention and take notes, use quizlets to study, and this should be a very easy class, besides studying for exams (three are mandatory) I hardly spent any time on this class outside of lecture. Super easy if you try!

Dr. Alaimo was okay, I actually really liked her as a person. However, the way she taught and the style of her classroom was just not good. Every lecture consisted of her reading off slides for the entire hour and a half. The good thing is that there are Quizlets for every exam and if you study and do all the work, you will get a good grade.

Everyone saying she was a bad professor just didn't put in the work. I will say the amount of content and memorization was more than my non-elective classes that count towards my major. Wouldn't take this class again but the tests were easy as long as you actually studied. Classes were boring and very long IMO.

Prof. Alaimo is a very sweet person but I could not stand her teaching style for me personally. The class is very dull and she just reads off the slides. I think the content is interesting but the way it is presented is very disorganized. She says a textbook is required but it really is not, I never picked it up once and I still received an A

Very kind and wants students to succeed. Lectures are sometimes long and all over the place. Learning objectives and key terms are very helpful for exams. I recommend going over these terms and objectives prior to lectures, or else it can be hard to follow.  Not too much busy work - some discussion boards and quizzes.  A lot of content to memorize.

She is a very sweet teacher and I love her as a person, but at the same time sometimes class is so hard to not sleep in. There are some fun things like our food days and also special guests. Overall she teaches well but it is a lot of memorization.

While Dr alaimo is not deserving of all the negative comments in this feed, she is not accessible outside of class, she teaches poorly based entirely around long boring lectures, and this has been the most dull class Ive taken over my 3 years at MSU. This class is incredibly easy and her exams throw no surprises at you. Just study a quizlet

Ignore the negative comments, Dr. Alaimo is great. This course is all memorization, don't be lazy. There are about a billion online quizlets with every potential exam question. Homework takes max 10 minutes. Do not buy the textbook. Attendance is counted. SO much extra credit offered. She is a fun professor and highly recommend this class!

It's a really interesting class but there is so much to study for and professor Alaimo really just reads from the slides so it makes attending the class pretty dreadful. It's really easy to study for and the tests are super easy. Barely any homework but don't waste money on the book because everything you need is in the lecture slides
Lectures carried too much information in a small amount of time
