reviews.comment: Good. Good.
Nice.
love love love.
Very helpful and insightful on semester assignments-would not do my paper for me but showed me the right path to walk down to get the right grade. Blaschke and Rypkema are a good team.
She is a young teacher but is very good at becoming a great teacher. She is very helpful and insightful on questions I have asked her. Hands down a good teacher.

The professor was very nice and the class was easy 6 reflections and 6 open note quizzes. The only thing that was hard was the quizzes included a lot of stuff that wasn't talked about in class and very niche things from the book. The questions were also worded weird.

Kelley absolutely changed the trajectory of my college journey. As a psychology major, I was interested in taking this class, and now I am a double major in social work because of it. She brings in guest speakers, and she herself has a significant amount of experience in the field. Quizzes are easy and every other week, and papers every other week!

She was very sweet! There was one guest speaker a week, and homework was split between short online quizzes and short written responses. A very easy course, but she did a lot to keep it interesting. I had no problem reaching her outside of class hours, and she was flexible about attendance, grades, due dates, etc.

loved professor Blanck, most students weren't very interactive, but she was. The class is easy and catered to the social work major. she uses guest speakers to teach about real world experiences working in differing social work types, very accommodating. assignments are very easy. only downside is passing with a 93% which is only a 3.5

ignorant to how difficult the materials she has us work with are or doesn't care but either way in this class we had to work using foreign techniques to us w/o practice and are critiqued and graded. Graded on many aspects that it's hard to keep straight what needs to be added and hardly gives any in class time to work. WAY too much for a100 class
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I really enjoy Prof. Blesing's class. I overall enjoyed her helpful feedback and the class was very motivating for artistic expression, though sometimes you felt you needed to bend your work to fit some of her preferences. You can probably get through this class without purchasing the art kit, she supplies many of the needed tools and resources.

I had a great experience in Rebekahs class she is a wonderful professor. She pushes her students to dive deep and think critically about their projects. Almost every class period you will have an opportunity to work on projects/homework.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Online Savvy--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: She was a really nice professor. I'm not a studio art major, so I was nervous about taking a sculpture class as a requirement for my major, but she was really helpful and provided good guidance throughout every assignment. The kit for the class was really expensive however, and we didn't use half of what was in it - buy materials as you go.

I enjoyed taking Rebekah's class. She seems passionate about presenting new projects. She gives excellent suggestions but has more or of a "figure it out as go" approach. I would love to take another one of her classes in the future :)
Good class with easy assignments, but gets cancelled all. the. time. it became disorganized quickly and confusing to stay on track with deadlines because class was cancelled so often.
You literally will not go to class, she canceled class every single week. I went to class maybe 5 times, IF that
Cancelled class last minute so many times.

She cancels all the time very last minute so don't take an 8 am class with her. Her class is very easy. She will make you read outload sometimes and work in groups or partners. All work is easy and there is never homework.

If you're into creative work and open to learn new perspectives, take this class! She is fun, caring, and despite some of the students making this class difficult for her because of circumstances unrelated to the class, she is empathetic and a kind grader. I loved her!

She was a good person, but the amount of times she cancelled class last minute was wild. Because my class was an 8:00 am, there was over ten times where I would be in the classroom and we would get an email saying class was cancelled, a few times even after class had started. The class itself was very disorganized, mostly due to many cancellations.

She was great! Super friendly and very engaging. Class was pretty easy, she would cancel class a lot but I was okay with it. Course work was simple and she was lenient on late work! Def recommend and would take a class with her again.

The professor is not all that bad. the class is easy and the writing assignments are not hard. For me, she did not come off as rude or have a bad attitude. She did however cancel class last minute a LOT or change it to Zoom that was extremely annoying. there is also a lot of reading in class and group discussions
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: If you can help it, don't enroll in a class with her as the professor! This professor is horrible at communicating and her attitude is also very unpleasant. The way that Professor Borha chose to run class this semester was always chaotic and unorganized to say the very least. Although the class itself is easy, she made it hard with her attitude.

Do NOT take this professor's class. She makes class online for no reason and lets you know the morning of. She never explains herself, adds random parts to the projects a day before it's due, and changes the due dates 100 times. She is very unclear about when things are due. Overall, this easy WRA 101 class is made complicated by this professor.

Bob Gould is one of the best professors I've had. He's a tough grader with high expectations, but if you participate and engage, the class is very enjoyable. His fun, goofy personality makes it interesting. The required video kit is expensive, but I would take this class again.

Bob is a good professor, but he switches up. One day he likes you the next he is so rude to you. The projects are a lot outside of class, so make sure you have time for that. He also teaches and grades like this is a 400-level course even though it's the beginning of journalism for a lot of students. Does get frustrated easily. Overall, a 6/10.

Bob is a charming and funny guy, he sometimes likes to talk about fun things at the beginning of class, which created a very open and welcoming environment; everyone seemed comfortable talking. He kinda expects a lot from a 200 level class and might get frustrated if everyone missed something, but he is very helpful and accessible outside class.

He is very passionate and has a good personality. I think he fails to take into account this is a beginner class and some of the things he has us doing is very complicated and he grades pretty harsh. If you miss one lecture, especially on a day were editing, it will be very hard to catch up. Also he is hard to reach outside of class.

He really does mean well, but towards the end of semester he will give you 2-3 projects to work on at the same time and they aren't super easy. Also he will only let you have 2 absenses or he will knock your grade .5 GPA.

One the most difficult graders I've ever had and grades as if it isn't an entry level course, expecting students to already be experts and grades just so. The equipment required is also very expensive, and the course is not well-organized or easy to navigate as a student. Don't take this class if you don't have to. Ruined my GPA.

I think Bob is a fantastic professor and cares a lot about students and their learning. His grading can be harsh, especially when you don't follow instructions EXACTLY, but he wants us all to succeed and create quality content rather than allowing us to put out something we aren't proud of. He's not easy, but that's why he's a great professor.

Seems like a nice enough guy, but the course organization was horrible. Very hard to navigate syllabus, find course instructions etc, and even then they were very unnecessarily complicated. He also seemed like he didn't know what was going on lol. It's easy once you figure out what you need to do, but just a very weird organization

He is a tough grader and attendance matters to him a lot. If you miss 2 classes, your final grade will go down .5. He gives a lot of projects and grades them tough if you don't do them exactly how he wants them. It is a 200 level class but feels like it is a 400 level class with the expectations.

Bob Gould is a good professor, but this class can be difficult. There is only one exam that you take at the end of the semester that covers everything. There are are weekly quizzes you take at home on D2L, and the writing assignments are relatively easy. He certainly makes the class interesting.
You'll think that you're doing well until you get your final grade. He's picky about details and doesn't take into account that you may be a beginner. He ruined my GPA.

Don't look at any of these low reviews. You have 4 exams the entire semester and they are 2 essays and a hybrid true and false section, that are both done online at home. uses iClicker but not for accuracy just for attendance purposes. Honestly, i loved the class, and professor black is a great instructor.

Despite the horror stories I read when signing up for my PLS course, I enjoyed Dr. Blacks course. If you don't do the readings and look at lectures, this class will probably be impossible. Attending and taking notes, doing the readings, and basic review should be enough for almost anyone to 3.0 the course with average effort.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I LOVED him. One of my favorite professors I've had at MSU. Exams 1-4 are online, and the final was in person. He was able to keep my ADHD brain focused even during an 8:30 am lecture.
The class is super interesting but be prepared to get a bad grade even if you do the work and pay attention. The exam questions are meant to be trick questions he is literally out to get you
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Legit my favorite class this semester, all you really have to do is pay attention to the lectures and do the exams. Exams can be hard, but he makes it easy to get half credit on questions, and you can pretty easily do decent as long as you know what's going on. Overall great prof!

Dr. Black is SO kind, funny, and such a great teacher. I am a journalism student with no interest in political science, and I was able to make it through this class. His lectures are great, and he is just an overall very likable guy.

He is a hard professor- but if you are planning on working in Policy, his lectures and coursework are completely fair. Takes up a good chunk of your time but he is so willing to help and lend a hand when needed!!!!!

i am in his online PLS 320 class right now, and can already say Professor Black is one of the best professors I have had in my 3 years at MSU. His lectures are very informational and he always gives some "fun facts" which I find interesting. He has one of the best set-ups of an online class that I have seen, and it is clear what is expected of you!

Don't waste your time with him! Go add the class with someone else this guy is hard grader doesn't round up the grade! I had 1% left and he didn't round up?! Just take it somewhere else I would not recommend! 4 years of college and this is one of the weirdest experiences with an online class. Hopefully MSU does something about him.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Probably one of the worst professors I've had at MSU.  His lectures were not only dated back in 2021, but they were just a boring yap-fest that made the subject not even remotely interesting and fun.  It also doesn't help that a majority of the lectures were him talking about his political science colleagues, which was super annoying.  AVOID!

His lectures were fantastic!! I took this online and loved it. Yes, there is work. If you actually watch the videos and read the writing will be insanely easy. The quizzes for each lecture are unlimited tries, and the midterm was multiple choice. This has been the best online class I have ever taken.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: I took the online version of this class during the summer semester, and I don't recommend it. Really one of the only professors I've had issues with during college. We just watched legal movies (Legally Blonde, etc), but it wasn't as fun as much as it might sound, as writing the papers dissecting these movies was a chore. Learned next to nothing.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Listen up, this class is NOT easy. Class is graded based on a midterm and final that include a multiple choice true/false section and 4 essays per exam and lecture/reading quizzes. Doing well is possible, but it will certainly test your limits!!! Make sure to do the reading and attend office hours. Prof is nice, but grading can be harsh at times.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Ryan was a really good professor. He has you read a book over the course of the semester which I cannot say I loved but his mandatory lectures made up for it. His lectures are incredibly entertaining and he makes everyone laugh throughout. Overall, the class was decently easy and he is an amazing guy.

ISS 325- Video Games and Revolution: I took this course over the summer.. it's interesting and fun (easier if you're a gamer), but it is SO MUCH WORK! There are only ten days per module and you must play through anywhere from 7-20 hours of a game, read the millions of articles assigned, quizzes, and papers.. all in 10 days.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--So many papers

reviews.comment: You only have a midterm and a final to be graded on. Those exams consist of 4 essays and 60 multiple choice questions, on top of the "multiple choice answers" are true, false, probably true, probably false, or I'm not sure. All the exams are graded by his TAs, but he gives you the option to ask for a regrade. You are able to lose points on regrade.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The worst professor I encountered at MSU. So many people in these ratings say how caring and engaging he is, but every lecture was recorded in 2021 and is outdated. 4 ULAs did all grading and made all tests. He put no effort into this course. Every lecture including his unimportant conscientiousness research will also be an additional hour.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Please do not make the same mistake I did and give him the benefit of the doubt. He is an awful professor and will destroy your gpa, mental health, and sanity. I wish I had never taken his class. We were graded off of two EXAMS only. People mentioned he liked papers, well not in this semester. AVOID IF POSSIBLE. AVOID. AVOID. AVOID.

This professor is the worst political science professor I have ever had. We were graded off of two things (the midterm and the final). He took forever to get back those grades and when he did, half of the class had failed. Believe me, I too thought he can't be that bad but he is. If you value your gpa or your mental health, AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Its uncommon to have a prof that's both passionate and good at transmitting information.  You have both here, if you watch the video lectures and take time to formulate your own ideas of the subject matter - you will find just what a blessing it is to have him as a prof. - funny, intelligent, passionate, & caring - that's what you find with him.
Lengthy lectures but still interesting, also the tests are lengthy as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Black was an amazing professor with an obvious passion for what he teaches. This is a super easy class for credit and can be interesting too! You don't absolutely have to buy the books but they are helpful. Attendance is iclicker every lecture. If you need ISS credits then I totally recommend this for a GPA boost!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: This professor is hands down the biggest yapper in all of MSU, he is very rude, and won't even round you up 0.05% in your final grade. Lectures are beyond boring, nothing is on Quizlet, and you're expected to read a 700-page book, so if you're looking for an easy 4.0 don't take him, the worst professor I've had in all my university experience

Professor Black is a cool guy, easy to get along with, and accessible if you need any help. The only problem I have is with grading- all done by TA's and all super late. He accommodated the course well, and was overall chill. Would recommend if you need the class for credit.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: ISS308 was not a bad course, but it is VERY BORING. You have to read 2 books and write a couple papers about them. If you plan on taking this course I would recommend doing it with a couple of friends to help each other along the way.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor Black was great, but the hour and 50 minute minute lectures were a bit long I would've liked more discussion rather than lecture. The tests may be a bit tough but they are open note, so I managed to 4.0. Take good notes and use ctrl-F on the readings to find test answers. Great professor though, and he clearly knows his stuff.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Way too much work for a gen-ed class. He makes you read five books a week that accumulates to over 200 pages, you have to write three essays and one book you have to purchase on your own in order to write the essays. He only taught topics that he found interesting. Attendance is mandatory if you want to do good on exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I took this professor before and loved the class(it was also a judicial politics class). This is a similar class and I have never hated a class so much. I ended up dropping the class because I would have 2.0 it. The grading is all over the place and if you do not mention something (within the 100 words you are given) you fail the assignment.

The first half of this class was rough, but after complaints came in about the class, the professor sent out a survey and made huge changes in how the course was being conducted. My grade went from being a 2.0 to a 4.0. Very few professors would be willing to make a 180 change like that mid-semester.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Two books were required for the class I barely picked them up and was still able to get a perfect score on the GBR's by skimming through. The class was an hour and 50 minutes long and he talked that whole time. The exams very long in questions so it was hard to make sure you got a good grade on them.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: I loved prof. Black, he's happy to teach, but this class is insanely hard to succeed in for me personally. I would definitely stray away if you're neurodivergent, the workload may take you 5x longer than others. Never got higher than a 76 on exams even after studying harshly. Great dude but a really tough class. Uses I-clicker and records lecture

Not the worst professor, he does his job, is very intelligent, and is passionate about what he teaches. I respect him for not being a lazy professor but... he's a yapper, assigns a lot of reading (I ain't reading all that), and uses i clicker. If ur lazy like me and just want easy iss credit look elsewhere. exams are difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class has very long lectures and the exams get up to 100 questions. There are numerous articles and passages assigned to read along with a book assigned over the span of the semester. If you do not have any interest or prior knowledge in politics, this class will be very hard to learn in. Professor Black is funny though.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This class is difficult. By the time you turn in 10 C4 assignments they just get around to grading. Then when they get around to grading them you messed up, and you wrote the 9 others the same way. So, you're never given an opportunity to learn and fix mistakes in future assignments. This is all due to their arbitrary grading scedule and scale.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: A theme I have seen, as well as experienced is that the professors grading is "shoddy" at best and the workload is a bit much. I can agree with both of these claims. The professor is not someone I would take again, and if I could drop this class without to much difficulty in the future I would.
The class is a good idea, however, choosing this professor to teach it may have been the wrong choice. I am doing more work than any of my other courses, and I am not seeing the benefit.

For a professor that pretends to be for the students mental health he is certainly testing mine. Says that the reasons he makes you do a bunch of essays is to alleviate the stress of doing essays. I would much prefer the stress of a 2 hour essay than the grading of his TAs.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: Takes forever to grade assignments. When they do come out you have about 4 assignments all with the same issues and cant do much to fix it because your grade has already been tanked. Would be nice if they graded promptly and gave you feedback in a timely manner.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: The format of this course is so bad that if you mess up a few small things they snowball and can basically lead to you being on ther verge of failing.

I find it interesting how I can be told "Great job!" but get a 60% on an assignment. This course prioritizes quantity over quality and cares little about whether the work you submit is good. If you are 12 letters off of the required number, he will fail you. Sad that a professor cares more about a word count than that of the words themselves.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: I would rather be doing 4 exams than 60 essays. Every week you have to write about 3 essay-type papers. They are graded by the TAs who have very different views on the grading process. Minimal interaction with the professor seems to delegate everything to his TAs. No drops, so if you mess up a couple of essays you can kiss your grade goodbye.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--So many papers

reviews.comment: I'm only halfway through the course and it is by far the worst class I've taken. All of the lectures he posts are from 2 years ago and he has multiple different people grading assignments, so grades are never consistent. Insane expectations for weekly assignments and readings

Professor Black seems like an amazing guy, very nice person.  However, this class is truly agonizing. To be fair, the topic of the Supreme Court isn't for everyone. But it is a 2-hour lecture, and all we do is listen to him talk and flip through slides. The homework assignments aren't terrible but you have to have read all of the material to do it.

Dr. Black's online PLS 320 class was very enjoyable. He has a bubbly personality which made listening to his lectures fun, although they were a bit long in some cases. His grading criteria for exams was very straightforward and I am happy that if you didn't get full credit there would be a reason why so you could appeal it.

This course is extremely lecture and reading heavy. However, the content isn't very difficult. The weekly quizzes are a great grade boost and the questions are reused for exams. Professor Black is passionate about judicial politics and it really shows in his lectures. Overall, a good course and not a GPA risk.

Professor Black has such a heavy lecture amount for this class. I took an online class for working while a student to make my life easier, this made it so much harder. No lecture is under an hour, making it very hard to retain information. The tests are very elaborate for being an online class with unfair grading. I would not take this class again.
reviews.rating_tags: Lecture heavy--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I took ISS210 online. I personally enjoy having the expectations/Due dates set at the beginning, *no-budge* deadlines, and playing some of my favorite games as an assignment. But, if youre looking for a more engaging session, take it in-person. Pretty sure the professor is more funny. Expect quizzes on reading and games. Outside of that, 10/10.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: One thing that sets this professor different than the rest is his ability to teach. His lectures are very engaging and clearly thought through, making his exams and quizzes easy to take - as long as you do the lectures. He was a very fair grader and made sure everyone understood the assignments every step of the way. 10/10 would recommend
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Black is a nice guy but that doesn't correlate with his class. The amount of time reading and watching lectures is outstanding. The format of the exams are not your typical exams. reviews.comment: While I will say he is great at explaining things and his lectures are enjoyable to watch online. TAs do all grading and not great at explanation of whats wrong, has to be perfect

reviews.comment: Professor Black is one of the best professor. He really cares about students success. The class are well organized and provides a detailed understanding.  The papers are relatable to your life, and then a few quizzes that are mostly unlimited attempts. His grading criteria is very doable.

Would not take a class with Professor Black again. While he was funny and knows his stuff he is unaccommodating. Multiple people in my semester had issues with him, and when confronted he was uncooperative and sometimes just rude.

reviews.comment: For the online class, to 4.0 you HAVE to get the books and you have to watch the lecture videos. Take good notes, he tests on what he says, not what is on the slides.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: If you put the work in listening to the lectures and reading the books, it is easy to succeed in the class. Prof. Black is extremely passionate about these topics and it shows! Also loved how he didn't include any personal opinions since the course (predictably) gets into social/political issues. Overall- amazing!
reviews.rating_tags: Accessible outside class--Get ready to read--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lots of reading and his lectures are long but hes probably one of the most caring professors at state. Hes very willing to accommodate his students and is passionate abt what he teaches, great guy.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Black was an amazing professor. He really cares about students success. I have taken ISS305 with him as well, and his classes are very well organized. reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Clear grading criteria--Caring

reviews.comment: I cannot sing enough praises for RCB. He's a great prof and his classes are enjoyable. Even his ISS 325 War & Revolution. These classes he bases off of video games and you simply write journals and take quizzes but you also learn a lot about the effect of videogames and society. Would recommend 10/10.

He tries to be funny ... but is not funny and very well a know-it-all. Regret taking this class because it tanked my 3.7 gpa. I found his test to be very convoluted and not focused at all. You will literally have to remember every little thing he said or that you read. Would not recommend whatsoever.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Lack of care for the online class over the inclass version. He should not have taught an online class concirrent with the regular version, as he got very sloppy.

Professor Black makes a dry topic interesting. He gives a 5 minute break in the middle which really helps me get through. If you dont do the readings, you wont get an A. He makes a lot of jokes during lecture which keeps you on your toes.

He is funny and sarcastic to listen to. He knows the information he teaches well. Partly because this class is basically all his data. There is ALOT of extra reading. No official text book but like 3 books and regular research articles you must read to pass. He is condescending and so are his TAs they know they are smart and are rude in email.
easy homework and quizzes, light workload, fair grader, easy 4.0
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Black was the first professor I ever had for an online course. His video lectures are easy to follow and he has a really good sense a humor. He also offers a bit of extra credit. I recommend taking a class with him.

I took one of his classes online over the summer and overall it was an easy A. Basically we read a handful of chapters for each module and then toke a quiz and then answered a few short response questions. He even worked with me on the due dates while I was out of the country. If you do the readings you'll be fine.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: We had to do many papers, but the exams were extremely easy and he's an overall chill guy. The lectures could get boring half the time, but half the time they were pretty engaging. He offers a good amount of extra credit. But in general, I wasn't too fond of the class though I liked him.
I loved this class. Most of your grade is a weekly current events type paper (only about 1-2 pages). He was funny. He also uses iclickers every class that counts for points.

Best professor that I have had. Lectures were very intriguing and I like how he weighs the homework way more heavily than the final (which is the only exam). If you write down the True/False questions and answers that he does at the start of the class, 100% on the final should be no problem. Would definitely take another of his classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Clear grading criteria--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: By far the best professor I've ever had. He recognizes that college and life can be hard, so he is more than willing to work with you if something comes up. He's also super clear about what he wants from you- you just have to write the NAPS assignments, show up, and do well on the final. The final literally the review he gives you.
Great professor, available and accessible, humor and easy grading system.

Professor Black is a great professor! He doesn't intend to make the class difficult because he wants his students to learn. We had no midterm but did have weekly writing assignments (only 1.5 pages). He is very kind and loves to teach! Attendance is mandatory through iClicker. I would recommend him for an easy A!
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many--Would take again

reviews.comment: Professor Black was a great professor. Lectures were clear and also very funny. NAPS assignments (50% of the grade) were challenging at first, but became easier as time went on. Would take another class from him.
Great professor! The material was easy to learn and his lectures taught pretty much everything you need to know.

Professor Black was a great professor who always made an attempt to make lecture funny and/or interesting. The exams were SUPER easy and very straightforward. If you go to section and come to class to get attendance points, you'll 4.0 easily. You also get to use a full page cheat sheet (front and back) on all exams. Highly recommended.

Ryan is my favorite member of the Political Science department, by far! Although his lectures can be dry sometimes, he adds in personal anecdotes that usually make up for it. We had a weekly 1.5 page paper due up until after the midterm, where you had to find a newspaper article and relate it to the class. The grading for those were extremely tough
Awesome political science teacher, and very fair grader. Reading and extra work is necessary to receive a 4.0.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Easy A and non bias

Professor Black was awesome. Super clear in class, plus he puts his lectures online, so you can review. While the tests (2 of them) are not open book, he does allow a 1 page (8.5 x 11) cheat sheet, which can have anything you want on them. The exams are easy, as long as you go to class and review. Definitely recommend him.

His lectures are super long and boring. He thinks hes funny be he rarely is. The class overall is easy and would be nice if his lectures didn't kill the material. He also says "normative" all to often.

Personally, I felt that lectures were boring. If you took AP Gov in high school, this class is going to be more than a breeze. There are clicker questions every day for points, but he drops your 4 lowest participation scores. Assignments every Sunday. Midterm and Final are easy--you  can make a cheat sheet with whatever you want on it. He's funny.
super funny and easy!
amazing!

He's a nice guy and keeps the class fun. Knows the material well and makes everything clear in class. Chose an interesting textbook to teach with too and the textbook is good as well. Not too hard of a class considering you can bring notes to the tests. You need to do the work but if you do it's an easy 3.0 at least

Class is somewhat hard but a 4.0 is easily obtained if you regularly attend class and section meetings. Prof. Black is super chill and funny. He's relatively young so he can still relate to his students.
Teaches well and keeps the class pretty entertaining.

Profesora Bongiovanni was extremely nice and an engaging teacher. She made this class very fun and collaborative. I took her class in Spring 2024 and had no trouble with assignments and felt like I learned a lot.
I loved her class! She is very fun, engaging, and makes phonetics interesting. I would take any class that she taught.

She was my favorite professor this semester!!! Take her class if you can. She makes it very easy to understand and is always happy to help when her students have questions. She canceled our final exam because she decided we had too many exams

Not allowed to use any devices in this class because he wants your "full attention", so be prepared to either buy a notebook or sit and be bored for the lectures(that are mandatory). My group and I have been waiting for our final project grades since December 2025. We are into the spring semester 2026, with still no grade or communication.(IAH231C)
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: do NOT take this class, Scott is def passionate about his study, and takes linguistics very seriously, if that's how you feel too it might be the only way you enjoy this class. attendance was mandatory, but make sure you have a notebook because there's absolutely no electronics allowed. my group and i have not received our grade yet(next sem btw)
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: Class is interactive and hands on; you go over the data sets & Scott writes everything out on the board. Scott said, "Dont be afraid to give the wrong answer. reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Scott just read lectures every class we had and introduced a final group presentation as our exam which was worth the entrie final grade as he gave almost no assignments. Then before FINALS this guy decides to assign a 20 page single spaced paper that WAS supposed to be double spaced but changed it TO MAKE IT EASIER ON US! His words not mine.

Scott is very passionate about linguistics and is a very nice guy but this course was so disorganized. We were expecting our final to be a group presentation, but he decided to cancel this and assign a 20-page SINGLE SPACED group essay on the last day of lecture. Attendance also required, and he forbids the use of any electronics.

Do not take IAH 231 with Scott Borgeson. He's a nice guy and is definitely passionate about linguistics but this class was awful. Him and the TA so disorganized and unclear about instructions/due dates it was ridiculous. Didn't end up doing half of what was on the rubric and he just assigned a 20 page paper due during finals week a week in advance.
Very well taught class especially for how difficult phonetics and phonology is. He was very friendly and eager to help however he possibly could.

Eddie seems like a well-meaning guy, and to be honest he's a good prof. He's admittedly a really good sociologist too, even if sometimes his politics come through. If you're used to temporarily catering your assignments to *slightly* farther left ideals, you'll be a-ok (if you survived any SOC classes with Ben Marley, you'll be more than fine!).
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This was a really fun class with a good professor. Only thing was that he would teach one class a week, and his TAs would teach the other class in the week. He's a great guy and the class was super easy. If you follow the rubrics step by step, you'll get all A's.

Boucher's classes are extremely easy which is why I ultimately gave him a "good" rating. However, be prepared to have him incessantly shove his liberal politics down your throat, and force you to regurgitate it through assignments. You don't learn anything, and it seems like he's just trying to get you to reinforce his ideology. Free A tho.

Class was ok. Watching the episodes and doing the work with classmates in the classroom was the only interesting thing. The papers he assigned for each topic was kind of hard because you had to find different episodes to compare the assigned episode to.

Very chill class where all you do is watch funny TV shows and do quizzes, a little assignment in class and a reflection paper every two weeks. And the papers are really easy and they follow a format that is consistent. You also get a group and film discussion videos that are also pretty simple. Easy A
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Gives good feedback--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: For a social science capstone course, Boucher gives his students an astonishing lack of freedom. We all felt like our research projects were more about "checking boxes" than learning something, even after February 13. I hope you enjoy sociology/ethnography, because those are the methods Boucher will force you to use in your project no matter what.

Prof.Boucher is very funny, and caring. In class, you watch TV shows about comedy, and every other week you write a paper, take a 10 question quiz, and film a group discussion. TA's run the class more than he does, but I don't mind. No exams. Super chill class if you are looking to bump your GPA.

TAs taught most of the class, professor wasn't really there. You watch tv episodes in class, write a paper/do a group discussion on zoom/take an online quiz every couple of weeks. Nice class to relax, most work would be done outside of class. Probably best ISS to take, but only this professor, other versions of 215 don't watch tv shows.
Great class, easy A you watch tv and reflect on it in an essay every 2 weeks
reviews.rating_tags: Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He's not there a lot, but I also wasn't and attendance didn't seem to affect my grade. You can not go for weeks and still get 100 in the class. The only work you have to do is a quiz, a reflection paper and a discussion every couple of weeks and the papers are so easy, I started submitting the same paper at the end and still got 100. Super easy A

Although professor Boucher was not there most of his lectures, he's teaching style was phenomenal and he was very passionate about what he taught. Lots of homework due to the amount of essays you have to write and the amount of reading and discussions you had to do. If you follow the grading criteria it should be easy to get an A.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: What I loved most about this class was the course materials and how it was presented in class. Dr. B. Is such an understanding professor and is willing to help out in way that is necessary. From brainstorming essay topics to reopening assignments.

Lectures were ran by the TAs mostly, I'd say 70% of the time. Class was a super easy A, what you do is sit down, watch a show, reflect on a paper w people sitting around you, and turn it in w your assistance. Every 2 weeks there's a heavy-ish paper and quiz, with a group assignment that takes maximum 20 minutes to complete. I'd take it again 100%.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--So many papers

reviews.comment: this class is a really easy A. class was interesting because of the shows we watched and the group discussions after each episode were extremely easy. reflection papers and group discussion assignments were not hard at all. class is mostly run by the TAs but they were extremely kind and helpful!
He's a chill guy, but he doesn't show up to half his classes and just has the TA's run it. Overall the class was super easy, because most of the homework was just watching TV.

Professor Boucher is only really there half the time, but when he is, he is entertaining and insightful. As long as you follow guidelines for discussions and papers you will get and A. The quizzes are also really easy as long as you watch the episodes and read the short readings.

In this class you will take no exams. Rather you will show up to class everyday and watch an episode of a TV show and break it down with a small group for attendance and participation credit. Every other week there is a group discussion, open note quiz, and unit reflection paper which is graded by his student assistants.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Im incredibly confused and disappointed by these ratings. He is such a great professor and knows how to get his students thinking without them even realizing. This class is so natural, interesting, and relatable. He does give about 6 essays over the semester but they are very simple and only 2-3 pages.Its SUCH an easy 4.0. trust me take this class!

I have too many great things to say about this class I went over the word limit on here. He cares about his students and is always available to help. Such and interesting class and an easy 4.0. Also such a nice break in your day watching shows like the office and parks and rec. The assignments are easy and not overwhelming. Couldnt recommend more!

Super nice prof, the class is very chill and not difficult as long as you complete the 3 assignments you are given every 2 weeks. Never got less than an A on one of the bi-weekly papers and feel as long as you follow the outline you will be fine. A very fun class and I really enjoyed it.
This class is genuinely so easy but it's also really tedious. There's a reflection, quiz, and group assignment every unit and he's really strict on not accepting any late work.

I've never talked to him, he doesn't take the time to know his students, I will admit it is a big class, but he has no idea who I am. He shows up maybe once a week, but he doesn't grade anything. Honestly the class could be run without him.
This class was overall not that bad. You're mainly graded on the papers in the class. The papers aren't that bad and the class isn't very time consuming or difficult at all.

reviews.comment: This is not your typical ISS course. It's all based around making a documentary with little help on how to actually do so. Good enough guy, but he likes to think that all of his students are going to love filmmaking as much as him. Very easy grader from what I've heard (tho I haven't got my grade back for my final documentary submitted 4 weeks ago)

First of all, Dr. Boucher cares about his students and will go beyond to accommodate them. The opportunity to produce a documentary for course credit was amazing. I'm confused at a lot of these bad reviews. Yea the TAs were the ones in class but it's an online class so none of us even had to come in if we didn't want to? Plus they were great.
I preferred organic chem 1 and 2 over this class. Professor seems kind and understanding, but I'm not a fan of the course material.

The class is not hard. Lots of focus on critical media or social construction theories, not really on learning about a different culture. Be sure to use the exact transitional phrases from the example/lecture when writing your paper, the quality of the idea you communicate isn't that important. Took it to fulfill a university requirement.

If you're in any major that requires a lot of time, do NOT take this class with Boucher. Boucher has his head in the clouds thinking his students have enough time to do a semester-long film project. He is overambitious and projects his interest in film-making onto his students. If you wanna take ISS 315, take it with another professor!
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Not hard, but the biggest waste of time. Every week there's so much useless, busy work. He gets sidetracked in lectures. The TA's grade the assignments hard. reviews.comment: I enjoyed this class a lot. If you want an easy ISS take this class!!! Boucher was only in class the first week though, but he's very nice and usually understanding. You do have to write an essay every two weeks, but the grading isn't difficult. None of my essays received a score under a 92. Quizzes are just based off the episodes you have to watch

This professor doesn't believe in standardized testing which means that the quizzes were super easy and most things were based on effort. The unit papers weren't too bad as long as you follow the rubric super closely he doesn't care about writing style very much at all. Super nice guy and very understanding.

This class seems interesting enough, was pretty enjoyable, and not hard. Professor Boucher, however, different story. He never showed up for class, except for the first day, and relied on the TA's. I sent multiple emails throughout the semester on varying topics, but not once did I receive a response. Would not recommend.

ISS215 itself is interesting enough. But this is an easy easy A...: I watched 2 lectures this entire semester, I'd come to class to watch the shows for extra credit, and mostly talked about my own opinions in all my assignments. prof Boucher? I had the chance to speak to him once! He never came to class always relied on TAs

reviews.comment: I highly recommend this class if you want an easy ISS credit. This class consists of a group discussion, a quiz, and an essay every two weeks and they are very easy. Attendance is extra credit but only if you attend 9/10. If you miss more than one, I wouldn't bother showing up to the rest. The lowest grade I received on an essay was a 95.

I took ISS 215 where you watch comedy episodes and write reflection papers and group discussions and a short quiz. The work he assigned was very manageable so Im not really sure why he didnt get better reviews by other people on this website. I thought it was a really fun class and I looked forward to it.

Dr. Boucher's class is amazing. He truly caters to his students by letting us Laugh our ISS off with comedy shows. By watching these shows, reading articles, watching short clips, or documentaries you learn so much about the real world. This class is so beneficial and gives you life experience and exposure to social issues. Work hard, you get an A.

The class is an easy A, you have a lot of time to complete your assignments, and he grades really easy, follow the rubrics to a T! Didn't care much for the material, but it was still interesting how he had us learn from comedy/sitcoms. Attendance was not mandatory. Would recommend as an easy class to get ISS credit.
This class teaches straight nonsense, but is an easy A.

reviews.comment: He is one of the best teachers I have ever had this class was made for everyone to succeed I am awful at writing papers, but I got 100% on all of my papers for this class. He gives you clear instructions on everything he wants from you. He cares about people succeeding. I thought the material was really fun, we watched a lot of comedies.
The class was straightforward. The TA's were really helpful and he was super understanding about people not being able to make it to class.

reviews.comment: I personally dont agree with what he teaches because its meaningless rhetoric. No evidence behind any of the stuff he teaches. Paper, quiz, group discussion due every 2 weeks. Easy A, No Exams.

The papers are all pretty much the same so once you get used to it and use his example theyre fine. No exams, in person was optional and we got extra credit.

Great professor, take him if you have the chance. I see a lot of bad reviews but I feel totally different. He has no exams or tests for his class, He has quizzes once every 2 weeks that are taken online. The class is easy, just take notes, do the paper, do the quiz, all in 2 weeks and you'll get an easy A. And you watch a lot of funny tv shows.

reviews.comment: He is very specific in what he wants. Follow the rubric carefully and get an easy A. Wasn't a fan of watching the shows but you can watch a couple and write the weekly essay on it no problem. Very time consuming,

I'm really happy I had proffesor Boucher for ISS 210. It was very laid back and the whole semester was mainly focused on the final film project. reviews.comment: I took Dr. Boucher's "Laugh your ISS off" online during my first semester of college. I have only been in class a week and half and I already want to drop it. This guys lectures are in total an hour and 15 mins long and he covers about 10 mins worth of stuff you actually need to know. Everything he talks about in his lectures is so confusing. Its obvious he doesn't read these comments because his class still sucks.

The tests have extremely specific questions in regards to these readings so it is incredibly difficult to know the answer since you have to cram and unhealthy and unproductive amount of information in your head.

In all honesty, his tests are hard and he's difficult to access. But he's not boring or biased. Im kind of surprised what people mean by that when a lot of them are taking a Race and Ethnicity class with a Black Professor in America. like if you can't handle ugly truths I don't know what to tell ya.  But ya his tests are hard and reading heavy lol
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Test heavy

reviews.comment: DO NOT take his SOC 215 or 315 class. His lectures are incredibly biased and follow no actual curriculum. He talks about the same 5 things every lecture and says he'll expand on them "later on." Tests are highly specific to random parts of the readings and almost nobody does well on them. Bragged on the first day that half his class last year 0.0'd

reviews.comment: I went into the class thinking it wouldn't be too hard since it's a 200 class but was prepared to do some work... nothing could have prepared me for this class. His lectures always seem to be heavily biased and boring to sit through. The tests cover stuff we never went over or extremely specific questions that no one remembers. Be careful!!!

reviews.comment: Dr. Broman has been a great professor. I took SOC 215 and I really enjoyed the class. It was difficult because you have to keep up on readings and the exams count for most of your grades, however I still enjoyed it. The course material was important and Dr. Broman always talked about these things in a passionate way. He is a great professor.

Not only are the lectures terribly boring and not engaging at all, but it really felt strange to hear him call LGBTQ+ people "Q People" the entire semester. He said his colleagues told him it was fine to say that, but if you feel the need to justify it is it really okay? It was just uncomfortable, like just say LGBTQ or LGBT or something.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Broman's teaching style is not suited for anyone with a learning disability. He sits on his chair and reads from the lecture slides the entire period. It is incredibly monotonous and difficult to pay attention to. Tests are 90+ questions, multiple choice, and highly specific. Not conducive to actual learning at all.

reviews.comment: I usually don't take the time to rate my profs but for Prof Broman I'll do it just because these other ratings are FALSE. Not an easy credit class.
The class is difficult but very interesting.

reviews.comment: Be ready to read. This prof posted lectures until the last day of class. What made it worse was he read straight from them & barely engaged w/ the students. He sat in his chair the entire sem. & mumbled behind his mask. 90+ questions on exams to take in an hour and twenty mins. The final (cumulative) had about 200-300qs in 2 hours. Ridiculous.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: This was well organized and explained so thoroughly that I actually wasn't confused by math. This class keeps the math interesting and relevant to making money and manipulating money, which is enjoyable.

This class isn't difficult at all.
It's online, asynchronous, and module-based, with a checklist every week, so you'll rarely wonder if you missed something.
There's a quiz with 2 attempts at the end of every module that isn't hard, which allows you to go back to the text to find the answer.
There's no exam for this class.
The textbook is $100 tho.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Prof. Browns MTH 102 Course you talk about how you would use money in the real world like home loans, stocks, etc. Prof. Brown gives clear and short lectures about what we are talking about. The modules take a 2-3 hours to complete because theres the module, module quiz, and discussions but they are very helpful for your financial future life.

I definitely loved this class, and it was very easy to follow along. The topics were consistent, and the workload allowed for good flexibility, despite the packback deadlines. The chapters were not too heavy with content, but the textbook was a bit pricey... However, you can tell the professor really does love teaching this course =)!

this man tries EXTREMELY hard to be funny and cool. it kinda works. makes u pay an absurd amount of money for his textbook that HE WROTE. very easy tho, weekly reading, quiz, and packback module that took probably an hour to finish. packbacks sucked

Taking this class online was probably the best thing I've done. Especially with professor Brown, he's very laid back, the course is asynchronous, and you have mon-fri to find time to complete each module. The only thing I dislike about the class is the packbacks that go along with each module.

This class was great. You always had the same type of assignments each week, starting on Mondays and being due on Fridays, making scheduling time for your other classes easy. Truthfully, you don't need the extra credit if you just get your work done, but it's there if necessary. Professor Brown's lecture videos were also pretty funny and engaging.

Best professor I've ever had. Actually makes a math class fun, and this course teaches stuff that can be applied to the real world, very beneficial. Super funny and entertaining. Easiest math class I've ever taken, but also the most beneficial and I learned so much from this course. Has office hours and lots of resources to help students succeed

Very simple assignments and work, same system every week and we had multiple opportunities to redo assignments to get the best score. no midterm or final. professor was funny too and made his course interesting. only downside was having to buy a $100 online textbook that we did all our work through but the textbook was written by him and funny.
Absolutely easy class. Professor is great, lots of jokes and humor if a bit dad humor at times. Everything is online and is done at basically your own pace.
I loved this class. Very easy to follow, funny professor, many extra credit/makeup opportunities, reading checks had no exact due date.
If you try to email him, he only has his TA and GA respond you will never be able to talk to him.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Graded by few things--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Super easy, super funny, has a good structure to the course, and is very chill with assignments. Lots of opportunities to redo assignments and extra credit opportunities every week. The only annoying thing is that all work is through a $100 online textbook.
I really liked him. A breath of fresh air. Cares about students, kept the class entertaining and hilarious. He's great.

Honestly, Prof Brown was the best professor I had this semester. He was super funny and made an online class come to life by it. The assignments are very straight forward and he gets in grades super quick. I wish I could take a class with him in person or in the future.

Although it an an online course, Professor Brown found a way to make it more engaging than most in person courses. Even through a screen you can tell he really wants his students to grasp the presented context. The work and content is very easy as long as you pay attention, and overall I would recommend this course to anyone.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Amazing lectures --Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Although this was an online class, prof brown was an amazing professor!!! He is super funny and entertaining, and the class is SO easy. Like SO easy. I wish I had the opportunity to learn from him in person, such a great guy!

Professor Brown was a really goo professor! I had this course online and it was extremely easy to follow. There would be modules every week, but nothing you won't be able to handle. Would definitely recommend taking this course!
Professor Brown was fantastic. His class was super easy to understand and he was a really funny guy that made subjects entertaining.

Brown is a phenomenal professor. He made his own online textbook you have to purchase, and he has weekly modules through them. It is very easy to follow and is a real world math class. I would 100% recommend this course.

Prof. Brown is a super cool guy, and the textbook he wrote for the course is completely online and easy to understand. Every week is the same structure and points come from the same four places: reading questions, quizzes, Packback posts, and Flipgrid videos. You can usually finish the material for the week in about two hours, maybe 3 max.
Per week there is a flip grid, lectures, a quiz, and a discussion post. All can be done within a day. SUPER easy class and work load. Online office hours as well as NO FINAL.
Professor Brown is a great professor who makes math fun.

This class is the easiest thing you'll ever take, and is not a traditional math class. If you're trying to fulfill your university requirement I would 100% take MTH 102 with Professor Brown. The structure of the class is really easy to follow, and all of the work is super easy, three things are by each Friday.

A super interesting class that actually applied math to the real world. He understands what college kids are going through and adapts to make the class enjoyable. Weekly modules through the textbook and other online forms were easy to complete. He also has lots of resources available to students. Highly recommend.

Super easy class. Same thing from week to week so no surprises. No midterm but chances for extra credit and an optional final that can only bring your grade up. Can usually get the week's content done in a day. Have to buy his online textbook which is the only real con.

Professor Brown has been one of my favorite professors all year! His lectures are exciting and very engaging which make it very easy to complete the weeks worth of work in one sitting. The class is all online but he has a very good system which allows for students to stay organized. I would 10/10 recommend taking Professor Brown!

I took MTH102 online, it was not enjoyable to do math online, but Dr. Brown made it very fun and engaging. That is a lot coming from me when I am someone who hates math. You were given 4 things to do each week, and had to subscribe to an online website which was where your lecture videos and quizzes were posted. He was a great professor.
Amazing professor, did the impossible by making me actually enjoy learning math!
Hats off to Mr. Brown for giving me the first good experience with math in a while. You revived my confidence as a student and inspired me as a person. Great job!
I'm assuming you are taking MTH 102 for credit but if you can, take Professor Brown.

10/10, would take another class with this prof. Class goals were clear to understand & he made learning fun suprisingly. Rather than taking mth103 if you still have time to switch I def reccommend taking 101 & 102 instead.

This professor wrote his own online textbook, and it worked out amazing for this class! You get two attempts on quizzes and numerous reading checks. If you're not good at math, this is a great class for you. He's super funny with the content, and it helped make the material flow all the more.

He is very caring towards his students and wants us to do our very best. Although this course was online asynchronous, the was no lack in connection between fellow students and the professor. This class was pretty easy and I would definitely take one of his classes again.

Professor Brown is definitely the best professor that I've had so far. The lectures were interesting, the grading was always clear, and everything was due at 8pm on Fridays. You could finish the entire weeks' module in about an hour or two. No final exam. Quizzes all had multiple attempts.
Prof Brown is the best made learning Math so much fun!

Professor Brown didn't just make things easy but fun as well. This class was something that every college student (especially freshman) should experience. I was lucky to take this my first semester and I could not have been more happy with the amount I learned and how balanced and organized everything was taught. I would recommend 100%

This dude is awesome! The MTH102 course I took with him was asych, but he did not fail to make the class and content interesting and engaging even more than a class that was fully in person. He is a dope person overall & would show us music videos and songs he has made as a DJ. Very passionate about teaching and an understanding guy. Great class!
Very funny guy, really helps with engagement. He has many ways of getting help if you are having a hard time. Overall makes learning fun and manageable!
there is attendance but you can get away with it outside of class

Never really been a numbers guy or one to want to write how a professor was during the semester. However with Prof. Brown I feel like this guy deserves all the props for being one of the best math instructors I have ever had. He applies real world life situations with mathematical principles that are very easy to understand and relate. Youll pass.
You will love professor Brown! He makes math fun. This class was a great experience for me being someone who struggles with any type of numbers. You will love him!

This class was my favorite class I have taken so far. We learned so many useful things and I wish more professors were like him. There was a list of homework at the beginning of the week and it was very easy to complete in a few hours so you don't have to worry about it for the rest of the week. I would highly reccomend him for any class.

This guy is a real gem and is exactly what teachers should be like. He is extremely cool and understandable, learning the material was easy because it made sense. He made the class fun while also making sure that we learned what we needed to learn, if anyone I know needs to take a math class, I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this class and prof.
Amazing Prof!

Prof. Brown is dope. Captivating guy, definitely has some side hustles. Assignments are clear and relatively easy. Took his asynchronous class, modules and quizzes were fine. Lectures are interesting. Only downfall is that he tried to have like 4 different online platforms for the class which for confusing. Thankfully one didnt work out.
I loved Prof Brown! He's a really nice and funny guy! Would take again

Prof. Brown uses this class to focus on everyday processes, structures, and many topics that are needed for the real world. He is realistic, funny, and there were so many opportunities for office hours and help. I got a weeks worth of class done in one day every week of the semester and got a 4.0. I could not recommend this class and prof enough!
Best math teacher I have ever had.

Prof. Brown is ABSOLUTELY one of the best profs here at MSU! He is one of the coolest, chill, laid-back profs EVER! He doesn't teach traditional math, where you add this and multiply that, his lessons are more philosophical, lessons that we will ACTUALLY need in order to understand the world better. I would definitely be taking more courses w/ him!

All of the class meetings were over Zoom due to Corona, but he honestly did such an amazing job explaining the material so it would make sense and the use of it outside of the class which made it more engaging. He was also very chill and gave a ton of extra credit which made it easy to get a 4.0. I can't recommend him enough!

best math professor at msu. he made math so easy for someone who hates math. hes funny & he welcomes all questions. he really makes the material understandable & is more than willing to take time to help you understand. real funky dude. if i ever had to take a math class again i would 100% take prof brown again. completely underrated teacher.
this is for non math majors it is so easy

Best professor I've ever had. Extremely passionate and very good at pushing you to understand the material. Believes in all of his students and goes above and beyond to help them succeed in class. Had for two classes throughout college and they were both far and away my favorite courses. He's also fun and can joke around with students.
A good professor, solid with explaining hard material. Only cons are he can be really patronizing when you don't understand. Still would definitely recommend.

reviews.comment: Very helpful and good at explaining tough material.

I would have spirals every week after class because he would talk so much and I couldn't keep up. We were guilt tripped at the end. The only reason I don't regret taking the class is because of my classmates. RELY ON YOUR CLASSMATES! When you work together you can make it through this, and hopefully with an A.

reviews.comment: AVOID!!!! So much reading, weekly in-person hand-written quizzes are on random material from the past weeks. Final/ midterm are in person and you have to write an essay that you won't get the prompt for until you walk in on final day. Harsh grader. Didn't take attendance, but there are quizzes every other class that cannot be made up.

The class itself isn't hard if you show up but there are a lot of textbooks to purchase (some which I spent an upwards of $20 only to read a small passage and then discard). He doesn't allow technology so you can't use a pdf. Your buying books for no reason just to read 20 pages and never use it again. Also a lot of group projects and readings.
Makes you buy SEVEN books, never stops talking and can't stay on one topic for more then 10 minutes. Take any other IAH instead.

Brian Burns is extremely difficult to work with, he will not allow any absences as well as make up work. He expects you to sit and listen to him talk for an hour and 50 minutes every class while also ready up to 150 pages a week. If you don't think his lectures are boring that sucks because no technology is allowed so you're forced to stare at him.

Avoid at all costs. Rants about AI constantly, syllabus is almost never accurate, blames students for doing poorly on his terribly written exams, won't answer questions you ask in class so he can continue his meaningless rants. Surprise group projects not on syllabus, extensive reading assignments, never posts slides, worst class I've ever taken.

reviews.comment: Don't take this class

Please don't take this class. you will suffer it's ridiculous how much quizzes and reading there is. Every week there's a quiz also the mid term and final are the hardest exams too. You have to remember lines from the book and know what word fits in the sentence and you have to remember 15+ portraits for the exams.

Do not make this mistake on taking this class .This is the hardest class I've ever took in my college years. He Makes things more complicated than they need to be.Don't take it trying to help you out seriously. He doesn't stop talking

never take a class with him. no technology is allowed at all but expects us to spend over $200 on multiple books throughout the semester that we read within a week. one quiz per book based on the reading for the day (which is about 70 pages of reading.) exam consists of writing an essay and 32 questions quoting all the books we've read. pls run.

reviews.comment: First of all, seven books and no technology allowed in the classroom... He talks more about how technology is poisoning society than the actual topic. Be in class or you will fail, and there are impromptu group projects. The grading is easy as long as you read what he tells you. I would never take this class again. Choose a different IAH!

reviews.comment: 7 required *paperback* textbooks that we don't even read the entirety of. Talks about his personal life more than valuable information. he's a waste of my money and time, and that's kind.
Non. Stop. Talking.

If you value your free time and sanity do not take this course with professor Burns. He does not know how to stay on track with the course materials and will bore you to death by going on tangents about god knows what.

I saw reviews that said he yaps a lot, but I figured it couldn't be that bad. Do not make my mistake, it IS in fact that bad. None of it is relevant to the course, and is useless information. He took years off my life in this class, please save yourself.

reviews.comment: No phones, laptops or tablets in class. No textbooks but over $230 of individual books. That list of books was not correct until the second week. Does not update course schedule. Impromptu essays on exams. D2L was not available until the second week and is rarely used.
Sent me into a mid-life crisis at 13. Now I'm only gonna make it to 26.

reviews.comment: Class is fine, he's a very poor academic though. Ramble for hours about nothing and makes it impossible to keep track of what matters and why doesn't in class. Should start a podcast instead of trying to teach students material.o

Lots of reading and essays, but it is well worth it.

reviews.comment: If you like a professor that goes off topic about random things and is hard to understand but kind of funny and good looking then this is the one for you! reviews.comment: Very insightful class and learned a lot. Mostly good selection of books to read. We watch a movie/documentary with each book we read. Not a timely grader, he graded my midterm paper after I submitted the final. He is very talkative which sometimes makes a long class feel even longer. Overall great guy, just not a fan of his teaching style.

Dr. Burns' entire class consists of 2 hour, long-winded lectures that don't engage students. He is boring, rants, gives vague instructions, and won't respond to emails.  You will have to spend over $100 just to buy books because no computers are allowed. Also, he hasn't graded half the quizzes and our final is next week. Avoid at all costs!
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He was difficult, and had group essays which I've never done before! But he really helped me grow in my writing, and he definitely talks a lot. A difficult challenge but a welcome one to be sure. If you do not wish to read a lot of content don't take this class then.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Group projects

reviews.comment: I was very unhappy with Dr. Burns. I emailed him several times for help, and he basically told me I was out of luck. The workload is intense, and we read multiple books that were extremely difficult to understand. The quizzes aren't bad, but he pulls a lot of tricks and is a difficult grader. I would never recommend him to anyone.
teaches well focuses on some things that dont matter. Easy grader

Lots of writing and reading which is expected of the course! genuinely helped me grow as a writer so so much- his lectures were always amusing and you could never quite guess what would happen next. A little off track with lectures sometimes, but this class helped me improve a ton and was the right level of difficulty.

reviews.comment: I had Dr. Burns for both ISHALL 1+2. Genuinely the worst classes I've taken. He goes on for ages on irrelevant lectures and never drives it to a point. He has no respect for students' names+pronouns. He really forgets he is teaching 13-15-y/o, not adults. WAY too much of a workload for children, regardless of gift or talent. Not worth the credits.

reviews.comment: While I did a good job grade wise during my year of ISHALL, the year was miserable altogether. If you do even one extracurricular on top of this; don't.

reviews.comment: Mr. Burns is a very nice man, but not a very good professor. He was very unprofessional when it came to promoting his own political opinions. He is also very narrow minded about Lit. Very Postmodern. Beware.

Best professor I ever had. Definitely chooses favorites which I was one of. Hes an acquired taste to say the least but genuinely wants you to succeed and loves his job. reviews.comment: fun guy, but you have to have a unique sense of humor to like his class. defintley has favorites, so make a good first impression. One of my favorite teachers of all time though, would recommend his class. Talks alot and gets distarcted easily.

reviews.comment: Ishall 1 has to be one of the greatest classes that I have ever taken. One of the most difficult, of course, but it is just such a great opportunity for HS students. The lectures are always engaging, as is the large load of classwork, if you put in the effort.
