This was one of the worst classes ive taken. The 85 for a 4.0 is NOT easy. I attended every lecture, took notes, studied, did all homework, and still got below 68 on each exam. Cheat sheet seems like it'll help but since theres only 32 questions on 5+ chapters its hard to know what to put on there, I barely ended up using them. Would NOT recommend
You need an 85 to 4.0 the class but this is more difficult than it sounds. For me what helped pass was I used the econ help rooms for homework and then to better understand the topics being taught.

Avoid this man at all costs, worst professor I've had in all my 4 years. No test curves, no extra credit. Don't be fooled by the 85 for a 4.0, it is not as easy as it sounds. My class average for our 2nd exam was a 61, and he refused to curve it, really just feels like he is praying on our downfall. If you are in ec201 avoid him at all costs.

Attendance is mandatory on iClicker, the lecture is basically just him reading off powerpoint slides. One homework a week which is very easy. The exams are pretty difficult and practice exams don't really help all that much. The textbook is pointless to buy.

Just don't use chat gpt on the homework + attend the lectures and you'll be fine. You get cheat sheets for the exam but they can be tricky. You only need an 85% in the class for a 4.0 though which is very doable. I've never opened the textbook he told us to buy though. Ce Liu is a chill guy overall.

Ce Liu is a dawg. In the past, I've had trouble understanding economics, and taking this class was a breath of fresh air. Professor Liu is interesting. I found it easy to concentrate and take notes in this class. The exams are difficult, but practice exams and problems are provided and are optional. 10/10 would take again.

The class was basically him just reading slides the whole time, which is fine, but attendance is graded so its kind of pointless when you have to go back and teach yourself the material before exams. The class is pretty boring, but it is not super difficult to understand. Plus, all materials are posted on D2L.

Mandatory attendance for a moderately easy class (10% of grade). Lectures were boring but at least the notes are posted. He says textbook required but you really won't need it. Grind practice problems to succeed. He can be a funny dude if you pay attention. Exams were not too bad. Overall, Professor Liu was decent but not great.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Good guy. very knowledgeable just a tough class. if i had to take micro again i would def take it with him
Bro yaps abt some random stuff too much
The lectures are boring, but its not really his fault, tough class to teach. He is funny, but the class is hard.
i love celiu

I personally thought he is a great professor, I just think micro is difficult. in this class you only need an 85% to 4.0 which I thought was very leniant.and per chapter every week you have a 20 question homework assignment. I personally never took any notes and just listened to the lecture and I did fine. I really recommend you take this professor

The professor is friendly, however the class itself is so boring. In the lectures, he sometimes spends twenty minutes on one practice problem, which makes it incredibly easy to get distracted and lose focus. I feel like I had to teach myself a lot of the material before each of the exams.
I pretty much taught myself and the whole class was struggling with the in class iClickers.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lecture heavy--Test heavy

reviews.comment: This class was sooo boring. The lectures were slow and we would spend half the class on one simple problem which makes you not want to go even though attendance is graded. The class is curved so it's not a ton a work to get a good grade. Overall I would recommend taking this class with another professor.

There are two heavily weighted midterms + a cumulative final with homework and iclicker questions that do basically nothing for your grade. Liu is monotone and quiet and seems unprepared, you basically have to teach yourself. you never know what your grade is bc it isn't curved until after the semester ends.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Liu was a pretty laid-back professor. He is a little quiet when he talks so if you want to do decent in his class, you gotta sit towards the front of the class. The homeworks have abt 35 questions each which can be time consuming and the exams are challenging so you gotta to study a lot for this class. Overall a good class, it was just kinda tricky
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Test heavy

reviews.comment: he sounded unprepared for every lecture and he speaks very low and there were several times students mentioned that but it felt like he turned his volume down. if you take time to study and pay attention it wont be that bad but it is a difficult class. there are at least 1-2 quizzes a week with 35 questions 2 midterms and 1 final. t

Ce Liu gives 80 points of homework for free, 15 iclicker questions for free. We have 1-2 hw's due a week and are around 36 questions each, but you get two attempts. Exams are easier than the homeworks and if you do the practice midterm you'll be fine. iclicker questions are graded by correctness, but if you just do the question you get 1/2 points.

Although I did terrible in his class, I thought Ce was a good prof. He was very kind to us and he tried to keep his lectures entertaining. He was kind of funny without trying to be. His class is hard but I just think econ is hard. I would recommend him if you have to take 201.
Good professor the only thing is that he was a little hard to understand but the grading was easy and it was a good class.

Class was not too hard but he only allows for the top 15% of students in the class to get a 4.0. Kinda rude sometimes as well and you never know what percentage of the class you are in as it is graded on a curve that is constantly changing so you arent sure how you are doing compared to others.
He was a super great professor! Was really funny and charismatic. Recommend if you need to take econ

I am terrible at economics and this class is extremely easy. The material he uses to teach this class is very straight forward. As long as you show up to class you will get a good grade. He takes attendance usually but you don't have to pay attention in class. Just do the practice exams and you'll be fine, they are the same as the tests. Easy!

This professor doesn't care enough about you to actually listen to what you say. Nor does he care about you actually learning (told me to answer the questions without access to the material). Don't take this person's class if you are human. I was in a motorcycle crash and broke my laptop. I showed him and he said use your phone without studying.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Very simple and straight forward class. Funny guy. Lectures are as entertaining as any lecture can be on Econ. Show up to class to get the in class participation points. Attendance isn't taken, but is required unless you're very confident in your exam ability.

Posted his lecture power points online so come in to have him explain them. Very personable teacher and made new material straightforward to learn and constantly asked the class if they had questions. Available office hours. Homework due every Sunday, but a majority of it was very easy and could be found on quizlet.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The class was very enjoyable. Professor gave amazing lectures and has a great personality. Not too much homework and overall it was pretty easy. If you take notes during or after the class you should be able to do well on the exams. I recommend this professor and class!

Entire grade is based on 3/4 projects. Attendance not required. He makes you buy his textbook. Dont buy it. Its a waste of your money. ALL of your assignemnts are graded by TA. I got a 4.0 in the class beacuse I had a nice TA.

He would constantly change the syllabus where the instructions for most assignments and projects were. He would come across as mocking of students in class after he'd ask for people to share their opinions. So many written responses, it makes a fun subject into a chore.

Youre whole grade is 3 projects basically and is all graded based on the TA's. If you get a TA that grades harsh, you're cooked. Mine graded harsh but my friend got straight 100s. Also just a waste of time learning this bs
I would never take a class of his again. Please incoming freshman take a different IAH class. This one is easy but still many more easier and enjoyable classes.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: You're WHOLE grade is determined by the TA you have, and they grade so hard and it is almost impossible to get an A even when you follow the rubric. PLS DROP THIS CLASS ( Afrofuturism)

Professor Chambliss is fine, the lectures can be a bit boring, however attendance is not required! I know people who went to no lectures and passed just fine, the course is based on 3 large projects (20% each) and 20% for recertation. They take attendance and if you miss 2+ that's 25% of your grade, befriend your TA thats how you get good grades!!

Although the course is about afrofuturism, you never really learn much about it as he lectures about the randomest topics ever. He wrote the mandatory textbook which is hard to understand. Your grade is dependent on your TA and most were very harsh graders. Dropped this class with zero regrets

You can take this class, never go to a lecture, and still pass with a 4.0. Your grade is solely dependent on who your TA is and how clearly they describe the projects. Dr. Chambliss will tell you to buy his book about Afrofuturism, do not buy it. You do not need that book for this class at all, I never read a single word of it. Class is super easy.

Four projects make up the majority of the grade and they're graded by the TA, not Dr. Chambliss. His class material is a lot more interesting than he is engaging, but his lectures aren't mandatory-- only the recitations. I had the pleasure of having a great TA (Journey Smith). Can't speak for those who don't-- simple projects though.

Like others have said, your grade depends on your TA. You don't have to go to lectures, but definitely go to recitations as attendence is mandatory and they recap lectures. You're graded on 4 projects and then recitation attendence, worksheets, and we had to take notes for one lecture and then teach one topic to our recitation class.
TAKE THIS CLASS ONLINE IT IS 10X LESS WORK. Also, most of the TA's in this class grade your papers like they are harvard professors.

Every IAH/ISS class is taught by someone who spent their entire career studying a niche/pointless subcategory of literature. They probably wrote a book that they require you to buy for the class (like this guy) if you have to take this class because it's required (like me) I suggest you take it online. Every assignment can be found on the internet.
I never went to a single lecture and got a 4.0, there are a few projects and thats mostly all you have to do. i would def take this professor again hes so chill

Chambliss is a nice guy but because of the way the class is formatted, your grade is entirely based on who your TA is. I would reccommend going to lecture in the beginning of the semester. Your whole grade is based on four projects and then your recitation grade, so I reccommend not taking this class because you can't pick your TA

Even though lectures were boring, I attended all of them yet still did bad. My TA was a harsh grader, you have to get lucky and get an easy one to do well. It's not worth it, take another more interesting IAH class.

Great professor, always cracks a few jokes in class. I would recommend going to lectures at the beginning of the course, but toward the end, it's less necessary. I did not read a single reading assigned to me and still got a 4.0. The TA was good; a little picky and slow with grading. I recommend going to all recitations if you can!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: My grade dropped drastically because of a missed assignment in recitation 3.5 to 2.5. Lectures are boring you don't even have to honestly. Put all that work into my assignments just to receive a C for one assignment. Just a waste of time. Save your money and enroll in a different course. Emailed TA about grade never got a response.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I maintained a 3.5 in the class the ENTIRE semester but at the very end my grade dropped to a 2.5 because I missed ONE assignment from RECITATION! I had B's on every major project that was given to me and a A on my final but somehow that didn't matter because since I missed one assignment in my recitation my grade is now a C. Don't take this course
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He is a really good guy at first, but the topic can be super uninteresting and hard to stay engaged with. It is also really hard to find good sources/examples online for projects. Lecture was so boring! The one major problem with this class was my TA graded super hard and it is usually very inconsistent. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!!!

Seems like a chill guy at first, but when I talked to him about a grade dispute he was very condescending and disrespectful. Limited work makes it hard to get a good grade in this class, and I wish I took a different IAH since this one messed up my gpa.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I HATED THIS CLASS! I was one of the few that actually attended lectures and still learned nothing. Your grade depends on only 4 projects, so if you do bad on one your whole grade tanks. I would NOT recommend this class.
Most uninteresting lecture I've ever taken. The TA was not good and very rarely gives out good grades. Not worth your time or sanity.
Extremely rude when you speak to him. Very unclear measures for grading and takes points off for no reason. Do not recommend him. Please stay away from his class.

Don't take this class. Course description doesn't mention it's about Afrofuturism. People stopped showing up to his lectures because they're boring and useless. Grades depend on the TA, mine was a super harsh grader. Project instructions were unclear, no rubric.Talked to the professor about my grade, and he laughed in my face, very unprofessional.

Dr. Chambliss is a great teacher if you are interested in the subject of Afrofuturism. I didn't really have an interest in this subject but still had a great time. Attendance is not mandatory for lecture but the recitation attendance is, and all the grading is done by your recitation TA. Only about 4 assignments in one semester. Lots of reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He was a great guy, but I just wasn't interested in the topic. I didn't need to attend lecture which was nice. However, you should be aware that your recitation teacher for this class will be someone else, typically Master's students who are not the best at what they do.

Professor Chambliss is amazing! He gets everyone engaged in the lecture & gives some prompts to get you thinking at the beginning of lecture that are honestly very interesting. He doesn't do the grading but the TA I had was amazing also and a very easy grader. His lectures do not require attendance but the recitation that goes along with it does.
Honestly, you can look up all the answers to everything if you're just looking for a 4.0.
Che is awesome! His class is very straightforward and all homework and exams are online with multiple attempts. If you can take the in person lecture you should!!
his class is very easy to follow along!

This professor misspoke multiple times in lecture videos but didn't edit them making them hard to follow along with. The amount of readings you are assigned each week with only 5 days to complete is overwhelming. I didn't understand the way things were being taught so I taught myself. He's a kind person, but the class could be structured better.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The professor does not care about the class at all, multiple times in his lecture video he would mess up over and over again but was too lazy to edit the video or restart. This class is basically a completely online class that has a structure so he does not have to Grade anything. The work load is very above average.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: Communication is amazing. He always give you ample time and notification when something is due. He is super easy to contact and understanding. One of the best professors I have had while completing my business minor.
He gives extra credit opportunities that are decently easy to do, he also makes a lot of the quizzes use examples from homework so if you do the homework or  extra practice you will be good

The class is well-organized, with a clear syllabus and helpful structure. Quizzes and the final are untimed, and homework allows three attempts. Zoom and in-person support is available. There's one research project, Packback posts, and low-pressure grading. Extra credit and quiz reminders are a plus.
As long as you turn in your assignments and do the work it is more than possible to achieve a good grade in this class. There are lots of extra credit opportunities.

Took the online version, not a hard class. Lectures are monotone and read off slides. You'll need to buy the online textbook to do homework - $85. Also weekly discussion posts. Practice problems are very similar or even identical to the exams. LOTS of extra credit. For me the final didn't end up mattering, its only worth 10%.
Just do the assignments on time and you'll be fine. Do the extra credit opportunities!! Do not skip them

This course was well laid out. The textbook quickly and easily gets your grades in, so you are not left to wonder like many other courses. Peterson was always on top of things too, it was almost impossible to fall behind in the course. Just pay attention to reminders and emails in the course and you will be fine.

The professor was nice and genuine but a bit boring. The course includes conceptual and math questions. Homework had multiple attempts, and quizzes were online, time-flexible, and unproctored. Practice questions and homework closely match quiz questions. He also offers great extra credit opportunities, which I highly recommend doing.

He's a very strict professor when it comes to excuses. The course isn't hard per say, you really have to remember to do the work and set time to learn the materiel. The class is perfectly structured, you are never unsure when something is due. When I had severe mental episode, he made a plan with me to still be able to succeed in the class.

super nice guy and great class structure. totally online and he is reachable and understanding. I had to go to the ER during my semester on the day of a quiz and he was totally understanding about making it up and worked with me to find a good time. would take again 100%
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: If you have interest in accounting, this is a great class to test the waters. If you don't, avoid it at all costs. I found the online class to be incredibly boring, with anywhere from 3 to 10 lecture videos per week to watch (each 2-20 minutes long). He is VERY monotone. The platform used for hw, quizzes & exams is terrible and often glitches.

Overall, he's a very kind and easy-going professor. He will accommodate things like quizzes or participation points for you if anything happens in your life with no problem. I took the class in person, so participation was required. There were 4 quizzes and then the final exam. I strongly recommend using the practice problems to your advantage.

Not a hard class; however, there is a lot of content and information you need to learn. You get several attempts for homework assignments and quizzes are online with no lockdown browser. Prof. Peterson reads off the slides he makes but still tries to make a personal connection with his students. Overall an ok class with nothing extraordinary.

Posts lecture slides every week, typically 8-12 videos varying from 4-16 minutes. The textbook is very tedious but provides good practice questions that are seen in the quiz and shows a lot of graphs to connect your learning to an image. 1 homework assignment a week and quiz (exams) every 4 weeks. 1 large excel assignment.

I just hate paying for online courses. I only reached out to Che one time to ask a question about a quiz, and it led to him connecting me with one of his associates for a job prospect, which was sweet. The course is hit or miss. Weekly discussions on top of homework. Quizzes and exams require heavy study time unless you cheat. Not an easy 4.0.

Prof Peterson is super accessible, very helpful if you have a question. Will open more office hours if you can't come during his. While confusing in MBC, his syllabus directly states when all due dates are. Homework & quizzes can be a little confusing, but it's open note. It is accounting so it is confusing, but he is a great professor overall.
There is not much guidance given by this professor and the class was overall very confusing.

Gotta pay to do ur HW. L professor. no reason for you to not get 100 on every hw, it's online. quizzes, not too bad my lazy self got like 78s so you can probably do better. Easy W for the credit. simple weekly HW (with the use of "external resources") discussion posts you can do in 30 seconds (shout out to gpt) and 4 quizzes hither and thither.

Due dates are all over the place, the list of assignments blends in with the readings/lectures necessary so its confusing reading it section by section. Overwhelming amounts of stuff on your screen. Do not recommend this class, because it was difficult to maintain this class with many other due dates. Very poor system and way of teaching.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Online Savvy

reviews.comment: He uses Mybussinesscourse for the entire class. Meaning you will have to pay $120 just to be able to do the homework that everyone is just going to cheat on anyway. I took this class as a summer class and I didn't have the option to purchase any options for access besides 6 months for $120. He was cool overall as a prof though.

Terrible organization, had to update syllabus numerous times throughout the semester to make adjustments that should have already been there. Bad at checking his email, some peers reported that he took multiple days to respond and only gave a one word answer. If you have to take ACC 230, try a different professor.

Dr. Chrobak is so sweet and helpful. Her class is honestly very easy, and she keeps everything very organized in D2L. She is accessible outside of class if you have any questions. A lot of the times she lets you out of lecture early which is really nice.
My favorite professor so far!

Amazing prof! Super well organized with her schedule and resources. I would recommend her to any student! I definitely grew as a person from the projects in her class, she was very intentional with what she assigned which was so helpful. She really does have everyone's best interest in mind. An easy and enjoyable 4.0!

She is so amazing and funny. Got out of class early each day but she was so willing to help you and doesn't make you feel stupid. She made me feel like I can be myself not only in class, but in the papers I write

I had her for a hybrid WRA 101 course. I was worried initially but it was really nice. We got out of class early most (every) day and while there were occasional readings and assignments to do outside of class, they didn't feel like busywork. A lot of the smaller weekly assignments directly related to the large assignments. Definitely recommend.
She is a great professor and is very open to different writing styles

Dr. Chrobak is the sweetest professor ever!! She is always willing to help her students, and she is very accessible outside of class. Her class has a very easy and clear structure. Each of her assignments have a purpose (she does not like busy work), and she provides great feedback. I would gladly take another class with her!!
Amazing Professor who cares and is willing to help. Lectures are clearly stated. Beautiful women as well!

an amazing professor to say the least. the class was so awesome because of dr chrobak. she made the lectures interesting and really cares about her students. i wish i could have 14 credit hours a semester with dr chrobak, TAKE HER CLASS!!

She is truly amazing. The lectures are fulfilling and inspirational, making me truly enjoy writing. She is super nice too, will respond to my emails and question kindly and patiently. The structure of the class is extremely clear, reducing our workload in finals week. As long as you put in some amount of time and effort, getting a 4.0 is very easy.

Prof. Chrobak is honestly one of the most amazing teachers ever. She is such a great mentor, who emphasizes how much she cares about her students. I had her asynchronously, so we only met in class once a week. She doesn't give much of a workload. Her objectives are always very clear, so it's really easy to get a 4.0. Just turn assignments on time:)
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I loved Ms. Chrobak's class! She was always kind and I enjoyed the material we went over in class. The assignments we had in class were good because we could choose something that mattered to us. I would definitely recommend this professor.

The class was super easy and we only met once a week, we had 4 main assignments but they were really easy and i got 100% on all of them, you do read some articles and have questions to answer but it is very very easy and honestly made my workload lighter. shes super nice and funny and is very considerate

Amazing teacher. I enjoy her teaching style, and she makes it very clear that she cares about us and wants us to succeed. The course material is fun and engaging. One thing to note is that there are no required textbooks; I bought an MLA textbook by mistake as MSU's bookstore shows the book as required. Other than that absolutely amazing class.

Mrs. Chrobak is by far the best professor I've ever had. She made my worst subject actually interest me. She has such great energy and genuinely cares about her students. 100% recommend taking a class with her!
She's great! Super cool and chill. She makes her class simple yet engaging. I usually dread writing/english classes but she was great and nothing to worry about.

Best professor I have ever had! Class is super easy as long as you do the assignments. Theres barely any homework and the papers are very easy and relatable. She is super nice and caring. Very easy grader and 100% recommend taking her class.

Very easy class to pass just do your assignments. Assignments are relatable topics and not too long. Super laid back professor and class. My class was supposed to be 2 hours but never went longer than 45 min.

I would recommend anyone that is taking this class to look for an opening with her in it. Shes by far one of my favorite teachers at MSU. Theres 4 Writing Assignments throughout the semester with no tests or quizzes and at max 30 minutes of homework besides the assignments. As long as you follow the rubric you should easily get an A!

Jill Chrobak has been one of my favorite professors at Michigan State so far. She makes writing an enjoyable task and allows her students to be creative. The amount of work assigned is very doable and she allows students to come to her for feedback on their assignments before the turn-in date. I loved her class and would recommend it.
This professor was amazing and changed the way I look at writing, absolutely loved her class but not an easy pass. Do the homework and write your essays but professor is prime.

The best WRA 101 prof ever! Take her online section, mandatory class once a week but she always lets you out super early. Cancels class a lot. Clear on assignments, everything is online. Papers are very easy. If you do the work on time you will 4.0 Her lectures are actually very fun and interesting she incorporates rap culture and stuff.

Incredible professor. Very easy going and makes writing assignments enjoyable. No exams and gives helpful feedback for each writing assignment. I would definitely recommend taking her class if you need an easy writing class to take. Given 3 excused absences.

Professor Chrobak is an awesome and nice but you need a 95% in the class to get a 4.0. She will only round if you have a 94.5% or higher. I recommend taking her class just make sure you double check the rubric and your papers are error free.
reviews.rating_tags: Tests? Not many--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Amazing prof, she is passionate about her students and the subject. She treats everyone with such kindness and inspired me throughout the semester to fall in love with language and writing and sharing it. The syllabus can be a little confusing, and the grading scale is challenging (96% to 4.0) but if you put work in your grade will reflect that.

Cindy Hunter-Morgan is an absolutely amazing professor. I cannot stress enough how inspirational her passion for writing is, or how much she cares about her students. She helped me improve my writing tremendously over the course of the semester, and even as an "English person" her class challenged me to become a better writer. tldr; she's awesome!

Cindy Hunter Morgan is the best human that I have met at this university. She has inspired me to WANT to read and write in my free time. She makes you work for the grade but I know that she just sees everyone's potential. I just wanna give her a hug.

Cimberly's organization was extremely confusing, and assignments were very loosely defined, leading to a lot of confusion. The class was extremely easy (as long as you did the very minimal homework) until the last month, when there were multiple group presentations. Overall, an easy 4.0, but can be confusing at times.

Attendance is MANDATORY. If you don't show up you won't pass. Group project is a huge part of the class with multiple presentations. She gets mad at students for having their computers open or doing anything besides paying attention. She will also get mad at you for being 5 mins late.

Overall, the class is an easy 4.0. If you go to class and complete your assignments it's a guaranteed A. The problem I had with her is that she can be very condescending whenever you speak to her, as many have said before. She gets worked up when the class isn't engaged, but gives lackluster lectures that sways no student to be engaged.
Super easy class but she is a micromanager in every way

Cimberly is a very nice professor. But I felt like she would send condescending emails to you if you hadn't submitted a discussion, even if it was before the due date. In office hours, she would be very distracted and not really listening to you. I get she's busy but the multitasking made me feel unimportant.
She wants the best for everyone. Super cool and understanding. wants to set you up to succeed outside her class

(GD 491) SheS nice enough, but not very organized. I found myself frustrated at times bc I was never sure what was being asked of me, and she rarely ever checked in with her students on an individual level which would've been nice because I felt lost sometimes. I like creative freedom but it was almost too open-ended.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--Lots of homework--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Overall this class was great, but sometimes it felt like we were just trying to fill time with the mandatory attendance. The graded assignments were all clear and straight-forward. Rebecca is amazing and truly cares for your well being, and is always ready to help. Just be prepared to do a bit of supplemental reading outside of the graded work.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Caring--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Professor Cifaldi's course was fairly easy, but she didn't really convey what we were supposed to do for a lot of assignments very clearly, and her feedback was not really that helpful. She also doesn't seem that great with the technology, and the class had a heavy analogue focus. She's nice though, and if you put in a little effort you'll do fine.

Cifaldi is a lovely woman BUT a rough professor. I've taken two of her graphic design classes and both have been a waste of my time. All her classes center around is theory and readings - that's all you do is READ. You never actually do any creative projects or use the skills you've learned. I know theory is important but she's so incredibly boring
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Super sweet. Really cares about each student and takes the time to walk around and see how everyone is doing with assignments and projects. The whole semester revolved around group work related to putting together the final project.

Professor Cifaldi is great! She's really kind and you definitely won't have a bad time in her class. She genuinely cares for what she teaches and her students wellbeing. Super understanding. She provides many XC opportunities if your grade flunks. Would definitely recommend, I hope I can take another class from her.

I love this professor. Super nice, communicates well, and truly cares about the mental health of her students. She was also ready, present, and prepared for class, She was super engaging and I wish more professors at MSU where like her. She should be teaching a class on how to be a professor. :)

I loved this class. Prof Cifaldi was an amazing woman who wants to bring new ideas into class. The textbook is used throughout the class, but she provided it for us so no need to purchase it. Focused a lot of new artists, and also artists often overlooked in history. Definitely worth taking one of her classes.
He really cares about what he teaches and is very knowledgeable about reproduction! Cares about his students.

I absolutely loved Dr. Cibelli. I took his class because it was the only thing that fit into my schedule. It ended up being my favorite class of the semester. Dr. Cibelli is so smart, kind, and passionate and so clearly wants his students to succeed. His exams are majorly based on the quizzes and in class questions. 10/10 recommend.

I absolutely loved Dr. Cibelli. I enrolled in his class because it was the only one that fit in my schedule. I did not have an interest in animal reproduction. It became my favorite class of the semester. Dr. Cibelli is so smart and kind, passionate about what he does, and so clearly wants his students to succeed. His exam expectations were clear.

He is a nice guy who knows a lot about animal reproduction. The material itself was pretty confusing and he goes through the lectures super fast but as long as you write everything down from his slides you'll be good. All his quizzes and exams were online and most of the material could be found on his lecture slides.

This prof was AWESOME!! Super helpful and knowledgable about animal reproduction. Everything that was on exams/ quizzes could be directly found in the powerpoint slides, so I'd recommend writing everything down. He kept things interesting and genuinely cares for his students.

This professor, grades the assignments very tough, doesn't have clear instructions on the assignments, expects certain things on homeworks/assignments that aren't written. I understand having teachers with accents but hers is impossible to make word of, "required" attendance but no grade on it. DO NOT TAKE!

The class is based off readings or videos to watch before the lecture, to which do not connect to the lectures. I constantly find myself in class being confused on what exactly it is that we are supposed to be learning. The class itself is not difficult, but she makes it confusing. She calls on students for answers to teach the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Group projects

reviews.comment: Bruh this teacher honestly doesn't know what she's talking about
Doesn't give directions for assignments. Talks about nothing you need to know in class.

Dr. Lopez is an awesome lady and knows very well what she is talking about. This is a great course to take if you are interested in the development of the world around us. She is a very fair grader, but sometimes the homework sneaks up on you if you don't keep track. Attendance is required and you'll miss a lot if you aren't there. Great class.
He's having a baby

Mathis dgaf and neither do I. He's alright I guess. Doesn't make up for the fact that physics makes me so angry I get nauseous and I am questioning all of my life decisions right now. Still not gonna use ch*tgpt though. I may hate physics but I hate Sam Altman more.

Mathis is chill guy. There are worse profs

Dr. Mathis was nice, but he was always very confused about his own class. He seems like he does not know how to teach and would rather be doing research. Things were constantly going wrong in class, and there was never any good instructional time; we were just handed piles of worksheets and were expected to blindly do them. EC & make-ups were nice.
I still am unsure how to do physics. I think i 4.00?
He always leaves in the middle of class and doesn't come back. Where's he going?

Extremely tolerant & patient & respectful. Decent lecturer. Keeps self-promotion of his work to a minimum but it's still very slightly annoying. D2L somewhat poorly organized. Projects take up a LOT of time, beware. Pretty good feedback on projects. Strange attendance policy. Most material probably could be independently learned from Scott McCloud

STA201: Loved this class. LOTS of work depending on how ambitious you are. Show up to class even if you don't have the project done. Chime in during discussions. It's always been a dream of mine to make comics and this class has let me do that. 
Btw you don't need the course pack if you're a digital artist. Ames lettering at most for one assignment

Honestly, it's the participation. As another rating said, if you are even 30 seconds late he will mark you absent. I was 1 minute late once, and I walked in and he had already started lecturing. He doesn't even wait for class to start to take role. The class is also focused heavily on time-management, but it's HIS time management. Not good for all.

He obviously knows what he's talking about, but does so in a way that is accessible and down-to-earth. If you're interested in exploring the comics medium or diving in to improve your work, the comics courses with Ryan Claytor are a great way to go. Workload is a bit demanding, but I've never experienced another class that made me feel so proud!
Great teacher! very fun class and easy to talk to

This professor will mark you late for being a minute off time a class period after he was five minutes tardy himself. He loves to advertise to his students, and will add ads for his own personal benefit to your homework assignments. If you show up loving drawing, you might hate it by the time he's done with you.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Excellent teacher. Dedicated, respectful, knowledgeable, and well prepared. Makes the extra effort to make lectures interesting.

Honestly really disappointed in Dr V and course. I love my HDFS classes and was excited for this course, but the way it was delivered was atrocious. There were SO many guest lectures and I lost points on a paper due to my references not being found in the database (even though they were) she just didn't take the time to look. Very condescending.
Don't take if you can avoid. I get it's a parenting by class but it's all from her parenting perspective and I feel like very few lectures helped on the THREE 6 page papers. EXTREMELY tough grader
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: Felt more like a personal therapy class for her to talk about things going on in her life and "how we would respond to it." Every paper we do has three separate due dates for references, 3 weeks in advance of the due date, which is extremely unnecessary. Tough grader on everything surrounding the papers, including finding scientific research. Avoid

Seems nice, kind of condescending. I was so excited to take this class until i realized it was not what i thought. So many long papers and she's a TOUGH GRADER! Random guest lectures constantly that (in my opinion) waste time. Random attendance so you never really know when you need to be there. Don't take if you can avoid.

HDFS 414.... 3 papers- very detailed and had to use scientific evidence. I wouldn't take her again but it was fine. Some discussions in class. Papers were kinda hard and they SUCKED. Don't think it is just an easy A. Hard grader on essays
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: Way too much work always given during class time. Always struggled with fellow group members to turn in assignments on time as group assignments would be due 20 minutes after they were assigned.

This woman will talk and talk forever about nonsense. Lectures and homework and exams do not match up at all. Gave me a 0 because I submitted the final in the wrong format. 0 in the CLASS mind you, and I did all the coursework and showed up. Take any other option because this woman will ruin your peace and gpa.

This class was my LEAST favorite class. The class was very unorganized and didn't follow any type of structure. In class assignments had nothing to do with what we were actually learning about. Overall, just a mean professor and a very boring class.

Dr Vergara is a really boring professor. She reads off of the slides the whole class, leaves a short amount of time for in class assignments, and also assigns assignments on topics we haven't covered yet. Luckily the content is really easy so the assignments aren't actually hard.

Class is very easy, but boring at times. Lectures are disorganized. No tests, no final. 1 assignment and home quiz a week. She grades tough sometimes, but you can have two drops per category. Be in class b/c there's in class work on random days and you can't make it up, you have to be there (that is the largest part of your grade minus the final).

Has very harsh late work policies and is not easy to work with when it comes to missing assignments. She wasn't very clear during her lectures and couldn't convey her message very well. She was very nice when you were talking to her and never treated students poorly in class. DON"T SKIP CLASS.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Awful teacher. takes forever to grade homework or any work in general and lectures are very unorganized. nobody knows what going on.

Dr. Vergara was good for an online course. I have seen the other ratings about her, but I did not experience that with this class. Although she is a tough grader, she does offer some extra credit and good feedback. Vergara's instructions were straight forward and easy to follow. The homework for this class was on the easier side compared to others.

The class is very easy to get a good grade in if you show up to every class and do the work, however, she is a terrible professor. Reminds me of a shitty high school teacher. Her lectures are so unorganized and she talks the entire time and then gives no time to do in class assignments that she is strict on the deadline for. Shes a terrible prof.

The worst ISB you can take, definitely would recommend anything else. Grades EXTREMELY hard and will not change it under ANY circumstances. Wants specific SPOT ON answers, if worded differently she will take off .275 point off.

Worst professor I've had. Makes a class that shouldn't be difficult impossible. Grading is very specific, taking off odd points (-.888 or -2.545) for little things. Doesn't give enough time to do work, submit 1 minute late you get a 0. Incredibly rude and won't give back points under any circumstances. Save your GPA and take another ISB.

worst professor I have every had, would never take this class again. she wants stuff done in specific ways but won't tell you them. this class sets you up to fail. if you are taking it if you show up you will pass, but i don't recommend taking it.
She's a terrible teacher
She would give you barely any time to do assignments.
just terrible

Gives out random pop quizzes during class when that's not part of the syllabus at all. Feels like the entire class is just improvised, class work/homework and lectures will be totally unrelated to each other.
Very hard to follow at times, and repeats a lot of information.

ISB at MSU with Dr. Vergara starts with two weeks of syllabus. No late work is accepted, even by 5 minutes. Weekly "preparations" feel pointless, graded by TAs/ULAs who look for keywords. ICA tasks are rushed, with just 25 minutes to complete. Grading feels unclear and strict.
Doesn't really do anything as a professor. Also clearly struggles with using D2L so just chooses to never update it.

Does not care about her students at all. Assignments had nothing to do with what she was teaching. Not enough time for in class assignments that you're forced to do in groups. Very hard grader, looks for very specific answers without clear directions. Lectures were long and drawn out and she is hard to understand.

Would do a lecture concerning one subject and make us do an assignment that isn't relevant to what we're studying. If you take that professor, get ready to improvise knowledge at light speeds to complete enormous assignments (2 full pages or more), her group system is obsolete too, if one of you doesn't show up your amount of work WILL be bigger.

When I first saw all the reviews, I thought she couldn't be that bad but trust me DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. I have never met a professor who is so unwilling to help her students and who genuinely doesn't care about them at all. She gives very limited time to do long assignments and then she is an extremely difficult grader for absolutely no reason.

Cannot understand her. Gave my whole group a 0 on the final because she never specified if the final was a group or individual project. Terrible teacher, DO NOT recommend this teacher at all and honestly don't know why Mix
Unprofessional and irrelevant assignments

This professor is easily the worst professor I have ever had at MSU. This class is already boring, but Claudia Vergara makes it worse.  She gives us 10 min to complete a 45-minute assignment and has no remorse for not completing the assignment. I don't recommend her at all, try your hardest not to take a class with this professor.

The grading criteria for every assignment is never clear and you often get points taken away because you don't meet the exact format/answer she wants, while not specifying what that is. Gives very little time to do the in class assignments and often means you can't finish them effectively. Would not recommend this professor, find someone else.
She grades badly and wants a specific way of answering questions but won't tell you how to answer them, doesn't give enough time in class for the in class assignments.
She assigns things without telling you and will not be lenient at all if you mess up.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS! She grades everything insanely harshly, feedback is not helpful she expects an exact answer from open note responses, she usually uploads assignments on weekends and never tells her class when she does so. She reads off a slide for an hour then gives you no time to do the assignment. Most disorganized course I've ever taken.

She is the worst professor I've had at MSU, she uploads assignments and quizzes on D2L throughout the entire course without ever talking about the deadlines for them in class and there are 0 email reminders which makes no sense for a class that the majority of your final grade is the hw and quizzes she assigns for hw.

Honestly, the class really isnt that bad. You just have to make sure that you are always checking D2L and keeping a planner. Her quizzes had no time limit and were fully open note. Yes, she is a tough grader, but once you learn how to write to her style it's relativly simple work. Just show up and put effort into the assigments and you will be ok

I would give this professor a negative score if I could. This class is sooooo disorganized, she jumps all over the place and the class has no structure. Most of the work needs to be done on the weekends and they are graded harshly. You never know what to expect in class and be prepared to not have enough time to do anything!

Actually horrible, the worst professor I have ever had. She gives you 20 minutes in class to do 40 minutes of work that's due by the end of the class period.  You work in unfair groups. She does NOT teach she just reads off a slide and is incredibly hard to understand.

Do not take this course. Professor is condescending and class is very disorganized. The course assignments are not predetermined, and her assignments are open at the whim of the professor without warning or student knowledge. A majority of the coursework is assigned over the weekend and not during the week. Group assignments are attendance.

She does not give adequate time to complete in-class assignments, the course material does not make sense, it is week 6 and I feel like I have learned nothing. Her grading is tough and she expects specific answers to open-ended questions and up for interpretation.

Never in my entire academic career can I truly say I have had an incompetent professor/teacher. Dr. Vergara happily broke ground on this and kept digging. She actively sabotages us. she treats her students like toddlers while also complaining that we are adults and need to be responsible. Avoid at all costs. sandpaper treadmill. AVOID AVOID AVOID!!

This professor is nothing but an obstacle, will provide 0 support and have pointless lectures that have nothing to do with the work. Gives a solid 15-20 minutes for work that takes at least 45 minutes to do in class with Zero leniency for if you didn't finish. ABSOLUTELY DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. This is a teacher that should be retired. God Help You
she sucks cant understand what she says
best prof in the world. Answers to all of her assignments are present online. Moreover the class is easy af with more than ample amount of time given for each assignment.

Much of the work seemed unnecessary. She often contradicted herself when explaining assignments which was very confusing. The assignments were assigned during class and we only had until the end of class (often 20 minutes) to complete something that might need 45 minutes. Because of this, the quality of the work and grades weren't the best.

Do not take this class. She doesn't grade things until the end of the semester so if you were doing something wrong all along, you wouldn't know until it's too late. Her lectures were pointless and awful. You have to answer the EXACT way she wants it and if you don't she will dock points off for the most absurd things. Very poorly ran class.

This is the worst course I have ever taken, by far. She has incredibly high expectations for her assignments, but does not give enough time to complete them with the quality she wants. Today, we had 20 minutes to do a 12 question assignment (written-response), and the content of the assignments is rarely discussed beforehand. DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS

The fact that everyone is on their computer not paying attention to her rambling says it all. She has 0 respect for you so you should have no respect for her. She treats you as a middle schooler and removes points if your phone is out. The assignments don't fit the work and she'll dock points for the dumbest stuff. God forgive you if you're late.

Don't take this class with her. The only good thing is it is all group work, you get one assignment per day and that is the "attendance" as well as most of the work. She will randomly post assignments due before some of the classes and randomly post assignments for the weekend. Doesn't want to help, just enjoys to ramble and give poor lectures.

Do not take this class, always check rate my professor. She gave me a 2.0 when I normally get 3.0-4.0s. She didn't grade assignments until after finals. You never know when you'll have an assignment and your answers have to be exactly to her liking.

Professor Vergara is a nice person by all means, but at points her courses felt unclear. Lectures are mandatory due to her in class assignments and sometimes instructions aren't entirely clear and grading is late + doesn't always make sense. Sometimes the class resources were of no use and we were discouraged from using ungiven resources.

Graded absolutely nothing until the very final few weeks of class at which point she was a tough grader but would not allow you to talk to her about the grades as they were from too long ago. She does not answer emails, and provides no help to students. All lectures are pointless but necessary as she will make you do in class assignments.
Simply just don't take this class. Whatever you do.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: You have to answer the exact same way she wants it. Tears apart your answers when grading. Grades everything all at once and won't know grade until end of semester. When you ask for any kind of help she blows you off. Only responds to emails when you CC her department head and will tell you to go to office hours, which she never shows up to.

overrated in difficulty, make sure to be ready to write actual answers that aren't short. Your group matters a lot and if they don't care it could make the class terrible. Not the worst teacher in the world.

This class is not easy compared to other ISB classes, There are few homework assignments (one to two a week), so just be prepared to write more than one sentence per answer. In-class assignments make attendance mandatory. Grades more strictly than other profs here and expects you to be able to figure out things on your own and not ask for answers.

Class was very lecture heavy. Attendance is mandatory because there are always group assignments. Although you won't know your grade until she starts grading everything in the last 2 weeks of the semester! And the grades are awful because she gives no expectations on what you're supposed to write, then deducts points like crazy. DO NOT TAKE

she was very unfair when it came to grading, she was not understanding at all and she literally gave assignments that were hard to understand. would not recommend for you to take if you have other options.
This class is almost completely group work, with 2 assignments a week as homework. This class wasn't bad.

Hhe is very inconsistent with grading and doesn't do it until end of semester, she speaks broken English, does NOT respond to emails or help with any issues, puts you into unfair groups, grading is unreasonable, gave multiple 0's for assignments turned in on time and well written with no feedback. I do not recommend anyone take her classes.
Takes forever to grade and when she does it is very inconsistent and unreasonable. The lecture is nothing like the in class assignments nor the homework.

She grades as if she wants your response to be the exact same way as hers. Her lectures have nothing to do with the group work or pop quizzes at the end of the week. NOT UNDERSTANDING at all. Expects you to understand all of bio before taking the introduction class.
If you get her, drop the course.
I failed this class cause I didn't use this website beforehand

The only good things about this class are that it's only group work every day, so while it's hard work there are people to work with. Another thing is that she doesn't give tests, so it is easy to get a good grade. However, she doesn't tell you when she posts assignments, you just have to hope you find them before they're due! Find another prof.

Seems like she has not changed since 2009. Gives out a ton of homework as if it were an online or hybrid course. If you value your time and mental well being, I would take ISB with a different professor. She grades very slowly as well (week 5 assignments graded on week 13), so you won't know if you failed or passed after finals week. Save yourself!

Literally the class ever. DO NOT TAKE ISB 202 WITH HER. YOU WILL REGRET IT!!!!! Long lectures and given little in class time to finish assignments. Also, you will have no idea what your grade is until the end. Overall just very bad and unprofessional. She's often very rude too and not understanding of her students. Take ISB 202 with someone else.

The content is fine but the professor makes it much more difficult. We are sometimes given 10-15 minutes of class time to complete an activity that should take around 30 minutes. She also uploads assignments at random times, making it extremely easy to miss assignments and receive 0s, and we don't know our grade until the end of semester.

Long lectures with little time to work on the group assignments. Hard grader with little to no feedback on the assignments when mistake is made. Many take this class solely for requirement, but her grading is geared towards real biology majors. Would not recommend. Topics are very friendly and familiar however.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This class is just like most generic lectures, a lot of slideshows, and a really boring class. However, the only reason this stands out from the rest is how the professor acts. For someone who has taught for years, she doesn't seem to regard her students as learning pupils, rather just "subjects". I would 100% take a different professor.

should've known with the other reviews.

she puts out assignments randomly without any mention, so the only way to really know is by checking the D2L page every single day. 

the lectures she gives out are essentially her rambling about random stuff, never getting into detail but also wasting time for the "required" group projects at the end.

reviews.comment:
Pop quizzes basically every week on stuff she hasn't taught or talked about. Many assignments requiring 30-40 minutes are expected to be due under 10 minutes.

reviews.comment:
If you can take an online class with her, do it!! I took an online class with her and it was very well structured, with all of our assignments due on Sundays. 

If you take notes on the videos, do all the homework and take notes on all the lectures, you will get an A. Exam questions are taken directly from the material and open note.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Easy 4.0 class to take to get the ISS requirement out of the way. Attendance isn't mandatory and there is either a quiz, exam or discussion form to do once a week. She gives plenty of time to get it all done and you can choose to take it in class or anywhere else. Easy material to learn. Would 100% recommend for an easy 4.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Professor was great. Class was easy of you went to lecture and took good notes. Lectures would end usually 15-20 minutes early.

Fairly easy class, very friendly. Attendance is not mandatory but it is difficult to get the lectures from a missed class. Watched some hour long movies in class which we would have questions on on a quiz or exam.
Boring mandatory lectures. If you miss lecture, it's difficult to get the information. ISS 230 with her was easy enough though.

Cowley's class is pretty easy to get an A in. The lectures may seem like fluff, but it's important to show up since some days she'll go over things that will be included on the exams (which are easy). She's extremely lenient, but you do have to put in some effort and also build connections with your classmates, it will help you through the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Cowley is not a bad professor. That being said she has her oddities. She has quite a boring voice and lectures a ton. She also has you watch these movies that are an hour or more but I found them interesting. If you are willing to just sit down for a couple hours a week and work, you will be fine in the class.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Her lectures had no point and the tests had nothing to do with what you learn in class. Just do her a billion hour homework and watch the videos she posts.

Professor Cowley is passionate about what she teaches and makes getting a good grade easy. Acing the tests is easy, as long as you do the work and show up to class during specific lectures. She has a great drop policy and goes over all test material in class. I would take this class again!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: It was a very fun class! I don't understand why there are negative reviews here. She is great. Easy material. You have to push yourself when doing the assignments. That's how I got a 4.0

Cowley was a very nice person and cared about her students success. There are many films to watch and readings to finish but with the time given to complete, it isn't a struggle. The course seemed like it was going to be all fast paced but she made sure things weren't thrown at you at last minute so you could be prepared for the exams-open note.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Cowley has lots of lectures, lots of videos, and movies to watch. I feel like if the class was in person, it'd be a lot more boring. The work and exams were easy, it was just time-consuming. I did like the class because I liked learning about the topics (such as the cold war, the berlin wall, migration, et cetera).
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: She is very nice, but is not very realistic in what she is asking of students. She lectures a lot and drags on and on. She does not post lecture notes online, and It is very hard to keep up and take notes. Also, ISS 230 is very boring! However despite all of that, she is very caring and understanding. She did very well with online transformation.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: Really knowledgeable professor & nice lady! Required courses are hard to make interesting, but I just brought a coffee, stayed awake, & ended up learning a good amount! We also watched lots of movies! If you go to class and pay attention you will not fail.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: She literally has the most monotone voice that I have ever heard in my entire life. I took her ISS 230 class. Every class usually has a hour of notes then we watch a foreign movie that is painfully hard to stay awake for that we are actually tested on. Tests are hard. You have to attend every class if you want to get a solid grade. I got a 3.5
DO not recommend
She says attendance is mandatory, god forbid you don't participate in a lecture... it's 8am and the lady can't stick to one topic. Overall, don't recommend. I see why she got a low rating.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The professor is wonderful, I just didn't always enjoy lecture.

Communication is key for this class. Professor Contreras is very understanding with her students and genuinely cares for them. She even asks students what she could do so they can better understand her class. Her class does involve lots of reading but she gives students enough time to do the assignments Most caring professor by far.

Take the other ratings with a grain of salt. I had her for IAH207H, and she was fantastic! She can ramble and seem unorganized at times, but she always gave good feedback on paper ideas and can definitely help if you're struggling! She genuinely cares for her students and has our best interests in mind.

Prof Contreras is a caring professor who is readily available to her students if they need help, and my writing ability definitely improved in the class. However, she is somewhat unorganized, rambles, and the course theme didn't really feel very connected to me. Her teaching style will work better for some than others, and unfortunately not me.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: I don't get why her rating is so low, I thought she was an amazing professor. She gives really good feedback on her assignments and makes sure that no one is confused by class material. She's also super nice, she made sure I was ok when I once got overwhelmed and had to leave abruptly. The class is VERY reading heavy, so be prepared for that.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: Professor Contreras gets way too hard of a rap on here. I had her for ENG 328 but I don't know how to add a new course code on here. Yes, she is unorganized but if you just tell her something is wrong or there is a mistake on the calendar SHE WILL fix it! She is so understanding if you just talk to her. She's so knowledgeable and caring.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Group projects--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Absolutely terrible class. I took Women's Writers and did not learn a single thing. Beyond unorganized class structure. Assignments are unattainable and do not pertain to anything. Taking this class seriously feelings like walking in the dark hoping you don't trip. Spent over $100 buying novels, and were expected to read one book a week. DONT DO IT
soooo unorganized. literally could not find any assignments, nothing made sense and the whole class felt very pointless and not educational. 100% do not take her class.

Extremely disorganized and also likes to push her political agenda and personal beliefs on students, just wants students to agree wit her. Wish she would let us think more freely. Must write about issues from her view and it is very tough/intimidating to disagree with her.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I would not recommend anybody take this class or any other class this professor teaches. Absolutely terrible at communicating and is insanely disorganized. Do not take this class unless you like not knowing what is going on week after week. Absolutely no accountability on her end and books also cost way too much money.

I wouldnt recommend this class to really anyone. Its just horrible. The book cost was over $200 for the class. The lectures are just her talking with no breaks or visual aid and it is so disorganized. She is extremely opinionated and wants other people to agree with her. Basically wont let you share an opposing view if you have one. 2/10.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Beware of pop quizzes

reviews.comment: I took this class thinking that I was going to learn a lot about women's suffrage or modern women's equality movements. However, myself and most of the students in the class that I talked to said that they did not get from the class what they wanted. This class is highly revolved around the prof's opinion and there is little factual discussion.
She lectures a lot, but she is interesting to listen to. She requires a lot of class discussion.
Great professor! Lectures were always engaging and there were only 4 quizzes a semester + the final exam. Lectures aren't recorded but he does post the slides.
The way quizzes and tests were worded was a little tricky — definitely go to class, and don't just memorize the material, a lot of things were application-based. Really interesting class though.

He wants us to be challenged a little bit and writes the quizzes in a way that we would be stimulated. I loved the material and didn't mind it, and this was easily my favorite class this semester! The material is pretty clear. although it goes a little fast.

I liked Professor Cowan, it's just the way he worded the questions on his quizzes that had me tripping up. Attendance isn't mandatory, but his class is hard so I would definitely recommend going to them.
Decently easy class

You can do fine on quizzes if you go to every lecture. Lecture slides are posted after class. I averaged a 98% on quizzes by going through the slides and typing everything up and reviewing it. Lectures are interesting. EC is available through SONA, or an essay. Very interesting topics discussed in class, and you can tell Prof Cowan is passionate.

Mr. Cowan was very professional and talked a lot during class. He said his exams were hard—and they were. Even though they were only 20 questions and open-note, I felt stressed due to limited time and space. I wish there were more interactive activities. Homework was light—just one weekly Achieve task.

I honestly liked him as a professor; he was very professional. But it's not open note now for quizzes and exams. I do very poorly on quizzes if I miss class, SO i really recommend going and taking notes from what he's talking about. Tip: definitely don't remember the material, and even less so how to apply it to the quizzes and exams.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Prof. Cowan is a great guy and very professional. Attendance isn't mandatory, but I found that I would perform poorly on quizzes if I missed class. There are four quizzes with one drop, but even though they are open note, I got mediocre scores. Little to no homework, but make sure you study hard for the quizzes (they make up 40% of your grade).

She's nice and approachable. In each class, you answer mandatory ICA questions from the slides with your table group as she lectures. Iclicker attendance. Group CER's. Practice exams are usually identical to the real ones, so fill your note sheet to the brim. The repettiveness can become boring, but bear through it, there's few absences allowed.

BEST PROFESSOR I'VE EVER HAD. She's extremely passionate about biology and it shines in her lectures. She's well rounded and cares about her students plus she's funny and adds memes to her slides! Whats not to love??? The exams are very similar to the practice exams and as long as you participate in class + complete ICA's, you are bound to succeed.

Grading criteria and concepts are relatively simple. Her lectures are good and she makes the materials simple to understand (no curve ball questions on exams). Exams are relatively straightforward and practice exams are almost identical to the actual exams. The assignments are collaborative. Only issue I have is that you need a 92% to get a 4.0

Overall good professor. Her lectures were engaging and she tried to make the class fun. The work was mildly difficult but she made it easier to understand. Not too sure about other BS162 professors, but she would be a good option if you need to take BS162.

BEWARE. She was the worst professor I have ever had. Disorganized and the TA did more work than she did. Seems passionate about the subject matter but doesn't come across as someone with a PhD. My recommendation would be to take any course she teaches with someone else if you can.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Your lab group definitely makes a difference, and I was lucky mine worked well together. The professor was extremely nice and passionate, and she would give extensions if you needed and emailed her. Doing things with R was a little difficult, but she works through it with you. Going out to collect samples was SO fun too, I had a blast.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Although attendance was mandatory, the in class assignments were not hard at all. Professors were understanding and tried to make sure the students were the focus of this course. The course was challenging to get a 4.0 in because the grade was heavily based on the exams which were graded hard and didn't reflect the content from the lectures.

Now known as professor Monks, she is very kind and helpful. This class is not for the weak or slackers, but she is helpful. However, this class is mostly reliant on group work and your TA's teaching. I had an awesome TA: Riley Pizza. Recitation has a lot of homework for a recitation but its honors so it makes sense.

The class setup was different than what I was used to so didn't like that. Attendance matters and so does participating with in class questions. Exams were short answer and took her a while to grade. She was a very understanding professor though.

This professor gives very 'vague' feedback and it was often conflicting with what our other professor would suggest if we asked (BS162 is set up currently to have 2 sections in lab at the same time, therefore 2 Lab Instructors/professor). Other than that, she was good at lecturing and if you go to her help hours she clears any questions up.

(Taught with both Dr. Higley and Garnett) The fun part of this lab were the experiences and lab activities in the river, but in the actual lab it can be pretty boring. The ULAs grade almost everything and there is not much feedback given which made it hard to know what you got points off on. A lot of work for only a two credit lab in my opinion.
reviews.rating_tags: Group projects--So many papers--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: In lecture, she tries to make the information as interesting as it can be, maybe even more than it can be. She engages with the information more than just surface level, which really helps in understanding material. Great class. Great professor.
Dr. Higley is super sweet and tries her best to help! She's a great lab professor and knows her stuff. The class is hard with RStudio being involved, but she will be there to help along the way.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Group projects

reviews.comment: Best experience in the MSU biology department so far. The pacing of the class is very manageable. She is personable and replies to emails fast! Class is the least boring one I have this semester. The CM questions took some getting used to but not bad after that. I think she does the BS172 lab as well and take that over 171 if you can. I wish I did.

My section was ran by a graduate assistant for the actual lab periods (who was great), but Corrine herself seems to be a really nice and understanding person from my experience with her recitations. I didn't really love the course or the layout, but the course is still very manageable. We only used one of the two texts, but not often.

This was a very disorganized class, the grades page was all over the place. Lots of busy work and pointless little activities to do. Overall an easy class to pass but I don't want take another class in CSUS based purely on this class. A big project was a video book review we had to submit on youtube, I don't know why she bothered. Very slow grader.

Took online. Nice professor, answered emails quickly. The class was a module every week which was lectures, a open note quiz, and sometimes a case study which was longer writing quiz. One final exam, have not taken that yet. Overall easy class, and interesting material.

Prof was very accessible and responded quickly to emails. Class was weird and mostly just busywork and tons of assignments but very easy to complete. Wasn't a clear order/structure of the class (random assignments every week) but prob better in person? Some weeks were less work according to holidays/breaks. Overall decent but wouldn't take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: This professor was very... different. One of the homework assignments showed us how privileged some were than others and there was a quiz on how to apologize to people. It's super easy but there are assignments every week. I wouldn't recommend it but definitely not hard.

Pros: Easy content, extra credit, and professor is responsive if you need help
Cons: D2L page is very disorganized and lots of busywork

This was my second course with Dr. Eustice, but CSUS 200 was much more disorganized. The content is not difficult, you just have to pay close attention and there are lots of unnecessary assignments.
A lot of busy work for this class but not too difficult to succeed. Just make sure to keep track of all the assignments and pace yourself.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--EXTRA CREDIT--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Dr. Eustice is a great advisor and is good about communicating with students. The intro class has a lot of busywork, but it's all very easy. As long as you remember to check in with the class every week, it's easy to succeed.

Crystal is a good professor and a great advisor. This class can be boring at times but not bad for a 200-level class that all SPRT students have to take. Staying on top of the work she assigns is generally easy and assignments were never overly stressful.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Lots of busywork in the class, not hard and not graded very hard. Shes super slow when grading, and needed a technology break the week we had a 150 pt project due. Her office hours were through zoom so there was no way to contact her. Wont respond to emails, but isnt a tough grader. Wouldnt recommend her if you dont have to take the class.
A lot of assignments and readings are kinda pointless but they are easy enough to get through.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Caring

reviews.comment: The professor is a great person, BUT she was extremely disorganized. You have to go to class and take notes since nothing is posted online. If you miss class, then you will most definitely be behind. The overall grade in the class is determined only by harshly graded weekly homework assignments and 2 exams. Take this class with another professor!

get in good with the TAs because they're the only ones grading anything. there was a help room every week and she hosted another one every weekend, you basically have to go. if you miss class at all you're cooked bc she has almost nothing online.
One of the worst!
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Participation matters

reviews.comment: Take this class in the spring. The lectures are atrocious and incredibly difficult to follow. She is very disorganized and cant answer a question without creating 3 more.
