reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Professor DeVeaux is one of the only professors I have had at MSU who genuinely cares about his students and their professional futures. Despite his Master's curriculum being noted as rather "hard" (esp projects course) if you are someone who is willing to put in the time and communicate mistakes openly... you'll be just fine! And prepared for job

MKT 891 Elective Project Course Professor DeVeaux is by far the best professor I have ever had. He has made me a better researcher and better student. This course is a lot of work, however is it extremely beneficial and crucial for the capstone project and future career projects. This course is not an easy A, but it will be worth it later on!

DeVeaux was my favorite professor in the MSMR program. I took his elective class which was very much like a real-life 40hr a week job, but so worth it. This class, and many of his other classes, prepared me so well for real-life work and I swear was the reason why I got my full-time job. Hes tough but is doing it to help you grow! Cool dude.

Professor DeVeaux is one of the best professors in the MSMR program! Its clear that he is passionate about helping students succeed in MKT 805 and beyond. He genuinely cares about students and takes student feedback seriously. In addition, he gives amazing career advice and is more than willing to help students with their job/internship searches.

Professor Detmers was by far my favorite professor from my time at MSU. He made me realize how much easier it is to learn and understand when classes/lectures are engaging. His lectures are fun and engaging while still being content rich.He cares about his students and their learning as well as improving the way he teaches.
I loved Justin!! He gets to know every one of his students and teaches things that are actually helpful in the classroom. He is really funny and makes the 3 hour lectures go by fast.
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: He's hilarious, caring, smart and just one of the greatest professors I have had

I had Professor Detmers during senior year and 5th yr teaching internship. He is a fantastic person, both in and out of class. He genuinely cares you and is very accessible. He makes lessons fun and engaging, filled with comedy as well as meaningful moments. I highly recommend connecting with Dr. Detmers as a mentor during your studies. Go Green!
Detmers was great. He's funny and reliable if you need to reach out to him. overall just a good guy who cares about the content he's teaching/ the students he teaches.
He's just all around great

Really nice guy! You can tell he's educated on the topics of this class and actually cares to take the time to get to know his students/ care about their well being. Lectures are engaging for the most part- There isn't an excessive amount of homework. Only one or two assignments a week but the reading does take a bit of time.

Online MTH 234 was such a pain. In lectures, the most basic fundamentals of each topic are explained. However, this leaves the student at a complete loss for the homework as they include difficult questions that the student could never begin to know how to do without exterior knowledge.The quizzes are hard and limited time (initially 10 min now 20)

Steve was really laidback and is overall really sweet. If anyone was unsure of how he got to a certain part of a problem, he always explained it with no judgment. Overall, I would recommend him to anyone. His teaching style is to go through example problems and explain what he is doing at each step.

I really liked him. His class was much easier for me than any math class I've taken in the past and he's very understanding. When I took the class, you didn't have to show up to either lecture or recitation, but you could always get two points extra for taking the quiz during recitation. He was always giving extra credit and I really liked him.

I took online, the lectures were a bit hard to follow at some points so I often would look up the topics on youtube to get a better understanding. Other than that, Prof Draggoo is a great professor who keeps a positive vibe in class and cares for his students. Exams always were way easier than I thought (I got an A on almost all of them)!

I had Prof Draggoo for MTH 234. He did an awesome job. He does a great job of teaching the material, gets back to students quickly, is lenient/understanding but also fair. Multivariable calculus is difficult to some extent but he gives you everything you need to pass the class. If I had been more disciplined with my webwork I easily would have 4.0
reviews.rating_tags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Quizzes and tests are pretty lenient which is nice. The worst part is the lectures, a lot of the videos have very roundabout or cryptic explanations which waste a lot of time. Many webwork problems are not covered in the lectures which make doing the HW very, VERY frustrating. They arent think outside the box problems, it just wasn't taught at all.

Dr. Draggoo is great! I had him asynchronous so I barely even saw his face and I never contacted him. He wanted to make this class as laid back as possible and it really was. Coming out of mth 103 with another professor to mth 114 with him was a breath for fresh air. TAKE A CLASS WITH DR. DRAGGOO!!!

He is a really nice guy and tries to make the class enjoyable, but his teaching style isn't the best if you aren't familiar with a lot of the stuff. I only took this class for the general math credit, so I am not good at math. Most of the time he taught it by just doing problems, not really by explaining them.

The one shining beacon out of the dumpster fire that was the team behind the MTH 234 course. Always helped students on Piazza in an informative manner and even showed up to the help room on Thursdays. I stopped attending my online lectures and just used his videos which were ten times better, this is the name that got me through Calc 3.

I was in the online async class so we had pre recorded lecture videos. These videos usually werent too long and Draggoo made them very straightforward and informative. There were a few times the lecture videos didnt cover all the homework but Draggoo was easy to access on Piazza.

I had Steve for math 103 last semester and he was a great teacher. He will change homework due dates if you need more time, never fails to go over homework in class if necessary, and he takes good notes that you can access outside of class in case you don't go. I will say sometimes, he skips steps in problems, but if you mention it he will go back.

He takes a lot of time making his colorful videos and I don't think a lot of students appreciated that. A few times the homework would be on a related topic but he never showed how to solve a problem of its likeness, but this is a good thing. It allowed me to figure it out myself - and that is much better than being relying so heavily on him.
Steve carried all of the MTH234 sections, even though he only taught some of them. He's super smart, good at answering questions with thorough explanations, and even funny sometimes.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Let's start by saying Calc 3 SUCKS regardless of the professor, but Draggo made it fine. Lectures were async with videos posted on the class website and youtube. Hit or miss with the homework, either he gave direct examples that were exactly on the webwork or didn't cover the subject at all. Expect to spend time in office hours.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He seems like a cool guy but I didn't like his teaching style at all. It's like he expected you to already know the material. Most of the time he would just give the answers to problems and not really explain how things worked. Made it really hard to understand the important concepts.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Recorded online lectures for asynchronous. Helped whenever I needed it, and makes great review videos.

Hes a good professor. He pre recorded all his lectures, during the pandemic at least, and you didnt have to go to the scheduled time to meet. If you went to the class times you could ask him any questions from homework or from notes and he would go over the question for you I essentially give you the answer.

I took MTH 114 Trigonometry with Professor Draggo this semester online and the class was great. He was very clear with his lectures, and the class is super organized (about 2 worksheets before taking a quiz). This class was completely asynchronous and the quizzes/tests were exactly like the worksheets.

honestly he's a very laid back professor. the class has a very manageable work load that doesn't become overwhelming. sometimes he does skip steps while teaching so if you're not the best at math and need a in depth explanation it could be confusing .
Great professor who made a manageable schedule during COVID. Would definitely recommend Draggoo!

The video lectures are good for filling out the worksheets, but rarely have full explanations to solving problems and forces students to Google for further explanations. Homework typically has more complicated problems than even the weekly quizzes, which are done several days before the homework. Was much harder than a general Trig class should be.

Probably the worst math professor I've ever had. Our quizzes were due and graded before homework for the same quiz were due. In his lectures he goes over very little of the work and leaves you with little to learn. He speaks on the work like you're suppose to have already mastered the subject, so if you don't everything you're screwed.

Steve is a great prof. I had him for MTH103 and 114 during my freshman year and received and A in both courses. I will say he sometimes skips steps when doing problems on the board, but asking him to go back and explain what he did, he will do without a problem. The practice test is similar to the exams and he drops low homework scores and quizzes

He posts the notes, his exams are exactly the same as the practice exam (using different numbers of course), and my TA was super chill. I usually don't study until the night before and get high 90's on exams. Sit toward the front though, he starts loud and clear then gets kinda quiet at times, but he's great!

Draggoo has no participation whatsoever. Does not thoroughly explain problems, just simply does them on the board. He is often corrected by his own students. The TA is standoffish and tries too hard to act like she knows what she is doing. The homework is also due before we even learn the content. Dont recommend.

This class should not be as hard as it is. All he does is solve problems from his notes on the board. There is no participation in class which makes it really hard to know how to do the work. TA is the worst. Asked her a Q & she said she didn't want to help bc she didn't want to say something wrong. Doesnt know what shes doing but makes the tests.

This class was only one day in person, and we had a short assignment due once a week to make up for the second class day. All of the work in this class was very easy, and exams were as well. Prof was very friendly and helpful, easy 4.0

This class is very easy to follow. Don't skip because you need to do the group work each week and get the points. Homework is very easy while I learned about climate change and planets. He's a very nice Prof, and  interacts with the class! Would take again! Easy 4.0!

Absolutely loved Dr. Bob. He was very interested in what he was teaching which made the class more engaging. You have a group assignment at the end of every class that counts for your attendance. Couple of big milestones which are easy and all exams are online. Def take Dr. Bob for your ISP.

Very easy class, the assignments are not hard if you just put in a little effort. The d2l page can be a little confusing to navigate and there's not really any communication about what the asynchronous assignments are but just make sure you stay on top of stuff and look ahead and you'll be fine.
Easiest class I have ever taken! Like easy assignments and easy test. If you put in any effort you will get a 4.0.

this prof knows that the class is almost all freshman/sophomores fulfilling their isp. you don't have to do anything in class, which was hybrid for me. all u had to do was the online assignment (took 5 min) on monday and the exams were all online. he didn't answer emails but that's understandable for this class. good class to fulfill ur credit

He's a super easygoing teacher, and the class is easy too. In class, you just do a few questions with your table group, write them down, and turn them in for attendance points. There's one easy async assignment each week, one simple project, and online exams.

He deserves this high rating. Lectures are easy. Your attendance is based on a quick group work assignment, which normally takes about 10-15 minutes. You have a couple big assignments but nothing I lost sleep over, very easy.
The nicest professor at MSU. I've never seen someone ranked so high but he deserves it he's amazing.

Excellent professor. Very flexible if you communicate well, offers ample extra credit, and gives leeway for unforeseen circumstances. If you put in the bare minimum effort, you will 4 point this class. Highly recommend taking him, and will definitely be looking at more classes I can take with him in the future.

Excellent professor. Gives a lot of leeway if you communicate effectively, offers ample extra credit, and shows a lot of understanding for unforeseen circumstances. If you put in the bare minimum effort, you will 4 point this class. Highly recommend taking him, and I definitely will be looking into classes to take with him in the future.

This class was mostly hybrid, but it was super easy to get a 4.0. This class was absolutely the easiest class at MSU. Dr. Bob was great, not only was the material pretty interesting, your graded basically on completion. The in class assignments are super fun and the exams are open note and super easy. Overall, this class is a very easy gen-ed!
love love love dr bob, so sweet and the workload is so light and exams are easy. take him easy A
Dr. Bob is an awesome professor. He's a super nice guy and I would recommend taking this class if you are required too.

If you want to finish the uni requirements without stress TAKE THIS CLASS. Professor's awesome, not only does he teach well, his homework assignments aren't overwhelming. We did small in group assignments in class. There were also essay-like writing assignments that had clear instructions. Easy A trusttttt

Great class, every assignment is easy and i'm so happy I took this class. The only con was the fact that he doesn't respond to emails and some of the assignments on d2l aren't accurate as he does not do some of them anymore... BUT still a great and easy class.

Probably the best class ive taken so far at msu. He clearly cares about teaching and makes it very easy to pass. Class is once a week and barley mandatory, but there's short in class group participation assignments so you will miss out on those points if you skip. Lots of extra credit opportunities to make them up. Easiest final ever

Literally the best professor I have ever had in my entire life, he is so chill and nice and responds to emails super fast. Cares for his students and has the easiest class I have ever taken. Easier than a middle school class, little work load and all exams online. The best class ever, highly reccomend.

I also took ISB 200 with him; the main assignments were the same. TA put additional assignments up but most didn't end up being required. He's a very easy grader, plus exams are online and very easy. He's a great prof and ideal if you need basic ISB/ISP credits but will still learn. Lectures are technically required but not super necessary.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Easiest class i have ever taken. You do need to go to class because of participation, but the class is usually under 30 minutes and tests are ridiculously easy. He knows this is a Gen Ed so it is a very easy class. One thing is that you need to check your email on D2L, as that's how he communicates.

Don't expect assignment due dates to be accurate in D2L, we didn't know when we were in person/online or what was due when. Not to mention his and his TA's inability to communicate. Assignments are easy, exams are beyond easy. Just don't count on ever knowing what is due that week until he finally decides to communicate. Easy but frustrating A.
Dr. Bob was epic, and a very easy grader. He knows this is a Gen Ed, and wants his students to succeed so he actually helps you out. Would take again.

Emailed Dr. Drost in a panic because I unwillingly had to drop one of my other classes, making me a part-time student and at risk for losing thousands of dollars in scholarships. Dr. Drost let me into the class a month after it started and made sure to help me catch up. That alone makes him the most caring professor I've ever had. Easy class too.

Had him for both ISB200 and ISP203B, easiest classes I've taken at MSU ever. Do keep in mind that TAs are the ones grading the work + attendance matters (missing few attendances can drop your grades easily). Besides that, the classes end early and half the time it's zoom classes. Would highly recommend.

Dr.Bob is very chill, makes an easy class. Have to show up for lectures for group work and attendance/participation credit, but if you do, you will pass no problem. The quizzes are online and easy if you have the slides and pay attention. Assignments are cumulative over the semester to one big final project but are easy and graded very nicely.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Such a nice guy and understands that everyone is taking this class because it's a requirement, not because they want to. Each class has one group assignment that is used for points and attendance so go to class but it's supposed to be over an hour and I was never there for longer than 25 minutes. Exams are all online and no lockdown browser...

Prof. Drost made this prereq class very easy to pass, and kept the homework (if any) very minimal and to the point. Attendance wasn't required, but points were taken if you attended class. No textbook either. Hands down best professor I've had this year!

Dr. Bob was literally the easiest professor and class ever. There is usually some sort of group assignment that needs to be completed for a grade every class so attendance is really important. It claims to be an hour and 20 minute class, but on average we were never in there longer than 40 minutes.

Dr. Bob was one of the best professors I have ever taken at MSU. He makes a prereq that isn't meant to be difficult but incredibly easy but still fun and informational. If you ever get the chance to take him for your ISP or ISB I would highly recommend.

If you need a super easy ISB class, this is the one! Dr. Bob is a super great professor and doesnt make the material difficult at all! Very easy to understand and a 4.0 is VERY attainable! Majority of grading is the individual milestone projects which take up to 2 hours to complete at most. Loved this class!

If you are looking for an ISB credit, take this class. He is an amazing professor, he makes the class so easy for students. His exams are so easy you are basically guaranteed 100%, most assignments are super short and so easy you get 100%, you also often don't meet on Mondays despite it being a class time + multiple extra credit opportunities.

Dr. Bob is amazing, his lectures are fun and class activities are not unusual when he holds in-person classes. Lots of extra credit opportunities and the TAs were super chill. Super recommended if you need to take an ISP for class/major credit.
If you go to class, you will get an A. Vey nice guy, he makes things easy to understand and assessments are a cake-walk.

Quite literally the easiest class you will ever take. Prof Drost was the most laid back guy ever, the exams are all common knowledge (and online), ULAs are very helpful, I highly recommend this course.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Love Dr.Bob! Such a chill guy, he understands the people in class are not science majors so he is much more relaxed than other "university required" profs. We never went over 20 minutes, whether that be on the zooms or in person. And the exams are super easy as well.

easy 4.0 definitely take him for any class that you possibly can. The Zoom class was often canceled and in person never lasted past half an hour. gradin was clear and assignments were easy. exams were all found online

Easy. Class is scheduled for an 1hr 20m but only goes for about 20 minutes each day. Zoom on Mondays so makes the week easy. He understands that the people taking this course are not science majors so the material is nothing crazy and his assignments are very easy, only take about 10 minutes, projects took me 30.

Dr. Bob is amazing! If you haven't taken an ISB/P course yet, take it with Dr. Bob. He is so chill and assignments can be finished in 10 minutes. Exams are exactly like the study guide. Super straight forward. In class we go over slides for about 20 minutes then answer a few questions with the people at your table.

Professor Drost is super laid back and understands that a lot of people are required to take the course. It is important to go to class because group work is a large percent of the grade, but the tests are super easy and he makes the material interesting. If you have to take ISB or ISP, definitely take it with him.
This class was really easy. Make sure to attend class because there is group work they grade on, but otherwise it is really easy and maybe a guaranteed 4.0.
Super easy class and super chill guy. Not a lot of homework and quizzes are easy.
Super nice. Understands that this is a required class and to take it easy. Basically gives you everything you need to pass. Best professor ever

one of the best professors I've had at msu, cares and wants students to do well. definitely the easiest class i have ever taken, only a few one page papers with clear q/a prompts. 25 Q exams and study guides are the exact same as the exams. good idea to go to class as there is in class discussion group work due most of the time.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Super easy class, just make sure to show up as class group work is a large part of your grade.  Tests and homework assignments are very easy.  Professor Drost is great to have for ISP or ISB courses.

SUPER easy professor. Study guides exactly like the exams, one project that you work on throughout the semester but super easy. Includes 3 milestones and then the final proposal. Group work but super easy. He often cancelled in person class and switched to Zoom. Super nice, funny guy. Exams are online.

He always makes lectures entertaining and really cares about teaching the subject material. The course itself is incredibly easy, as long as you go to class each week and submit the group work then the class is an easy 4.0. The projects and milestones are cake walks and the exams takes questions directly from the study guide.

If you are looking to be challenged by course work Prof is not for you. If you are looking for an easy 4.0 and Credit Prof is for you. Don't feel like I learned a whole lot, but Class was about natural hazards and not applicable to my degree, so didn't feel like I was missing out. Prof has realistic expectations of students interest in the subject.

If you do the work and show up to class you will get a 4.0. Our class was graded highly on very easy papers. Many classes were moved to Zoom. Always got out of class early. Dr. Bob does everything he can to make the class easy and stress-free for students. You can also learn a few interesting things!
He is not a tough professor show up do the work and you will be fine.
R Drost is the best professor for ISP. Our class used to end way before the class ends. Small lectures with great knowledge

Super easy professor/class. In person you work in groups to answer a few questions that is graded on participation. Then you do a few easy assignments on your own which built up to the final project (also easy). He gives study guides for exams that are the exact exams and have answers on quizlet. He canceled the zooms and often shortened classes.

Super easy class. He understands a lot of us are taking the class for the credit not for our majors. Groupwork in class so go, but he usually lets you out after 15-30 minutes of class. Great professor, highly recommend this class.

He is very funny. It is an easy class. He posts the answers to the quizzes right on the powerpoints. easy 4.0 class. Lectures are not long at all, get gets the point across and would end the class which was nice.
Took Fall of 2020, assignments were clear and easy to follow. Easy class to get an A in

Drost is a nice and respectable professor. I took him Spring 2020 during the COVID-19 pandemic and he made sure his students were not overwhelmed during this time, which I especially appreciated. The class itself was not difficult at all and a great choice for the ISP requirement.
The class is an easy A, just show up and do the group work. Exams are online and are incredibly easy. I feel like it would be harder to fail this class than to ace it.
This is the easiest class ever. All you have to do is show up to class and do the group work. The exams are online and you can find all the answers on quizlet. Effortless 4.0.

This class is an easy 4.0. You have to show up to do in class assignments but they are easy and lectures are chill. All exams are online and he gives you a study guide with the exact same questions as it a week before. There are a few projects, but if you follow the rubric you should get 100%. Very easy class with minimal effort
Dr. Bob is amazing, his classes are the best at MSU. I very much enjoyed having him as a professor. I applied to be an LA for the course I took and got the job. Cant wait to keep working with him!
Amazing professor and I'm taking him again as he's so great.
Easy class. Just show up for participation points. Exams online.
He is a great teacher. Very funny and friendly. Easy class.
Best Professor at MSU. Take his classes for a guaranteed 4.0. Totally loved him. Much Respect.

Easiest thing I've ever done. Class is almost painfully easy and uninvolved. Exams are all online and google-able. Class attendance is required most of the time. If you showed up to class with a beer in your hand I'm not sure that he'd even tell you to get rid of it.

The class was super easy. I found the lectures to be kinda boring since he read off the slides and posted them on D2L. You do need to show up for random attendance questions that are a part of the grade. Drost is pretty easygoing and only asks for participation.
everyone please take this class, it will boost your grade point by doing little to no work with a nice teacher!

Guy walks in the first day wearing a Hawaiian shirt and reveals his love for Jimmy Buffet and Tequila. Tests were all online and word for word from the review. Did give some online HW, but it was super easy too. One of the easiest classes I have ever taken.

I took him twice (ISB and ISP) and the class was exactly the same!. Turned in the same assignments and the exams were EXACTLY the same. Barely went to class at all and got a 4.0 (twice). He's so cute (for a geeky professor) and so passionate about what he's talking about!

Great teacher! I have had him this passed semester for his 'flipped' section where the class is split into like 50 groups of 4 people and we just do our work during class! No homework, quizzes are all online due before class and exams are all online EASY 100% on all of them! 3 milestones, final project, and a final group debate, super great class

He is a very easy professor! He gives you the exam before you take it so all you have to do is find the answers in his lectures and memorize the answers. He didn't give a final, we had a final project instead that we worked on throughout the semester. He doesn't require any textbook(s). Easy A! Must attend class because attendance is mandatory.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Tests? Not many--Would take again

reviews.comment: I love Bob (Yes, he told us its O.K. to call him by his first name). He always finished class at least 30 minutes early and would let us leave whenever his lecture was done. He makes a 4.0 very attainable, assuming that you turn everything in on time and actually try. The work is often tedious (No offense, Bob), but not difficult by any means.
reviews.rating_tags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Best class ever and best teacher ever. 10/10

This man is amazing! He is very passionate about what he teaches and truly cares about his students. He usually lets class out early, gives some extra credit opportunity, and grades very easily. Easy 4.0, 10/10 recommend.
He is wonderful and gives you the tests ahead of time so you know what is on them.
He is the man.
Great teacher. Always entertaining and very caring about his students. Learned a lot in his class.
Okay best teacher I have ever had

THE BEST TEACHER YOU WILL EVER HAVE AT MSU. Dont feel like going to class? No problem, every slide is uploaded online. About a week before you take the exams he uploads the exact exam word for word with all multiple choices included so you can study. Has about 4 "milestone" term projects to do but are not that hard and graded very easily. EASY 4.0!
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Hilarious--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: It's a class on natural disasters and hazards, he is super passionate about it and it's pretty interesting. He uses video clips, and things to keep it interesting.
Kinda mean

I like Professor Draths for the most part. The 8am 3 times a week sucked but as long as you take good notes you'll be fine. You can get a lot of extra credit just for attending class and recitation so even if you don't do great on tests you can still get a good grade. Also there's her office hours and TA help room which are very helpful for exams.
reviews.rating_tags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Orgo is hard, theres no getting around it. The class has an insane amount of extra credit: go to every optional class (and all labs) and do the homework, you'll be fine. Exams are hard, so you pay attention and take thorough notes. She is also very accommodating to any emergencies!

Wow where to start. This class was NOT easy. ALEKS was hard and expensive. Lab was easy, but my TA for recitation was awful. He hardly helped anyone. So much info in each lecture. Prof Draths was rude and condescending. Only thing that saved me was TA Ben's review sessions! Most exam questions were HARD and nothing like the practice ones. Good luck

Professor Draths only wants the best for you. She brought my grade up to a 4.0 after being a few points shy of the threshold. As long as you attend lectures/recitations, labs, ALEKS homework, and get as much extra credit as you can you'll be just fine. The 8AM lectures are a pain at times, but they're well-worth it!

i barely passed gen chem and 3.5 orgo - the lectures are boring but GO TO CLASS!! you can get like 40 extra credit points. i failed the first 2 exams and got a 70 on the final and still 3.5 but do all the ALEKS, go to lectures and recitation and lab portion should be very easy

The class isn't as bad as it sounds. As long as you just go to class everyday, do aleks, and do solid on the labs which aren't that hard, you should easily get a 3.5. I got 70s on the first two test, and only need an 80 to 4.0. She will give double attendance points sometimes.

This class is lecture-heavy, but the lectures are actually really good if you pay attention to them, and you get extra credit for going to class every day. The test averages are very low, but because of the extra credit, you can get a 4.0 easily if you go to class and do moderate to bad on the exams. It is a hard class, but she is a good teacher.
She is the best. Go to her office hours and the class is very easy. I love her.

I thought Draths was a great professor. It felt like she wanted everyone to succeed. Attendance was optional, but you get extra credit if you go. You also get extra credit for attending recitation, so there are many opportunities for you to boost your grade.

Super kind, she really cares about the class and is an expert in what she is teaching. Attendance is not mandatory, but for extra credit points. The recitations are also extra credit and are added to your exam score. The class is hard but if you go to class, do the homework, and study for the exams, you should not have a problem passing.

Orgo is tough, but this class makes it easy. A lot of the grade is homework and lab participation. EC for every lecture and recitation totals 4% on the overall grade. Lectures are boring and slow, but Draths cuts any lecture material she doesnt get to off the finals. If you do the homework and show up, you will pass. People who complain didnt try.

The Class was pretty hard, Would not take it again. ALEKS is your best friend for this class, same with the Labs. The exams are hard, but as long as you do all of the ALEKS and Labs you can at least get a 3.0. Lectures are not mandatory, neither are recitations but they do give you extra credit.

Lectures itself weren't helpful & neither was going to office hours. Attendance wasn't required, but go to get the bonus points. Final grade relied heavily on ALEKS homework and chem labs since midterms & final always averaged ~55%. So make sure you're keeping up with ALEKS and going to labs.

She doesn't require attendance but if you don't go you are screwed and the class is only offered at 8am M/W/F so welcome to hell. Class is insanely difficult considering the amount of students who are not stem majors and just need it for a major requirement.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I had fun in this class. The lectures were good and the labs were pretty fun. Not a lot of homework either, spent less than an hour a week on it looking back. Dr. Draths cares a lot about the material and is very knowledgeable. There is also a lot of extra credit available if you attend lecture and recitations.

The material is difficult and sometimes this professor is hard to follow in lecture. She makes up for it by having the midterm and final not weigh as much as you'd expect in your final grade. Just do the homework and labs and you'll pass no problem, you do not have to ace the tests to get an A in this class. Believe me.
Easily one of the worst professors/teachers ive ever had. Lectures pointless dont go. Watch youtube and attend recitation and help room.  Or just don't take this class here

Did not learn anything from the lectures. There were only two exams (midterm, final) and after the first exam, the average was a 50%. The only reason most people passed the class was because of the ALEKS homework and if you do well in the lab. Would not recommend this professor unless you have a lot of free time outside of the class.

Professor refuses ADA (&Uni approved) recorded note taking for VARK learning styles.
Analysis of cost to comparable value= MSU is shorting each student minimum 10% of each lecture of paid for teaching and office hours are billed@ $75/hr/student which is not part of the legal credit billing system. charged 4 CR for 2 Cr Hrs of class and 1 cr of lab.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: This class was extremely difficult. The only reason I had a B was because of the help of my TA during his help hours. This professor goes very fast but somehow we were behind the whole semester.

Avoid at all costs. The worst professor I have had and a very bad experience overall. I had to take this class for my major as a prerequisite. Take this class with any one else, over summer or anything.

The worst teacher I have ever had.
Don't bother going to the lecture because she will just read you the book.
She piles up the work, I spent about nine hours a week studying and my grades still did not reflect that. 
I have an average 3.7gpa and got a C in her class. 
She is also MEAN, but she doesn't think so.
GOOD LUCK, you will need it.
Could lecture better but the recitations and office hours were helpful

The HIGHEST quiz average so far has been around a 55% and she has not curved any of them. No homework grades, just exams, quizzes, and labs. Great professor, explained everything in great detail, and had great review sessions for the exams.

Amazing D2L page, always makes sure you know what your resources are. Lectures really help and many example problems are from the homework.

Awesome

Amazing man, started every lecture with a song which was awesome. His lectures made this class so much easier to understand. Easy A if you are willing to put in the work to succeed.
One of the BEST professors in MSU!! He makes everything so easy to understand. He is also very fun in lectures, and sings for us as well. Highly recommend!!

He's an amazing professor!! He dumbs down the information for you & really cares about his students. He also has a nice "grandpa" vibe around him, so watching him instruct the class is fun. Awesome professor. Loves the subject and teaching. I never understood most math before taking this course with him. Highly recommend
His quizzes were exactly like problems in the lecture and homework. Easy to follow and thoroughly/efficiently explained all material. Great professor!

Loved him! He was my favorite professor this semester and made Calculus actually easy to understand.

Drachman is a great prof! Very organized (but sloppy writing) and even gives hints for quizzes/exams. Sometimes he lectured a little fast but you can watch the video recording later. Mr. Drachman was a pretty good calc prof, I took AP in high school so I was familiar with the content of the class. However he did a much better job explaining the content than the intro videos. reviews.comment: Prof. Drachman is the BEST! He is an extremely likable guy & his personality made Calc 2 much more enjoyable. He explains material very well & gives helpful examples everyday in lecture which helped a lot with Webwork problems. Absolutely loved him, one of my fav profs at MSU and he helped me do well in the course. If you can, get him for MTH133!

10/10 would recommend Prof. Drachman! He does a great job with explaining the material in the class and gives tips for passing the class. Calc 2 is a hard class, so make sure to go to the lectures. He also makes sure to do review before the exams.
Calculus is boring and can be difficult but he makes it bearable.
Takes everything step by step and explains well. Teaches everything that is on the test, and doesn't try to steal points on tests and quizzes with cheap tricks. Also, a good guy all around.
If you're taking mathematics classes at MSU, find Drachman.
This is easily the best math professor I have had ever. He gives hints on the exams and wants every student to succeed as much as possible. One of the greatest professors. Nicest person too.
Drachman is a great prof and he clearly explains everything he does.
Have you every heard this man play the harmonica? If not ask him to play it for you! He's the best math teacher I ever had. Best thing is his many examples. He's A1.

I had Professor Drachman for Calc II (MTH 132). He is great at explaining how to do the problems and is always willing to help outside of class. His lectures are clear and he goes through many examples at a reasonable pace. I felt very prepared for all the quizzes and tests after completing the Webwork and going to lecture.

reviews.comment: GOAT
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Great at explaining problems. Moves quickly but not too quickly. As long as you go to class and watch the video notes you should be able to do the homework and ace the tests and quizzes.

Drachman is really good at explaining how to do a problem. You do not really need the book, unless you are someone who likes to read and go over the book on your own time. Basically you take notes and do Webwork examples that will help you with your homework.  It is like any other math class, Webwork for homework, a quiz once a week and 3 exams.

He posts notes online that you have to print yourself, and fill in by watching videos outside of class. In lectures he goes over example problems and answers any questions. I don't think you could find a better calc 1 professor.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: He handed out packets of notes to fill in for homework. You watch videos and fill in as they go along, and then he gives you credit for doing it. Plus, they're fantastic notes to go back to.
Calc 2 is always hard so don't be afraid of the easiness scale. Drachman is the bomb.
Alex Drachman is the best calc teacher of all time. He speaks very clearly and knows what/when to emphasize an idea or equation. He is the GOAT.

He was an amazing professor, he was very helpful in class. I also had an amazing TA, but I would say that he does most of the teaching you need during lecture. Tests do count for a lot of the grade, but the final is not cumulative and only another unit exam. There are also quizzes every week, but you only need to complete the homework to do well.

Dr. Krause is a great and understanding teacher that wants everyone to pass. Was always willing to answer questions after class and often let us leave ~15 minutes early if it fit with the schedule. Highly recommend.

Super nice, cares about his students, and is very organized. Attendance isn't mandatory and notes are posted online, but definitely go to recitation. Very easy to 4.0 the class and extra credit is offered.
He's a very good professor but tends to take a fast pace, and you can get lost very easily during the lectures. Outside of class he's very available, and cares about his students.

Andy is fantastic. Not only does he understand and relay the topics well, you can tell he genuinely cares about the success of his students. Pre Calc is definitely not an easy class, he does a great job simplifying it. I would retake a class with Andy 10/10 times.

Dr. Krause was an amazing math professor. He was always happy and nice during lectures and gave many resources for extra help. I was never shocked by having homework or a quiz/exam because he always gave a heads up. I am not the best with math all the time but I 4.0 this class because he was so good at teaching. Would definitely take again.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Great professor. The class has itself a lot of homework and quizzes, but they do a great job of balancing out the exam grades. Andy is very detailed but goes very quickly through lectures, but don't be afraid to ask questions during the lecture he will usually provide another example to help you get it. I would 100% take Andy for any class you ca

Andy is super sweet and very funny. He does a lot to help you prepare for the exams and it honestly helps a lot. You are given homework assignments after each lecture and a quiz every week leading up to the exams. This may seem like a lot but if you actually try on everything, the exams are very easy. The class is based mostly on exams and quizzes.

Attendence isn't mandatory but showing up helps a lot, the class isn't too difficult as long as you pay attention. The extra credit webwork is a must do at the beginning of the semester, but great professor
Goes really fast when filling in notes but overall helps students when they need and gets the point across nicely
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Amazing lectures --Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: He is such a caring and wonderful human being. He knows how to teach and helps you understand things. Although the lectures are just filling in notes, he walks you through every step and explains why which is really helpful. Theres a quiz almost every week but only about 5 questions.

I really like Professor Krause, he is one of my favorite mathematics instructors I have ever had. His lectures are concise and easy to understand, and he answers questions well in and out of lecture. He made Calculus simple to understand and succeed with. I highly recommend anyone to take his class.

i dont know how he did it but he made calc 1 easy. rn im averaging like 90% on the exams because of it. the lectures for example leave no room for questions because everything is explained so well. even if you miss the lectures, the intro videos are also great. my only criticism is i wish the quizes had 1 hour time limits instead of 30 minutes
Amazing professor. Provides a lot of help during office hours. Makes everything extremely easy to understand. Quizzes and Exams are online.
You have to be ready to move at a fast pace. Lots of time must be put into this class. He drops a lot of exams/assignments to help out.
So much homework. But, the professor does a great job of grading. It's a tough class but definitely the best professor if you have to take it.

DO NOT take this class over the summer especially if you are taking another class at the same time. This class will take up all of your time. Andrew is super nice and helpful and the extra credit opportunities saved me in this class. I've never gotten a 3.5 before so that was tough information to swallow.

DO NOT take this course online in the summer. Work load it extremely heavy, 20 hours of work a week at a minimum, and lots of homework. Expect at least one whole chapter a week if not more. The course is also supposed to be 8 weeks long but is actually less. Plus classes tend to run longer then they are supposed to.

Andrew was one of the best professors I've had in my life. He has a very good understanding of Calculus and he's an excellent teacher, he truly cares about students learning and he always makes himself accessible. I didn't even have his class but I would watch his lectures just because of how much I preferred him to my actual professor.

At first I struggled in this class but I later started getting the hang of the course schedule. There are weekly quizzes but are simple if you do the homework. This professor is considerate and cares about students' success. If you have any concerns, he is willing to meet with you outside of class. There are many dropped assignments.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Accessible outside class--Group projects

reviews.comment: Krause was definitely the best Calc 1 professor. I know students who had different professors who attended his lectures because of how goo the was. He tells you what types of questions are on the quizzes (if you ask him only).

Be prepared for lots of work outside of class time to prep for lessons. Quiz almost every Friday but lots of drops available. Lectures arent required but Krause does a really nice job explaining the concepts and answering questions, so I recommend going.

Professor Krause is THE best math professor I have ever had in my life. His lectures are well structured and he makes sure to explain concepts thoroughly in order to help you understand the material. He is always there and willing to help during his office hours. His exams and quizzes are very reflective of the material in class. Take it with him.

Professor Krause is amazing. His lectures are clear and concise. Piazza is a HUGE help for homework and he tends to answer pretty quick on this site. The homework is a bit challenging (typically more than the tests) but it prepares you for the quizzes and exams. If you are taking calc at MSU, I highly recommend him.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Krause is by far one of the best mth professors. His lectures are really good and help you understand the content no matter how difficult it is. He also answers questions that you may have during the lecture. His notes correlate to the homework and the quizzes/exams, so you will be prepared to get good grades.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: MTH124 is a really tough course. He was definitely one of the better profs I've had for math but could talk really fast making it hard to keep up. I needed some extra help understanding the material outside of class, I used the Wize videos for this course and they really helped me to understand!

Andy might be the best math prof ever. He's always available for questions, helping with homework, and flexible. He had some easy extra credit things and was fun. If you're ready to learn calc, he's ready to make sure that happens.
Such a great professor. Really cares about students doing well and available to meet whenever. Makes Calc a lot easier to learn. 100% would take a class with him again, I wish i Could.

Seriously one of the best professors I have ever had. Great at explaining things and actually makes calculus enjoyable. He's always willing to help you out individually and going to office hours was a game changer for me. Definitely recommend him, he's a great guy!
Great at explaining the material and is willing to help. Makes learning calculus enjoyable.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Respected--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Math 124 is hard stuff, especially when you're like me and can't get a good grasp on calculus. With that being said, he was the first teacher that ever made me remotely understand calc. He sometimes moves super fast, but he's very thorough and answers any questions. He posts his completed lecture notes, but I still recommend attending.

He's a great professor, he has a clear grading system, will meet with you outside of class and really cares about his students. I liked having the videos outside of class and would recommend watching them before class. Overall amazing professor.

Professor Krause is an amazingly patient and personable professor. On the first day I had a scheduling conflict involving his class and he worked with me to get it resolved. You have to watch videos before class lectures but he goes over everything and works really hard to make sure everyone understands the material. Best calc prof. by far!

I had like a mixed type of learning, so you watched the notes online, and a small class of us, like 20-30, sat while he did examples and went over the notes. Quiz every Friday, but Krause is a great guy and he taught me a lot. Just stay on top of webwork and quizzes and you should be alright.
Explains things but gives out a lot of homework and does not have good examples in class.
reviews.rating_tags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Dr. Olive is a wonderful professor and is great at teaching immunology content. The course itself is hard, and requires a lot of studying for exams that are not easy and require enough understanding to apply the knowledge. they are open note but that truly will not help you if you don't have a solid understanding first. Difficult but he's great

Dr. Olive knows his stuff and explains content in a digestible way. His office hours are extremely helpful, and so are his in class activities. Exams are in person and open note, as long as they are on paper. The class requires effort but as long as you use the resources Dr. Olive provides and ask for help when you need it, you will be fine.

Dr. Olive knows his stuff and explains difficult content in a digestible way. His office hours are extremely helpful and so are his in class activities. Exams are in person and open note, as long as they are on paper. The class requires effort but if you use the resources Dr. Olive provides and ask for help when you need it, you will be fine.

Dr. Olive is the most passionate professor at MSU. Immunology is a hard class, and his exams are difficult, and you will need to study, but his in class assignments, quizzes, and office hours are very useful. All lectures are online, and the in class time is for an assignment and to ask questions.

He is a passionate professor and he is nice. but his exams are SO complicated and take SO long, even after studying. the MC in the exams is annoying because if you don't select all then you will get 0 points.

Dr. Olive is one of the most passionate and well educated professors I've ever had. He knows his stuff very well and although the content is difficult he does a good job at teaching it over recorded lectures and then in class activities!

While the course content itself is more advanced, Dr. Olive does an amazing job at teaching the material and setting up the students for success. I was extremely nervous doing into the class as I really hated other mmg courses I took, however this one was literally amazing!!! Dr. Olive really knows his stuff and knows how to teach it well!

Exams were take-home, free response and multiple choice. MC on exams can have multiple answers that ALL need to be selected to earn credit. People complained about MC because they did not study enough for the exams, sounds like a them problem. He graded the free resp easily. Be prepared to take 3-4 hours for exams if you did not study.

All multiple choice questions are "select all that apply" and out of 5 answers. If you select one wrong or one too many, you get 0/4 points. I have never had a class that grades exams so ridiculously. He praises the top percent of the class and expects everyone to perform as well as them. It's ridiculous. Does not care about students who struggle.

I would have really enjoyed this course if I didn't thoroughly learn the material and open the exam to find them so difficult. Short answers/creating experiments/multiple answer questions you lose 4 points for if you don't select them all/etc. Open for 24 hours and take SO long. ICA keys weren't posted to review work. Just really disappointing.
Assignment directions are very unclelar. His class is very confusing.I dont reccomend.

Overall this class has way too many quizzes, discussions, and overall too much work for the class level. Not only is it too much work for the level but as an online class this is just too much information to grasp alone and in person would be better. Andrew is a very kind professor overall
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Was a very tough grader! Too much work for a level 200 class, and many text books that you do not even use. Very nice professor, and responds quickly to emails. Eagar to help students but still grades super hard.

The professor is honestly a great guy who wants you to succeed. Super nice person to talk to overall. He's very much old-school even if you take his class online. His assignments can be very tedious, and you are going to be writing a lot. As long as you just participate in class and put in actual effort in his class, it is an easy 4.0.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Too many assignments and pointless readings. Very passionate about the class but it's too much for the average student. Most of his grading comes from these video journals that have to be minutes long. Seems like a nice guy but his responses to the discussion boards are very critical. I would try to get out of this class.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I did bad on a lot of his quizzes because the questions and answers are highly subjective rather than factual. The final assignment is a 20 minute presentation or a 2000 word essay. This is not honors college. No hate to the teacher; I can tell he put a lot into making the class what it is, but we're undergrads, not experts in this field like him.

He seems like a nice guy who cares about his students. It is just an impressive amount of work for a general elective class that most people take to check off a box. Lots of readings and quizzes that are hard to understand wording, he is very critical with feedback as well.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: His course is way too much work for a pointless elective class. Can be a smart aleck when leaving comments on your work and is very belittling.

I am sure he is a nice guy but for a basic IAH class I was taking as an elective it was an unnecessary amount of work. He also leaves comments on work that are very unsupportive and it seems like unless you put insane amounts of effort into this course you are doomed to fail.

There is a fairly heavy amount of workload and reading expected each week but he will grade most of your assignments based on effort, so if you do the reading and your work you will do fine. However, the reading quizzes are unnecessarily difficult.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: Professor McCullough was my favorite professor this semester, while it was a requirement for my degree I learned a lot of useful information I will use as an adult.  Yor are graded by effort, so all these people who gave him negative reviews probably didn't do all the reading outside of class....which is a lot but college is literally all reading.
reviews.rating_tags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Tough grader, along with a tough final project and pointless readings.

Do not take his IAH 209 class unless you like reading pointless information that is very difficult to understand, enjoy getting feedback that makes your self-esteem tank into the ground, and love being graded like you are in medical school trying to become a doctor.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Tough grader

reviews.comment: This was my favorite class this semester. While you have a lot of reading, the assignments are easy. You can email at any hour of the day, and have a response in a short amount of time. Always willing to help, give feedback, and is super understanding. Due dates are not a suggestion, but there is wiggle room for them.
One of my fav teachers in all 4 years of college. Makes class super fun and engaging
Matt was amazing! I learned so much about acting in this class thanks to his great feedback and activities! He is very supportive and such a kind professor.
Matthew Durland is a great professor and helped me become a better actor.

Matthew Durland is my favorite professor I've ever had! He genuinely cares about every student in the class and their personal growth as actors. I still reach out to him with advice and questions, and he always provides timely and helpful responses. He also came to support a show that my fellow students and I were in. I loved this class!

Matt is an amazing professor, super friendly, and always ready to help.

His course structure is straightforward, and any assignments are not difficult; he is more than happy to clarify if you have any questions.

Going to class is a MUST. Please be there for your peers and for your own grade.

Do the work, and it is an easy 4.0.

Very nice guy, but grading is unclear, and points in the syllabus did not add up. A 97% was considered a 3.5, which was not stated in the syllabus. Classes were fun, and he gave great feedback; it was just hard to know where you stood in the class, and how he was going to grade something (no posted rubrics).

Duke always brightened my day! He's super nice and funny! The workload could be a lot sometimes but make sure to communicate with him as he's pretty understanding and genuinely wants to see you succeed!!

I love Professor Duke. He's sweet, funny, and an incredible artist! Still, this class can be grueling (in-class still lifes & time consuming hw). Either way, I was able to get 100s on nearly all of my assignments. Show up so you can get your in-class hw credit (Iike fr) & you'll be fine. No matter what, I loved having Prof Duke this semester :)
He is a very friendly quirky guy!!! Tough grader but that comes with most art courses! Overall enjoyed his class :)

If you ask for feedback, it will be unclear and not make any sense. Supposedly this class is graded on effort, but it's obviously not. It's clear he wants you to draw in such a specific drawing style and if you don't, he will give you a low C or high D even if you spent hours on an assignment. He's also very passive aggressive.

I was very excited for this course, and at first liked it a lot because the prof was very passionate and gave a lot of positive reinforcement to me personally. As the course went on I realized he is a very strict grader, which I was not expecting for an art class. I will say I did learn quite a bit in this class but it was so so time consuming.

Yall need to cut this man a break lol. I entered this class thinking it would be an easy A and I'd skate by with my previous knowledge. Wrong. This class disrupted all I thought I knew and rebuilt it even stronger. People complain about spending hours on a project.. it's a large final work of art! As long as it's clear you are trying you'll b ok!

PROS: He's a nice guy, has a sense of humor He's a good artist. Lets you redo all assignments up until midterm (there is a HUGE but though.) CONS: EXTREMELY unclear grading criteria, Fairly large assignments due EVERY week. (the BUT... for the redoing assignments) Gives little feedback, what he does give is extremely cryptic.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Get ready to read--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: Unclear grading criteria, never tells you what he wants from an assignment. Lets you redo assignments, but won't tell you what was wrong and "needs fixing." Told one of our students to worry about grade and laughed. Told another that he graded the class on a scale from worst to best instead of how much we've progressed or learned.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: No clear grading criteria. Some people got full marks on late work and others who turned it in on time didnt. Professor laughed at student for asking to see their grade. Giant projects due every week as homework. No clear feedback or constructive criticism. He would say that you would get full marks as long as you did your best but thats a lie.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Tough grader

reviews.comment: Refuses to give constructive criticism. Wants students to paint in his style, and is insistent on doing things his way even when they are 10x more expensive and time consuming. I definitely did not improve in this class. Falls through on supposed deadlines.
reviews.rating_tags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.

reviews.comment: He's a really good guy, gives great critique and is an amazing artist himself. I feel like I improved. However, he's pretty scatterbrained, and sometimes has trouble managing a class. Expects you to work on each homework piece for a minimum of 6 hours, and attendance is mandatory. But he lets you wear headphones, so it's not too bad for drawing 1.
reviews.rating_tags: Gives good feedback--Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK

reviews.comment: Duke was a lazy, submissive instructor who fails to realize that painting is dead and needs to be re-invented.
As a mandatory course, it is rather easy without much workload. Suggest taking in senior year.
She was nice and understanding. Sometimes strict, but helpful with details. I learned a lot!
very intelligent, cant teach - laughed at us for not understanding, incredibly inpatient, failed to give clear instruction, tough grader unnecessarily, did not display any compassion

I have never had a professor this horrible. She does not care about her students and will most likely never give you a 100% on ANY assignments. She is rude and is not understanding what-so-ever. I turned one assignment in late because of personal issues and she didn't let me do the WHOLE project, which is most of our grade... Do not take her class!

Beyond unqualified to be a professor, should truly consider another profession. She is legitimately rude to students, harsh grader and overall poor teaching abilities. You will likely get half-credit more than full credit. She has zero care or concern for her students and no leniency. I can confidently say she is the worst teacher I've ever had.

Hard to understand. Is very mean. Treats her students like children and yells at them. Doesn't teach well. Assigns homework and expects us to learn it then just re-explains the homework in a bad manner.
Encourages collaborating with classmates inside and outside of class. Engaging lectures and reasonable work load. No formal textbooks, readings are posted on D2L.

It's clear that Marcus isn't just there for research, he really loves teaching. He keeps the long lectures interesting and is always ready to answer questions with his experience from the industry. Definitely take the lab with this class if you can.

I would definitely recommend Dr. Duck as a professor. His lectures are very straight forward and he makes sure to keep things interesting. He has weekly quizzes so the information is fresh in your head. All tests and quizzes are open note online. Also would highly recommend taking the 213 lab too, extremely fun!
Great teacher, enjoyed coming to his lecture and lab each day. He has lots of experience in the industry and as a professor.
The class was 8 quizzes and 1 exam. Did not talk with the professor at all but material could be found within his presentations or online. Would recommend for people that need a 2 credit class. Easy.

The class was only 8 weeks long. All material that you read can be done at once but the grading is 8 quizzes with 1 exam. That is the ONLY grades for this course. I would skim through the readings, check in on quizlet, and then do the quizzes/exams on the following monday. Great prof and cares about his student.
Amazing professor, really funny, the subject is really easy.

Overall great! Class is super easy if you just do what the rubric says. Its only graded on like 5 things but theyre all super easy, no tests/exams. He can sometimes be a bit much/condescending. but aside from that overall great professor
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I went to his office hours once for extra help with irrigation, and never went back for office hours help because of the way I was treated. He can be very condescending at times and was not understanding at all when my parent was going through a serious health crisis.

Most of everyone going for a Horticulture Major should know him (or even have him as an Academic Adviser). He is super funny, and uses many examples. He may get excessively repetitive at times, but its only to burn valuable information into your head. I never had one lecture with him that was boring.
If sarcastic humor is your thing you will enjoy any class taught by Marcus. He's a super friendly little southern guy and is always willing to help.

BUS101 was taught by the toughest grader I've ever encountered. Despite attending every class, working with TAs, and investing more time than in my other courses, I was unable to do well. I took BUS101 in Spring 2022 and believe he no longer oversees the course, likely for good reason. The TAs he chose were awesome, but that's the only pro I have.

I loved this class; Professor Handspike was incredibly open, caring, and honest. I particularly enjoyed this class because of how much professor Handspike pushed my way of thinking and helped instill new habits, sharper character traits, and confidence within myself and the others, as well as always relating to us as student, he is great!

One of my favorite professors. Genuinely cares about you and your success and wants you to do well in this class, just be sure to ask for help if you need it. Good class for learning more about yourself and what you want!
Tough tough grader. Make sure you follow the instructions to a t. Lots of group projects
No Comments

Dyksen seems to go out of his way to embody every cliche of toxic managers. I laughed out loud in many of his lectures because of how unbelievable the things he said were. Expect a zero tolerance policy for everything, including what you are allowed to wear to class. The class could be really cool if not for him. Hope he gets a vacation. Or meds.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Do not recommend, toxic micromanaged sweatshop from the 80s. The whole course treats grown adults as kindergarteners and cultivates stress over the smallest things e.g. filenames, being 10 seconds late, etc. Disconnected from reality, punishes students who work to survive. Health policy is dangerous, leads to sick students coming to class.

Joke of a capstone. He will fear-monger you the first 2 days of class about coming to class on time and then have the most useless lectures afterwards. Just pick the most fun/easy project and don't give this class your peace of mind.
Dr. Dyksen uses old slides and material to lecture when every single lecture could have been an email. Any value in this course is provided by external clients or peers.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I understand that he cares about student success, but he tries to achieve that with overly strict policies and grading criteria, making me rate this class a 1 in quality overall.  You will lose points for very small things and missing any day of class severely affects your grade.  One of the most stressful classes I have taken at MSU.
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: The hate for Professor Dyksen is a little overblown in terms of the attendance. Although, it is annoying that even if you give ample notice for a single absence, he might not let you take it without a grade penalty. The real issue is the grading structure of the class. You will have no idea how you are doing in the class until the very end.
reviews.rating_tags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: He clearly cares about students' success and can be blunt about it. If you show up and do your work, you'll do well in the class. I learned more from this class than any other class in my degree, and it is partly because he has it structured like a real internship. If you disagree with his teaching style, you probably won't succeed in a real job
reviews.rating_tags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is a class where you'll actually learn the most compared to any other comp sci classes you've taken throughout your undergrad. However, I do agree that the kind of group you get can be sometimes a deal breaker but professor is really fair in grading when it comes to individual contributions.

Dr.D is misunderstood. He tries his best to relay the importance of professionalism and timeliness so he is strict about absences and missed work but thats what makes his class so important. Many people miss this point and find reasons to blame him for their poor grade. He clearly outlines expectations and genuinely wants everyone to succeed.
reviews.rating_tags: Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: On top of mentally torturing some of us with these insanely hard projects, the cherry on top was when a simple web application won the Best award. It convinced me that there is 0 point in doing any hard project and I highly suggest anyone in future classes to pick easy projects and save your sanity
This man's grim little goblin smile haunts my every day. ironically abysmal with technology. pits students against each other.  I bet he loves global warming.

The most disrespectful prof I have encountered in my entire college experience. He clearly thinks all the students are indebted to him. He has no experience in industry and loves the fact he can boss around students. Constantly gives incomplete directions and then yells at the entire class. Truly disappointed in MSU Engineering dept. at this point.
He's making me lose my hair. What a shame that this class is almost unavoidable. If I ever have a boss like him I'd quit on the spot he thinks we are in the 50s.

Honestly, this guy is someone who has never actually had any real life experience in the industry and his entire shpiel is based on other people's experiences. SO nice and passionate!! The lectures are interesting and she makes sure to answer all your questions. She has very helpful office hours that you should attend!
